hamakashavarun mw'mn n kaamiyaabukoshfi'eve. naseebuverive'je'eve. 'e'ee qym@ dhuvahunneve.

'adhi kanda'eLigen 'emeehunnakee beykaaru / nuvatha baTilu kankamun nuvatha 'ekalaange khlq thakunnaa'imedhu ruhivodi nugannavaa kankamun dhuruve 'enburifuragasdheymeehunneve.

('ebahee kiyeveykamuga'i vi'eve.) dhen thiyaba'imeehun 'e'ash bodaave, kbr verivee'eve. 'adhi thiyaba'imeehun vee faafaveri, nuba'i mjrm n kamuga'eve.

'adhi hamakashavarun ge w`d fuLu 'e'ee HqW 'ekeve. ('ebahee meesthakun maruvumashfahu 'alun dhiru'va'i, mHshr kure'vumuge w`d fuLu 'e'ee HqW 'ekeve.) 'adhi qym@ dhuvahakee sha'ke' nethi 'annaaney dhuvahekeve. mihen thiyaba'imeehunnash bunevi'je'yaa thiyaba'imeehun bune'eve. qym@ dhuvas 'e'ee kon dhuvahe'kame' 'ahuremennakash neynge'eve. 'e'ee hama heekoshgen dha'kaa vaahaka'e' kamuga'i menuvee 'ahuremen heenukurameve. 'adhi 'e dhuvas 'e'ee 'annaaney dhuvahe'kan yqyn kuraa bayaku kamuga'i 'ahuremen nuvamu'eve.

'adhi 'edhuvahun 'emeehun dhuniyeyga'i kuri kanthakuge nuba'ikan 'emeehunnash fa'uLuvaane'eve. 'adhi 'ekamaamedhu 'emeehun malaamaathkosh, fura'saarakuri kantha' 'emeehun vasha'ilaane'eve. 'e'e'chakee `dhb 'eve.

'adhi ('emeehun naraka'ige gadha `dhb ga'i theLifoLi, haLeylavamun dhaahindhu) 'emeehunnash 'engeyne'eve. kaleymen dhuniyeyga'i thibi'iru, mi dhuvahaa ba'dhaluvaaneykan handhaan na'tha'ili fadha'in thiman raskalaangeves mi'adhu kaleymen (naraka'ash lumashfahu) kaleymenge matheen handhaan na'thaalaa husheemeve. 'adhi kaleymenge thanakee hama naraka'eve. 'adhi kaleymennash nSr dhee, 'eheevaaney 'ekakuves nuvaane'eve.

kaleymennash thiyahen thiyavee kaleymen (dhuniyeyga'i thibi'iru) ge 'aayaththakakee 'e'ee kuLeykuLey 'e'chakash hadha'ila'i, 'e'ee malaamaathkurevey 'e'che' kamuga'i hadha'ilikameve. 'adhi dhuniyeyge dhiri'uLun kaleymen ha'la'i, 'avadhikoshlee'eve. 'eyash he'ligathee'eve.
fahe dhen mi'adhu 'emeehun 'ethanun, y`ny naraka'in nunereveyne'eve. 'adhi ge kiyamantherikamuge there'ash vanumash 'edheveyney bayaku kamuga'i -'adhi ruhivodigannavaaney gothash 'uLumash 'edheveyney bayaku kamuga'i - 'emeehun nuve'eve.
fahe 'enmeha'i Hmd 'aa'i, t`ryf 'aa'i, thn 'e' HqW vegen vanee hama 'asheve. 'e'ee 'uduthakuge veri rbW 'eve. 'adhi bimugeves rbW 'eve. 'adhi 'enmeha'i `lm thakuge veri rbW 'eve.
'adhi 'uduthakaa'i, bimuga'ives keerithikamaa'i, maathkamaa'i, kbry vanthakan khSW vegen vanee hama 'ekalaange'asheve. 'adhi 'ekalaange'ee `zW@ vantha, Hkm@ vantha kalaange'eve.
Hm mi'akuruthakugemuraadhu moLash dhenevodigenvanee hama 'eve.
mifothbaavaathle'vun vanee 'ebahee mi keerithi quran baavaathle'vunvanee `izWa@ vantha Hikma@ vantha ge HaDra@ nneve.

'uduthakaa'i bimaa'i 'adhi 'edhemedhuga'i vaahaathake'chaa'i hama hha'qu gothuga'i menuvee 'adhi kada'eLigenvaa mu'dhathakash menuvee thiman raskalaange nuha'dhavameve. 'adhi kaafaruvee meesthakunvanee 'emeehunnash birugennevunu kanthakash furagasdheegenneve. ('emeehunnash birugennevunu kanthakakee 'eemaan nuvinama boduvegenvaa `azaabe' 'athuvedhaaney kamuge vaahaka'eve.)

('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve! llh fiyava'i kaleymen thiya du`a kosh govaathake'chaa'imedhu (budhuthakaa'imedhu) kaleymen nikan dhekibalaasheve. (hhabarudheebalaasheve!) bimun 'ethakethi he'dhevi 'e'che' kaleymen nikan 'ahurennash dha'ka'ibalaasheve. nuvatha 'uduthakuga'i ('udutha' he'dhevumuga'i) 'ethake'chash ba'iverikame'vanee he'yeve? kaleymennakee thedhuverin kamuga'i vannyaa'i 'ekamugema'chash dhaleelukuraa fothe' (mi quran ge kureege foththakugethere'in namaves) kaleymen 'ahurennash 'efothe' genesdheebalaasheve. nuvatha `ilamu gethere'in 'e'ves 'asare' (khabare') genesdheebalaasheve! (mi quran ga'i 'evanee 'ekalaange'ash 'e'ves shareekaku ba'iveri'aku nuvaakamasheve.)

qiyaamath dhuvahash dhaandhen ves 'eynaa'ash ('eynaage du`a 'ash) 'ijaaba nudheymeehakash nuvatha 'e'chakash fiyava'i govaa du`a kosh hadhaameehakashvure 'aniyaaverin bodee fahe kaakuhe'yeve? ('e'ashvurebodu 'aniyaaveri'aku nuve'eve.) 'adhi 'ethakethi vanee 'emeehun 'egovaa govumash ('eynaage du`a 'ash) Gafilu vegen neve.

'adhi misthakun maHsharu kureveydhuvahu 'ethakethi ('ebudhutha') 'emeehunge 'ebahee (budhash 'aLukan kurimeehunge) `adhaavaaththerin kamuga'i vaane'eve. 'adhi 'ethakethi 'ethake'chash kurevunu 'aLukamaa'imedhu dhekoLuhadhaane'eve. 'inkaaru kuraane'eve.
'adhi 'emeehunge ma'chash bayaanvegenvaa thimanraskalaange 'aayaththa' kiyevi'je'yaa HaqWu 'aa'imedhu (quran 'aa'imedhu) kaafaruveemeehun bunaane'eve. mi'ee bayaanvegenvaa siHr'ekeve.

'adhi nuvatha 'emeehun bunanee'eve. 'ekaleygefaanu 'ekalaange'ash 'ebahee ( 'ash) dhoguhedhee 'eve. 'eygejavaabuga'i 'e'angavanee ('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve. 'ahuren 'ekalaange'ash dhoguhedhi kamuga'i vannyaa 'ekalaange 'ahurennash `azaabe' fonu'vannyaaves 'ekan dhifaa`u kurumash kaleymennash kuLadhaanavegen nuve'eve. 'adhi 'e (quran 'aa'imedhu) kaleymen dhoguhedhumash vadheganna minvaru 'ekalaange dhenevodigathun bodeve. 'ahurennaa'i kaleymennaa'i dhemedhu hekiveri'akash 'ekalaange fudhivodigenve'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange'ee ginadhina'in faafa fu'savaa raHma@ le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaange'eve.

('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve. rasoolubeykalunkuren 'enme furathama rasoolaakamuga'i 'ahurennuve'eve. 'adhi 'ahurennaa'imedhu kantha'vaanee kihinakunkame' 'adhi kaleymennaa'imedhuves (kantha'vaanee kihinakunkame') 'ahurennakash neyge'eve. 'ahurennash baavaathle'vey waHiy 'ash menuvee 'ahuren taba`i vaakamuga'i nuve'eve. hama'ekani bayaanvegenvaa nadhiyru 'aku kamuga'i menuvee (birugannavanivibeykalaku kamuga'i menuvee) 'ahuren nuve'eve.

('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve. 'e quran 'e'ee ge HaDra@ nvaa 'e'che'kamuga'i vefa'i 'adhi kaleymen 'e'ash kaafaru ve'je'yaa 'adhi banee 'israa'eelunge meehaku hama 'eyaa'e'gothash 'ebahee quran 'e'ee hha'qu thedhukamash hekidheefa'i dhen'adhi 'emeehaa quran 'ash 'eemaanve 'adhi kaleymen 'e quran 'ash bodaave kibru verive 'eemaan nuvikamuga'i vannyaa dhenvaanee kihinakun he'yeve? (kaleymenge ma'chash HujWa@ qay'imu vaanee'eve.) hamakashavarun 'aniyaaverinnash. llh t`la~ thedhumagu nudha'kava'eve.

'adhi kaafaruveemeehun 'eemaanveemeehunnashbune'eve. 'ekan 'e'ee ('ebahee muHmd gefaanu gennevi nabeekamaa'i 'adhi quran 'e'ee) heyokame'nama 'emeehun 'ebahee 'enikamethi mu'uminun 'ekamuga'i 'ahuremennashvure kuree 'isnuveeheve. ('ekamuga'ives kureethibeehee 'ahuremenneve.) 'adhi 'emeehunnash 'ekamash thedhumagu nulibunuhindhun fahe nikanhure 'emeehun bunaane'eve. mi'ee 'ebahee quran mi'ee 'ihuge muskuLi dhoguvaahaka'eve.

'adhi 'efothuge kureega'i. ('ebahee quran gekureega'i) muwsa~ `alayhi lslm gefoth('ekaleygefaanash baavaathle'vi tawra@) ve'eve. 'e'ee thabaavevey 'imaame' kamuga'yaa'i 'adhi raHma@ 'e'kamuga'eve. 'adhimi'ee (miquran mi'ee) (muwsa~ `alayhi lslm gefoth tawra@) thedhukuraahhaalu seedhaa `irib bahun 'a'isfa'ivaa fothekeve. 'e'ee 'aniyaaverivee meesthakunnash (mushrikunnash) biruverikamuge khabaru dhe'vumashaa'i 'adhi Hsan therinnash 'ufaaverikame'ge gothunneve.

hamakashavarun 'ahuremenge rabWu 'akee llh 'ey mihen bune dhen 'ebasmathee qay'im vethibi meehun dhanna'eve. qiyaamath dhuvahun 'emeehunnakash 'e'ves biruverime' nuve'eve. 'adhi hithaamakuraaney bayakukamuga'i 'emeehun nuve'eve.

'emeehunnakee suvarugeyge 'ekuverinneve. 'emeehun 'ethaa dhemithibeyhu'teve. 'e'ee 'emeehun (dhuniyeyga'i thibi'iru) kuraakamuga'ivee rangaLu `amaluthakuge dharuma'e'ge gothun 'emeehunnash kanda'eLigenvaa ni`ma@ 'eve.

'adhi 'inasaanaa 'eynaage ma'in bafa'innaa'imedhu Hsan therivumash / heyokosh hithumash thimanraskalaange 'eynaa'ash 'amuru kure'veemeve. mihenee 'eynaagemanma 'eynaayaa'igen balive'inee burakamaa'i 'eku / nuruhevey hhaaluga'eve. 'adhi 'eynaa 'edharifuLu vihe'eeves burakamaa'i 'eku / nuruhevey hhaaluga'eve. 'adhi 'edharifuLaa'igen 'eynaabalive 'inumaa'i 'adhi kirudhee ninmumaa'i 'e'ee muLi'eku thirees masdhuvaheve. 'adhi 'edharifuge bu'dhi furihamave hashigadu gadha'e'ja'umash dhaandhen (balaha'ta'eve.) 'adhi saaLees 'aharuvumun 'e'insaanaa 'eynaage rabWu 'ash dhannava'eve. 'ey 'aLuge rabWu 'eve! 'ibaraskalaange mi'aLaage ma'chashaa'i 'adhi mi'aLaage ma'in bafa'inge ma'chash 'ele'vi ni`ma@ 'ash mi'aLaa shukuru kuraanegothaa'i 'adhi 'e `amalu 'ash 'ibaraskalaange ruhivodigenvaa SaliH `amalu kuraane gothaa'i mi'aLaa'ash 'angava'i dhe'vaadheyve. 'adhimi'aLaage dharifaskoLu mi'aLaa'ash SulH kosh dhe'vaadheyve! hamakashavarun mi'aLaa 'ibaraskalaange'ash tha'ubaa ve'ja'eemeve. 'adhi hamakashavarun mi'aLaavanee muslimunge there'inneve. (kiyamantheringe there'inneve.)

kanda'eLigen 'emeehun 'e'ee 'emeehunkuri rangaLu 'amalu 'emeehunge kiba'in thimanraskalaange qaboolu kura'vaane meehunneve. 'adhi 'emeehunge nuba'ikantha'tha' thiman raskalaange fu'sava'i `afuw kura'vaa huree meve. 'adhi 'emeehun vaahushee suvarugeyge 'ekuveringe thereyga'eve. 'emeehunnash wa`du vevigenvaakamuga'ivi wa`du 'e'ee thedhuveri wa`du 'ekeve. ('ebahee rasoolu beybeykalunge dhoofuLugematheen 'emeehunnash llh kura'vaafa'ivaa wa`du fuLu 'e'ee hama thedhuveri wa`du fuLekeve.)

(akhira@ dhuvahash 'eemaannuvaa 'adhi ma'in bafa'innash kiyamantherinuvaameehaa) 'eynaage ma'inbafa'innash bune'eve. thiyadhemeehunnash huthurukan hu'teve. thiyadhemeehunge vaahaka'in 'ahurenge hith dhathive'eve. 'ahuren kashvaLun nereveynekamashaa'i maHsharu kureveyne kamash
thiya dhemeehun 'ahurennash biruveri wa`du kuranee he'yeve? 'adhi hamakashavarun 'ahurengekurin qarnu tha' veythivegen higa'je'eve. ('eygethere'in 'ekakuves naadhe'eve. 'emeehunge kantha' 'enimunee 'eve. 'ahurenge kantha'vesvaanee hama'ehenneve.) 'eynaa 'ehenbuninamaves 'eku'jaage ba'pa'aa'i manma'aa'idhemeehun 'eku'jaa salaamathveythoa llh 'ashdhannava'i du`a kura'vanee'eve. ('adhi 'edhemeehun 'eku'jaa'ash bune'eve.) kale'ash halaaku hu'teve. kaley 'eemaanvaasheve! (llh 'ashaa'i akhira@ dhuvahash 'eemaanvaasheve!) hamakashavarun ge wa`du fuLu 'e'ee hamaHaqWu wa`du fuLekeve. (maruvumashfahu dhiru'va'i maHsharu kure'vumuge wa`du fuLu 'e'ee hamaHaqWu wa`du fuLekeve.) fahe 'eku'jaabune'eve. 'isvedhiyameehun dha'kaafa'ivaa thaakunthaaku nujehey dhoguvaahakathake'kamuga'i menuvee thiyavaahakatha'nuve'eve.

'efadha 'efadha meehun'e'ee 'emeehunge ma'chash koafaage basfuLu HaqWu ve'jemeehunneve. 'adhi 'emeehunvanee jinneennaa'i 'insaanungethere'in 'isvedhiya (kaafaru) 'u'maththakugethereyga'i 'emeehunnaa'igunifa'eve. hamakashavarun 'emeehunvee ge'lihalaakuveemeehungethere'in neve.

'adhi konmebayakashves 'ebayaku kuri `amalu ge dharajathake've'eve. 'adhi 'emeehunnash 'emeehunge `amaluge jazaa qiyama@ dhuvahun baraabarash dhe'veyhu'teve. 'adhi 'emeehunnash 'aniyaa nuveveyhu'teve.

'adhi kaafaruveemeesthakun naraka'ash husha'aLa'ileveydhuvas (hadhumafuLu kura'vaasheve.) ('edhuvahun 'emeehunnash 'engeyne'eve.) kaleymen kaleymenge dhuniyeyge hhayaathuge rangaLu ba'i kaleymen ge'luva'ila'ifeemu'eve. 'adhi kaleymen 'edhuniyeyga'i majaakosh 'araamu libigenfeemu'eve. fahe mi'adhu mi kaleymennash jazaadheveyne'eve. 'ejazaa'akee 'e'ves HaqWu 'e'nethi kaleymen bimuga'i bodaave kiburuveriveekamuge sababunnaa'i 'adhi kaleymen faasiquvumuge sababunneve. 'ebahee ge kiyamanun nukuthumuge sababun 'ihaanaaththerivegenvaa `adhabu ge jazaa'eve.

('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) 'adhikaleygefaanun kaleygefaanunge qa'umuge meehunnash `ad baaga'igemeehunge 'khu (huwdu `alayh lsWalam) ge vaahaka hadhaankoshdhe'vaasheve! 'e'ee 'aHqafu 'eveki'unu thaaga'i 'ekaleygefaanun 'ekaleygefaanunge qawm 'ash 'inzaaru kure'vi hindhu 'eve. 'aHqafu 'e'ee 'e qawm ge meehun 'uLunuthaneve. 'adhi hamakashavarun 'ekaleygefaanunge kurinnaa'i 'adhi 'ekaleygefaanun fahunves nadhiyru ntha' 'ebahee (rasuwlu beykaluntha') 'isgosfa'ive'eve. vada'igenfaave'eve. ('ekaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvi'eve. 'ebahee (huwdu `alayh lsWalam vidhaaLuvi'eve.) kaleymen llh 'ashmenuvee 'aLukan nukuraasheve. hamakashavarun kaleymenge ma'chash boduvegenvaa dhuvahe'ge `adhab 'athuvedhaaneykamash 'ahuren birugannameve.

'emeehun dhennevi'eve. kaleygefaanu 'ahuremenge gaathash thiyavada'igennevee 'ahuremen 'ahuremenge lh n thakuge kiba'in 'anbura'ile'vumashthoa'eve? (nuvatha manaakure'vumashthoa'eve?) kaleygefaanakee thedhuveringe there'invaa beykalaku kamuga'i vannyaa kaleygefaanu 'ahuremennash thiya wa`d kura'vaa 'ethi ('e `adhab) 'ahuremengema'chash genesdhe'vaasheve!

'ekaleygefaanu vidhaavi'eve. 'ekamuge 'engunvanee ('e `adhab) 'annanaanevaguthe'ge 'engunvanee ge HaDra@ ga'eve. 'adhi thiman kaleygefaanu 'ekamakaa'igen kaleymengegaathash fonu'vunu kantha' kaleymenash 'i'va'i dhenee'eve. 'adhi 'ehene'kamaku 'ahuren kaleymennaamedhu dhekenee kaleymennakee jaahiluvaa bayaku kamuga'eve.

dhen fahe 'emeehun ('e `dhb) dhu'hidhun 'e'ee 'emeehunge vaadheethakaa'i dhimaalash kurimathila'i 'anna vilaagadekeve. ('emeehunnash `dhb 'a'ee vilaagade'ge sifa'iga'eve.) 'emeehun bunnyeve. mi'ee 'ahuremennash vaareyfen ve'saane vilaagadekeve. 'ekaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvi'eve. namaves kannimifa'ivanee 'e'gothakashves 'ehennooneve. 'adhi ki'e'he'yeve. 'e'ee kaleymen 'e'e'che' 'avaskurumash 'edhunu 'e'cheve. `dhb 'eve. 'e'ee 'eyga'i veyndheni `dhb 'ekulevigenvaavayekeve.

('eva'i) 'ebahee `aadhu baaga'igemeehunge ma'chash jehunuva'i 'eva'ige veri rabWu ge 'amurufuLash konme'e'che' halaakukosh barubaadhu koshla'eve. = fahe 'emeehun 'uLunu goathi gedhorunoonee nufenevey bayaku kamuga'i 'emeehun ve'je'eve. ('ebahee goathigedhorutha' baha'taafa'i 'emeehun maruve dhiya'ee'eve.) nuba'i nulafaameehunnash thimanraskalaange jazaadhe'vanee 'efadha'inneve. (mivaahaka ba'e'soorathuga'i varashtafSiylu koshbayaanvegenve'eve.)

'adhi hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange 'emeehunnash 'ebahee `adu baaga'igemeehunnash 'ekankamuga'i kaleymen quraysh nnashves hamaja'sava'i dhe'vi kankamuga'i hamaja'sava'i tamkiynu kosh dhe'veemeve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange 'emeehunash 'ivumaa'i fenumaa'i 'adhi hith le'veemeve. dhen fahe 'emeehun ge 'aayaththakash dhekoLuhadha'i qaboolu nukuri hidhun 'emeehunnakash 'emeehunge 'ivumakun 'adhi 'emeehunge fenumakunviyas 'adhi 'emeehunge hithakun viyas 'e'veskame' fu'dha'e' nudhineve. 'adhi 'emeehun 'ekankamaa'imedhu malaamaathkosh fura'saara kurikantha' 'emeehun vashaala'ifi'eve. 'ebahee 'emeehunnash `dhb 'a'is 'emeehun halaakuvedhiya'ee'eve.

'adhi hamakashavarun rashthakugethere'in kaleymenge vasha'igenvaa thanthan thimanraskalaange halaaku kure'veemeve. 'adhi 'aayaththa' 'ebahee (dhaleelutha') thafaathu kura'va'i thimanraskalaange 'egothmigothash badhalukure'veemeve. 'e'ee 'emeehun (kaafarukan dhookosh heyomagash) 'enburi 'aadheythoa'eve.

llh 'aa'i gaathkoshdhee ku'than koshdhey lh n thake'kamuga'i llh fiyava'i 'emeehun hifaa khtiyaru kuri thakethi ('ebudhutha') 'emeehunnash nSr dhinnama'eve. 'adhi kiye'he'yeve. 'emeehunge kiba'in 'ethakethi ge'lunee'eve. 'ebahee qiyaamathdhuvahun 'emeehunnash 'ethakethi ge'leyne'eve. 'e'ee 'emeehun hedhi dhogeve. 'adhi 'e'ee 'emeehun dhoguhadhaakamuga'iveethake'cheve.

'adhi thiman raskalaange kaleygefaanaa'i dhimaalash jinneenge ba'igade' 'anburu'va'i le'veemeve. fonu'veemeve. 'e'ee 'eba'imeehun quran 'adu'ehumasheve. dhenfahe 'emeehun 'ekaleygefaanunge 'arihash 'aadhevunuhindhun ('emeehun 'emeehunnash) 'emeehun bunnyeve. kaleymenneyve. hanuhimeynun 'ahanthibeysheve. (dhen 'emeehun 'ekaleygefaanu kiyavaavidhaaLuvaa'adufuLu 'ehumash thibe'ja'oo'eve.) dhenfahe 'ekaleygefaanun kiyavaa vidhaaLuvun nimunuhindhun (qawmu gemeehunnash) 'inzaaru kuraahhaalu 'emeehun 'emeehunge qawmu 'ash 'enburi higa'je'eve.

'emeehun bunnyeve. 'ey 'ahuremenge qawmu gemeehunneyve. hamakashavarun 'ahuremen fothe'gevaahaka 'aha'ifeemeve. 'efothakee muws~ `alyh lslm 'ashfahu baavaathle'vunu fothekeve. 'efothuge kureegefoth tha'ves thedhukuraahhaalu baavaathle'vunu fothekeve. 'efoth magudha'kanee hama seedhaa HanqWu 'asheve. 'adhi seedhaa thedhumagasheve.

'ey'ahuremenge qawmu gemeehunneyve. gefaraathash 'egova'ila'vaa kaleygefaanash kaley men 'ijaaba dheysheve. 'adhi 'ekaleygefaanash 'eemaanvaasheve. 'eyrun kaleymenge faafa'ithere'i 'ekalaange fu'savaa hu'teve. 'adhi veyndhenivi `adhab n 'ekalaange kaleymen salaamathkura'vaane'eve.

'adhi gefaraathash 'egova'ila'vaa kaleygefaanash 'ijaabanudhinmeehaa (dhanna'eve.) fahe bimuga'i nukuLa'dha'ileveyne meehakukamuga'i 'eynaanuve'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange fiyava'i 'ehen 'e'ves saharoaveri'aku 'eynaa'akashnuve'eve. 'efadhameehun 'evanee bayaanvegenvaa magufuredhume'ga'eve.

hamakashavarun 'uduthakaa'i binhe'dhevee llh ta`al~ kan 'emeehunnashfahe neygeneebaava'eve. 'adhi 'ethakethi he'dhevumuga'i 'e'ves nukuLedhuntherikame''adhi nuvatha varubalifuLu vume' 'ekalaange'ashnuve'eve. mihen mikan kan huri'iru maruvefa'ivaathakethi dhiru'vumugema'chash ves 'ekalaange kuLadhunvanthavevodigenve'eve. 'adhiki'e'he'yeve? 'ekalaange'ee konmekame'gema'chash kuLadhunvanthavevodigenvaakalaange'eve.

'adhi kaafaruvee meesthakun naraka'ash husha'eLeydhuvas (handhumafuLu kura'vaasheve!) ('emeehunnash 'engeveyne'eve.) 'aLefahe mi'ee hama HaqWu kamuga'i nuveyhe'yeve? 'ekaafarun dhannavaane'eve. 'aadheyheve. 'aLamenge rabWu gandhee dhannavameve. thiya'ee hama HaqWu 'eve. 'ekalaange waHiy kura'vaane'eve. fahe kaleymen kaafaruvaakamuge sababun 'ehenve kaleymen `adhabu ge rahalibigannaasheve.

('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) rasoolubeykalunkure hithvarufuLugadha `azmu varugadhabeykalun keththerivevada'igennevifadha'in kaleygefaanu keththerivevada'igannavaasheve! 'adhi 'emeehunge ma'chash 'avasvevada'i nugannavaasheve. ('ebahee 'ekaafarunnash `azaabu 'a'umash 'avasvevada'i nugannavaasheve!) 'emeehunnash wa`du vevunukantha' ('e `adhabu) 'emeehun dhekey dhuvahun 'emeehun konfadha he'yeve? 'emeehun nash heevaaneedhuvaale'ge hindhukoLe'ga'imenuvee 'emeehun (dhuniyeyga'i) lasvenuthibeykamuga'eve. dhenfahe 'isdhiya mivaakathakakee 'i'va'idhinumekeve. meesthakunnash wa`Zu naSiyHa@ 'i'va'idhinumekeve. fahe faasiqu bayakumenuvee. ( gekiyamanun nukuthbayakumenuvee) halaakuvaaney he'yeve? 'ebahee. gekiyamanun nukuthbayakumenuvee halaaku nuvaane'eve.
thimaamen kaafaruve ge magu bandhukuri meesthakun. (dhanna'eve.) 'emeehunge `amalutha' baatilu kura'va'ifi'eve. ('emeehunkuri heyo `amalutha' ge'leni kura'va'ifi'eve.)

'adhi 'ash 'eemaanvegen saalihhu `amalukosh 'adhi muhhanmadhuge faanunge ma'chash baava'ile'vi thake'chash, 'ethake'chakee 'e'i 'emeehunge rabWu ge hhadrathun baava'ila'va'ifa'ivaa hhaa'quthake'cheve. 'e'ee qurun 'eve. fahe 'ethake'chash 'eemaanvi meesthakun (dhanna'eve.) 'emeehunge kushfaafatha' fu'sava'i 'adhi 'emeehunge hhaaluthakaa'i kantha'tha' 'islaahukoshdhe'va'i sulhakura'va'ifi'eve.

'ehen'ekan'evee, hamakashavarun kaafarun thaba`avee baatilaa'eve. ('e'ee 'ash shareekukurumaa'i 'ekalaange'ash 'uredhumeve.) 'adhi hamakashavarun 'eemaanvee meesthakun thaba`avee hha'qaa'eve. ('e'ee tawHiyd 'aa'i 'eemaankamaa'i kiyamantherikameve.) dheba'imeehunge hhaalu bayaankura'vanee meesthakunnash ja'savaa misaale'gegothunneve. (`ibrathe'ge gothunneve.)

'ey 'eemaanve'ge meesthakunneyve. thiyaba'imeehunnaa'i kaafarunnaa'i (maydn ga'i) ba'dhaluve'je'yaa 'emeehunge kandhuraatha' kandaasheve. 'emeehunmaraasheve. 'e'ee 'eyge gina bayaku maruve 'avadhivaandheneve. dhen 'adhi 'emeehun rangaLash bandhe ha'yarukuraasheve. ('e'ee 'emeehunnash fila'igen nudhevey fadha'akunneve.) dhenha'yaruvee meesthakun 'ehennyaa 'e'ves fidhuya'e' badhale'nethi dhookoshlaasheve. nuvatha fidhuya 'athulaafa'i dhookoshlaasheve. (maslahhathu hurigoth balaanee veyaa'eve.) 'e'ee hanguraama 'eyge hathiyaaru baha'ta'ifuma'dhaanneve. 'ebahee kaafarun balive hathiyaaru baha'ta'ifumash dhaandheneve. 'adhi 'e hhukum 'akee kaafarunnaamedhu 'othhhukumeve. ('adhi mikanmigothash ninmevumakaanula'ives llh 'edhi vodigennevinama 'ekaafarunge ma'chash mu'uminunnash nasrudhe'va'ifeeheve. 'ehennamaves 'ekalaange 'ehen nuhe'dhevee thiyaba'imeehun 'e'bayakuge faraathun 'ane'bayaku 'imthihhaanukure'vumasheve. (keththeri mujahd nnash thawab ginakoshdhe'va'i rangaLu jazaadhe'vumasheve. 'adhi 'emeehun 'aththakun kaafarunnash `uqoobaath dhe'vumasheve.)
'adhi ge maguga'i maruve shaheedhuvegen dhiya meesthakunge dharumayaa'i thawab ge'leni nukura'vaane'eve.
nikanhure llh ta`al~ 'emeehun suvaruge dhi'umash magudha'kavaanetheve. 'adhi 'emeehunge 'enmeha'i kantha'thakaa'i hhaalutha' rangaLu kura'va'i baraabarukoshdhe'vaahu'teve.
'adhi 'ekalaange 'emeehunnash 'ethan hunnaanekan 'angavaafa'ivaa suvaruge'ash (nuvatha 'emeehunnashtaka'i 'ekalaange 'ethaaga'i meeruvasdhu'vaafa'ivaa suvaruge'ash) 'emeehun va'dhavaahu'teve.

'ey 'imaanve'je meesthakunneyve. kaleymen llh 'ash nasru dhennyaa ('ebahee 'ekalaange dheenash nasrudhennyaa) 'ekalaange kaleymenash nasru dhe'vaanetheve. 'adhi kaleymenge fa'ithilatha' hanguraama'ige ma'idhaanuga'i nuvatha SiriTu maguhigaa'iru saabithu koshdhe'vaa hu'teve.
'adhi kaafaruveemeesthakun dhanna'eve. 'emeehunnash halaaku hu'teve. ('abaa'javerikanhu'teve.) 'adhi 'emeehunge heyo `amalutha' 'ekalaange baTilu kura'vaa hu'teve.
'ekan 'ehen 'ehe'dhevee llh baavaathle'vi thake'chash hamakashavarun 'emeehun nuruhunee 'eve. ('eemaan nuvee'eve.) 'ehenve 'emeehunge heyo `amalutha' 'ekalaange ge'leni kura'va'i baTilu kure'vee'eve.

'emeehunge ('ebahee ma'kaage kaafarunge) kureege ('ebaavathuge kaafarunge) nimun 'adhi 'emeehunge fahukoLu veekonfadha'akunkan mimeehundhekeyn mimeehunfahe bimuga'i higaabigaa dhathuru fathurukosh nuhadhanee baava'eve? llh ta`ala~ 'emeehun (basnu'ehumuge sababun) halaaku kura'va'i barubaadhu kure'vi'eve. llh 'adhi (mihaaruge) kaafarunnashves hama kantha'kura'vaanee hama'efadha'inkamuga'ivedhaane'eve. basnu'ehi'yaa halaaku kura'vaafaane'eve.
'ekan 'ehen 'evee hamakashavarun llh ta`ala~ 'ee 'eemaanvee meesthakunge saharoa veriyaa'eve. 'adhi kaafarun (dhanna'eve.) 'emeehunnakash 'e'vas saharoaveri'aku nuve'eve.

hamakashavarun 'eemaanvegen SaliHu `amalu kuri meesthakun 'ethanthaagedhashun 'aarutha' dhemey bageechaa thakakash llh ta`ala~ va'dhava'eve. 'adhikaafaruvee meesthakun 'emeehun (dhuniyeyga'i) 'araamukure'eve. 'adhi na`am soofi ka'ibo'i hadhaafadha'in ka'ibo'i hadha 'eve. 'adhi (qiyama@ dhuvahun) 'emeehun gosthibeynethanakee naraka'eve. 'alifaaneve.

'adhi kaleygefaanun 'erashun nerele'vi rashuge meehunnashvure baarumaagadha kitha'kitha'rash (rashrashugemeehun) thimanraskalaange 'emeehunves (basnu'ehumuge sababun) halaaku kure'veen he'yeve? 'ebahee 'ebaavathuge varash gina rashrash halaaku kure'veemeve. 'emeehunnakash dhen 'e'ves nasruveri'aku nuve'eve.

'emeehaage rabWu ge HaDra@u nvaa dhaleele'ge matheega'ivaa meehaayaa'i 'emeehaage nuba'i `amalu tha' 'emeehaa'ash zeenaththerivevunumeehaa 'edhemeehun 'e' fadhavaaneyhe'yeve? 'adhi thimaagehavaanafusaa'i nuvatha 'ami'la 'edhumaa'i taba`a vegenvaameehaafadhahe'yeve? ('edhemeehun 'e'varunuvaane'eve.)

taqwa~ verinnash wa`du vevifa'ivaa suvarugeyga'ivaa 'aaruthakuge misaalakee 'ethaaga'i nuba'inuvaa kuninuvaa meeru fenunvaa 'aaruthake've'eve. 'adhi 'eygeraha badhalunuvaa kiruge 'aarutha've'eve. 'adhi boameehunnash rahameeru ladhWa@u huri raluge 'aarutha' ve'eve. 'adhisaafu maamu'ige 'aarutha've'eve. 'adhi 'emeehunnash 'ethaaga'i hurihaava'thare'ge meyvaayaa'i 'adhi 'emeehunge rabWu ge HaDra@u nvaa faafa fu'sevumaa'i mihurihaa ni`ma@ 'e' 'emeehunnash 'ethaave'eve. mifadhameehaa'aa'i 'adhi 'emeehunnash 'enme hoonukan gadhafen boandhevey dhen'eygesababun 'emeehunge gohorutha' buriburivaa hhaalu naraka'igaadhemihunnameehaa'aa'i 'e'fadhavaaneyhe'yeve? ('ekaku koLunethkoLuge 'araamaa ni`ma@ ga'i dhemihunnanee'eve. 'anekaku koLunethkoLuge veynaa'i `adhabuga'i dhemihunnanee'eve.)

'adhi 'emeehungethereyga'i 'emunaafiqungethereyga'i 'ekaleygefaanungevaahakafuLu 'ahanthibeymeehun ve'eve. 'emeehun kaleygefaanunge 'arihun nukume'ja'umashdhaandhen neve. dhenhama nukumefe'i `ilmudhe'vunu meehunnash ('ebahee mu'uminungethereyga'i thi'bevi `aalimunnash 'emeehunbune'eve. (suvaalukure'eve.) dhenme 'ekaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvee keekeythoa'eve? 'emeehunge 'evaahaka'ash 'ishaaraath kura'va'i llh ta`ala~ 'e'angavanee kanda'eLigen 'emeehun 'e'ee (heyo'e'che' nuvannaaneygothun) llh ta`ala~ 'emeehunge hiththakuga'i si'ka je'sevimeehunneve. 'adhi 'emeehun 'emeehunge havaanafusaa'i taba`a vegenvaameehunneve.
'adhi thedhumagulibevunumeehun dhanna'eve. 'ekalaange 'emeehunnash thedhumagu 'ithuru koshdhe'va'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange 'emeehun taqwa~ verikanmathee dhamaha'tava'eve.

hamaku'li'akash 'emeehunge gaathash 'ebahee ('emunaafiqungegaathash) qiyam@ 'a'umashmenuvee 'emeehun fahe 'inthizaaru 'ebakureyhe'yeve? hamakashavarun 'eyge `alaamaaththa' 'athuve'je'eve. fahe 'emeehunge gaatha' qiyam@ dhuvas 'athuve'je'yaa ves dhen 'emeehun wa`Zu naSiyHa@ libigannaanee konfadha'akun he'yeve? 'eyge fa'idhaa'e' nukuraane'eve.

fahe hamakashavarun llh menuvee HaqWu 'ilaahaku nuvaakan kaleygefaanu dhenevada'igannavaasheve! 'adhi kaleygefaanu kaleygefaanunge faafa fu'sevumash 'edhi dhannavaasheve! 'adhi mu'uminu firihenunge'aa'i 'adhi mu'uminu 'anhenunge faafa fu'sevumash 'edhivada'igen dhannavaasheve! dhuvaalu vaguthu masa'kathuga'i kaleymen 'efu'mifushash furoLeythan llh ta`ala~ dhenevodigenve'eve. 'adhi reygaduvaguthu kaleymen 'araamukurumash gosthibeythanves llh ta`ala~ dhenevodigenve'eve.

'adhi 'eemaanveemeesthakun bune'eve. (hanguraama'ige vaahaka bayaanvegenvaa) soorathe' bavaathla'vaaneynama'eve. dhenfahe 'esoorathuga'i Hukum tha' rangaLash saafukosh 'oLume'nethi bayaanvegenvaa fadha'in hanguraama'igevaahaka bayaanvegenvaa soorathe'baavaath la'va'ifi'yaa 'eba'imeehunge hiththakuga'i (nifaqu kamuge) balikame'vaameehun kaleygefaanu dhekevada'igannavaanee maruvaanvegen heybalive dhekaLi vidhifa'ivaameehaku balaagothash kaleygefaanaa'i dhimaalash balaathee'eve. 'emeehunnash halaaku hu'teve. (nuvatha 'emeehun neydheygoth dhimaavun) 'emeehunnash 'a'ulaavegenve'eve.

kiyamantherikan 'adhaakurumaa'i 'adhi heyobas bunun hu'teve. dhenfahe hanguraama farDu ve kanda'eLi'je'yaa 'emeehun dhebasve fahathash jehe'eve. 'adhi 'emeehun kiyamantherive llh ta`ala~ 'ash thedhuverivinama 'egoth 'emeehunnash maaheyoveeheve.

('ey mithiba munaafiqunneyve! nuvatha murutha'dhumeehunneyve!) kaleymen 'u'mathuge kankamash verikurevi'je'yaa (nuvatha kaleymen 'islaamudheenun moonu 'anbura'ila'ifi'yaa) kaleymen bimuga'i shirukukosh fasaadhakosh 'adhi kaleymen kaleymenge raHim kada'i hadhaabayaku kamuga'i vedhaanekanneyge'eve. 'ehenvun 'ekasheegenve'eve.

kanda'eLigen 'efadhameehun 'e'ee llh la`na@ le'vi meehunneve. fahe 'ekalaange 'emeehunnash (heyo'e'che' nuvisneymegothun) beerukure'vi'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange 'emeehunge loatha''adhiri kure'vi'eve. ('e'ee ma`nawi~ gothun HaqWu thedhu 'e'che' nufennaanegothunneve.)
'emeehunfahe quran 'aa'i medhu visnaafikurukosh thadhubeerukosh nuhadhanee baava'eve. nuvatha 'emeehunge hiththa''evanee thaLu 'aLuvaa bandhukoshfa'ihe'yeve?

hamakashavarun 'emeehunnash thedhumagu rangaLash bayaanve 'egumashfahu 'emeehun 'emeehunge furagahash ra'dhu veemeehun 'ebahee murutha'dhuveemeehun (dhanna'eve.) shayTanu 'emeehunnash (nuba'ikantha'tha') zeenaththeri koshdhinee'eve. 'adhi 'emeehunnash 'esoru beykaaru 'u'meedhutha' koshdhee hedhee'eve. vaave'dhee'eve.

'ekan 'ehen 'evee hamakashavarun llh baava'ile'vi thake'chaa'imedhu nuruhunumeehunnash ('e'ee ma'kaage mushrikun nuvatha yahoodheenneve.) 'emunaafiqun bunee ba'e'kankamuga'i nikanhure 'ahuremen kaleymennash kiyamanvaahusheemeve. 'adhi 'ehennamaves llh 'e'angavanee 'emeehunge si'rutha' llh dhenevodi gannavaakamuga'eve.

'adhi malaa'ikathbeykalun 'emeehunge maruhithpava'ifi'yaa dhenvaanee kihine'he'yeve? ('emeehunge maruhithpavaahinidhu) 'ebeykalun 'emeehunge moonuthakuga'yaa'i 'emeehunge fookoLuthakuga'i thaLu'vaahu'teve.

'ehen 'evee hamakashavarun llh koafaavevodi gannavaa kanthakaa'i 'emeehun taba`a veekameve. 'adhi 'ekalaange ruhivodigathumaa'i 'emeehun nuruhunee'eve. dhen fahe 'ekalaange 'emeehunge (heyo `amalutha') baTilu kure'vi'eve.

'adhi nuvatha 'emeehunge hiththakuga'i (nifaqu kamuge) ba'ye'vaa 'emeehun 'emeehunge hhasadha'ige ruLiverikan llh nuneru'vaanekamash 'emeehun heekuranee he'yeve? ('ehen nuvaane'eve. 'emeehunge hiththakuga'i mu'uminunge ma'cha' 'evaa ruLiverikamaa'i hasadhaverikamaa'i `adhaavaaththerikan llh neru'vaane'eve. faaLu kura'vaane'eve.)

'adhi thimanraskalaange 'edhivodi gannavaanama hamakashavarun thiman raskalaange kaleygefaanash 'emeehun dha'kava'ifeeheve. ('e'eekonba'e'kan 'angavafaahusheemeve.) dhen hamakashavarun 'emeehunge `alaamaathun kaleygefaanash 'emeehun 'egivada'igenfaane'eve. 'adhi hamakashavarun kaleygefaanash 'emeehunge basbunumuge raagunnaa'i 'adhi miqSad n 'emeehun 'egivada'igenfaane'eve. 'adhi ('eymithiba munaafiqunneyve!) kaleymenge `amalutha' llh dhenevodigenve'eve.

'adhi hamakashavarun kaleymengethere'in mujaahidhunnakee konba'e'kamaa'i 'adhi keththerinnakee konba'e'kan thiman raskalaange dhenevodigenvaakan faaLukura'va'ifumashdhaandhen hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange kaleymen imtiHanu kura'vaahusheemeve. ('e'ee hanguraama farDu kura'va'igen kiyamantherinnaa'i nukiyamantherin haamakura'va'igenneve.)

hamakashavarun kaafaruveemeesthakun 'adhi 'emeehun gemagu bandhukosh 'emeehunnash thedhumagu rangaLash bayaanve 'egumashfahu dhen'emeehun rasoolaa'aa'i 'idhikoLu hedhimeehun (dhanna'eve.) 'emeehunnakash 'e'vesgothakun 'adhi'e'veskamakunviyas llh 'ash 'udhagule'kosh ge'lume'koshhedheyne ba'e'kamuga'i 'emeehunnuve'eve. 'adhi nikanhure 'emeehunge `amalutha' baTilu vedhaane'eve.

'ey'eemaanve'je meesthakunneyve! kaleymen llh 'ash kiyamantherivaasheve! 'adhi kaleymen rasoolaa'ash kiyamantherivaasheve! 'adhi kaleymen kaleymenge (heyo) `amalutha'
baTilu nukuraasheve! (mi'aayathuge mafhuwmu 'ashbalaa'iru llh 'ashaa'i 'ekalaange rasoolaa'ash kiyaman nuvaa konmemeehe'ge (heyo) `amalutha' baTilu vaane'eve. 'edhefaraathuge 'amuraa dhimaanuvaagothash hunna'e'ves heyo`amale' qaboole'nuveveyne'eve. migothun balaa'iru mazuhabe'ge namuga'ikurevey `amalutha' rasmee 'ofeehun ba'lava'i gannavaanekamuge 'e'ves dhaleele'netheve.

hamakashavarun kaafaruveemeesthakun 'adhi 'emeehun ge magu 'ebahee 'islaamudheen bandhukosh dheenash meehun vananudhee huraskosh / bandhukoshhadha'i dhen'emeehun kaafarukanmatheevaa hhaalu maruvedhiya kamuga'ivannyaa fahe llh ta`ala~ 'emeehunnash nufu'savaahu'teve.

fahe kaleymen mu'uminun balikashi nuvaahushikameve! findi nuvaasheve! 'adhi kaleymen (kureefasha'igen) SulHa yashnugovaasheve! kaafarun SulHa 'ashgovandhen kaleymen hanguraama kuriyash gendhaasheve! kaleymennakee mathivaanemeehunneve. llh vodigenvanee kaleymennaa'i 'ekuga'eve. 'adhi kaleymenge `amalutha' 'ebahee `amaluge dharumayaa'i savaabu 'ekalaange madhu nukura'vaane'eve.

dhuniyey ge midhiri'uLunvaakan kashavaree kuLivaraa'i 'adhi llh ta`ala~ gemathin Gafil koshlaa 'e'che' kamuga'eve. 'adhikaleymen 'eemaanve 'adhi kaleymen tqw~ veri ve'je'yaa kaleymenge 'ujoora kaleymenash 'ekalaange dhe'vaane'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange kaleymenge mudhalakash 'ebahee kaleymenge muLimudhaa ('ekash) kaleymendheykashe' 'edhivodi nugannavaane'eve. ('edhivodigannavanee 'eygehha'qu'adhaakurumasheve. zakaathdheysheve. dhenves sunnath Sadaqa@ dheysheve.)

'ekalaange kaleymengekiba'in ('ekash) 'emudhaa heydhakurumash 'edhivodigennevi nama fahe 'eha'irun kaleymennash dhathivedhaane'eve. dhenkaleymen dhahivethi vedhaane'eve. bakhiylu vedhaane'eve. 'adhikaleymenge hithyakuga'ivaa ruLiverikamaa'i hhasadhaverikan 'ekalaange neru'vaane'eve.

'eymithibameehunneyve! kaleymen gemaguga'i heydhakurumash kaleymennash goveyne'eve. fahe kaleymengethereyga'i bakhiylu vaaneymeehun - dhahivethivaaneymeehun- vaane'eve. 'adhi bakhiylu vaameehun - dhahivethivaameehun dhanna'eve. fahe hamakashavarun 'emeehaku 'e bakhiylu vaakan kashavaree 'emeehe'ge 'ami'la nafusasheve. 'ebahee 'ekamuge ge'lumaa'i dherakan'onnaanee hama 'emeehe'ge 'ami'la nafusasheve. llh 'e'ee 'ami'la zaathufuLaa'igen fudhivodigenvaa kalaange'eve. 'adhi kaleymenanakee faqeerunneve. 'ekalaange'ash beynunvegenvaameehunneve. 'adhi kaleymen gemaguga'i heydhanukosh 'ekalaange 'amurufuLuthakash 'enburi furagasdheefi'yaaves 'ekalaange 'ehenqa'umakash badhalu kura'va'ifaane'eve. 'ebahee kaleymenge badhaluga'i 'ehenbayaku gennava'ifaane'eve. 'adhi 'egennavaameehun kaleymenfadha'in nuvaane'eve. bas 'ahaane'eve.

('ey rasuwl llh 'eve!) hamakashavarun thimaraskalaange kaleygefaanash bayaanvegenvaa fataHa 'akun fataHa kosh dhe'va'ifeemeve. (mithaami 'ishaaraath kura'vaa fataHa 'akee SulHu lHuda ybiyWa@ ge fataHa kamaa'i nuvatha makWa@ fataHa kure'vun kamaa'i nuvatha 'ekaleygefaanash dhe'vunu hurihaa fataHa kamaa'i mikankamaa'imedhu mufasWiru nge bas thafaathuvegenve'eve. konme'akas 'aLugadu dhekeygothuga'i 'e'ee 'ekaleygefaanunge `adhaavaaththeringe ma'chash 'ekaleygefaanash llh dhe'vi hurihaa fataHa 'ekeve.)

'e'ee 'ebahee 'ebodu fataHa 'e' llh kaleygefaanash dhe'vee kaleygefaanunge faafa'igethere'in 'isvedhiya faafathakaa'i 'adhi fasvedhaaneyfaafa'akaa'i kaleygefaanash fu'sava'i dhe'vumashtaka'eve. 'adhi kaleygefaanungema'chash 'ekalaange ni`mi@ furihama kure'vumasheve. 'adhi 'ekalaange kaleygefaanash hama seedhaavegenvaa thedhumagash magudhe'kevumasheve.

'adhi llh kaleygefaanash gadhavegenvaa naSru 'akun. naSru dhe'vumasheve. * dhanna'eve. 'isvedhiyathaaga'i 'evaa konme kamakaa'imedhu vaahatha'dhiguve basthafaathuvefa'ive'eve. 'ehenve 'ekan hadhaankolameve. 'aLugaduves 'adhi 'ehen dhadivaLe'ga'i 'ekankamaa'imedhu 'e'che' dhannavaanee'eve. n shaa llh.

'adhi muw'minu n ge hiththakash 'e fataHa thakuge sababunhamajehumaa'i ma'ithirikan genasdhe'vee hama llh 'eve. 'e'ee 'emeehunge kureege 'eemaankamugethere'ash 'eemaankan 'ithurukure'vumashtaka'eve. 'adhi'uduthakaa'i bimuga'ivaahaa sifa'inne' milkuve khaSWa vegenvanee hama llh 'asheve. ('e'ee hurihaava'thare'ge sifa'inneve. malaa'ikath beykalunnaa'i 'insaanunnaa'i 'adhi jinni sha'ithaanungethere'innaa'i mi'enmehaabaavathe'ge sifa'inneve.) 'adhi llh ta`al~ vodigenvanee dhenevodigenvaa Hikma@ vantha kalaku kamuga'eve.

'e'ee muw'minu firihenunnaa'i muw'minu 'anhenun 'ethanthaagedhashun 'aarutha'dhemey bageechaathakakash / suvaruge thakash 'ekalaange ve'dhevumashtaka'eve. 'emeehun 'ethanthaa dhemithibey hhaalu ga'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange 'emeehungekiba'in 'emeehunge kushfaafatha' fu'sava'idhe'vumasheve. 'adhi llh ta`al~ ge HaDra@u ga'i boduvegenvaa naseebe'kamuga'i 'ekanvi'eve.

'adhi 'e'ee munifiqu firihenunnaa'i munifiqu 'anhenun 'adhi mushriku firihenunnaa'i mushriku 'anhenunnaa'i (mimeesmeehunnash) 'ekalaange `adhabu dhe'vumasheve. = 'emeehunnakee llh ta`al~ 'aa'imedhu nuba'iheetha' heekuraameehunneve. 'eygesababun 'emeehungema'chash nuba'igoththa' medhuverikura'vaashi'eve. 'adhi llh ta`al~ 'emeehungema'chash koafaala'va'i 'adhi'ekalaange 'emeehunnash la`na@ le'vi'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange 'emeehunnash naraka tha'yaaru kure'vi'eve. 'adhi 'e'i 'ethaagosthibun nuba'ivegenvaathaneve.

ge HaDra@u nvaa faDulu vanthaveri kamaa'i 'adhi ni`umathe'ge gothunneve. 'adhi llh 'ee dhenevodigenvaa 'adhi Hikm@ vantha raskalaange'eve.

'adhi mu'uminunge dheba'igade' 'e'bayaku 'ane'bayakash hanguraamakosh thaLaafoLaa kamuga'i vannyaa kaleymen (dhenthibi mu'uminun) 'edhemedhu SulHa kuruvaasheve. hamaja'saasheve. 'adhi'edheba'imeehunkure 'e'bayaku baGawa@ kosh 'ane'ba'igaduge ma'chash 'ara'igenfi'yaa fahe kaleymen (SlHu kuraameehun) 'emeehun llh ta`al~ ge 'amurufuLash ('ekalaange hhukum fuLash) rujoo`a ve'ja'umashdhaandhen 'e baGawa@ kosh 'ara'igath bayakaa'i kaleymen hanguraamakuraasheve. dhenfahe 'emeehun llh ta`al~ ge 'amurufuLash ('ekalaange hhukum fuLash) rujuw`a ve'je'yaa dhenkaleymen 'edheba'igadudhemedhu SlHu kuraasheve. / hamaja'saasheve, 'adhi kaleymen kankamuga'i seedhaakosh `adhuluverivaasheve. mihenee hamakashavarun `adhuluverivaameehunnash llh ta`al~ loabive vodigannava'eve.

hamakashavarun mu'uminunnakee 'akhu nneve. ('e'badu 'e'bafaameehun fadhaba'ekeve.) fahe kaleymen kaleymenge dhe 'akhu nge dhemedhu SlHu kuraasheve. / hamaja'saasheve, 'adhi kaleymen llh 'ash biruvethivaasheve. 'e'ee kaleymennash raHma@ la'va'ithoa 'eve.

'ey'eemaanve'je meesthakunneyve! kaleymen 'e'bayaku 'ane'bayakash malaamaath nukuraasheve. 'emeehun ('ebahee malaamaathlibeymeehun) 'ane' meehunnashvure ('ebahee malaamaathkuraameehunnashvure) heyobayaku kamuga'i vedhaane'eve. 'adhi 'anhenunves 'anhenunnaa'i (malaamaath nukuraasheve.) 'ekanbalunvedhaane'eve. ('ebahee malaamaath libeymeehun) mikanbalunnashvure heyokamuga'i ('ebahee malaamaathkuraa meehunnashvure heyokamuga'i) vedhaane'eve. 'adhi kaleymen 'e'bayaku 'ane'bayakash `aybu nukiyaasheve. 'adhi kaleymen 'e'bayaku 'ane'bayakash huthuru lagabu nukiyaasheve. huthuru vanan nukiyaasheve. 'e'ee faasiqu kamekeve. 'eemaankamashfahu fasiqu nuba'i nanki'un nuba'ivegenve'eve. 'adhi tha'ubaa nuve'jebayaku dhanna'e! fahe kanda'eLigen 'emeehun 'e'ee 'aniyaaverinneve.

'ey'eemaanve'je meesthakunneyve! ginaheekurunthakun kaleymen dhuruvegannaasheve! hamakashavarun ba'e'hee 'e'ee faafa'ekeve. 'adhi kaleymen jaasoosu nukuraasheve! 'adhi kaleymen 'e'bayaku 'ane'bayakash Giyba nukiyaasheve! (meehaanethis 'eynaa nuruheyvaahaka) nudha'kaasheve! kaleymenkure 'ekakuves thimaage 'akhugemas 'eynaa maruvefa'ivanikosh / muLavefa'ivaa hhaalu ke'umash loabikuramuhe'yeve? fahe kaleymen 'ekamash nuruheyne'eve. (meehaa neththaaga'i 'eynaa nuruhey vaahaka dhe'kumekey 'emeehaamaruvefa'ivanikosh 'eynaa gemaske'umekey 'e'fadha'eve.) 'adhi kaleymen llh 'ash biruvethivaasheve! hamakashavarun llh ta`al~ 'ee ginagina'in tha'ubaala'vaa raHma@ le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaange'eve.

'eymeesthakunneyve! hamakashavarun firihenakaa'i 'anhene'ge faraathun (adam `alayhi lsWalam) 'aa'i sitWuna HawWa~ gefaanunge faraathpuLun thimanraskalaange kaleymen he'dheveemeve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange kaleymen jama`a@ jama`a@ 'ashaa'i qibiyla@ qibiyla@ 'ash le'veemeve. 'e'i kaleymen ('ekaku'anekaku) dhenegathumash taka'eve. hamakashavarun kaleymenkure ge HaDra@u ga'i 'enme maathmeehakee kaleymenkure 'enme taqwa~ verimeehaa'eve. hamakashavarun llh 'ee dhenevodigenvaa khbr kura'vaa kalaange'eve.

'adhi '`rabi~ ngemeehun bunnyeve. 'ahuremen 'eemaan ve'ja'eemeve. ('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanuvidhaaLuvaasheve! 'adhi kaleymenge hiththakakash 'eemaane'nuve'eve. 'adhi'ehennaves 'ahuremen 'islaamu ve'ja'eemeve. mihen kaleymen bunaasheve. 'adhi mihaathanash kaleymenge hiththakakash 'eemaankan nuvdhe'eve. 'adhi kaleymen llh 'aa'i 'ekalaange rasoolaa'ash kiyamantherive'je'yaa kaleymenge `amaluge dharuma'in 'e'ves 'e'che' kaleymennash 'uninuvaane'eve. hamakashavarun llh 'ee ginagina'in faafa fu'savaa raHma@ le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaange'eve.

mu'uminunkamuga'i vaakan kashavaree 'emeehun llh 'aa'i 'ekalaange rasoolaa'ash 'eemaanveemeehunneve. dhen'emeehun sha'ku nukuraa meehunneve. dhen 'adhi 'emeehunge mudhalaa'i 'emeehunge nafusuthakun gemaguga'i 'emeehun jihaadhukoshhedhi meehunneve. kanda'eLigen 'emeehun'e'ee thedhuvereenneve.

('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanuvidhaaLuvaasheve! kaleymen llh 'ash kaleymenge dheen 'uganna'i dhenee he'yeve? 'adhi 'uduthakaa'i 'adhi bimuga'i vaahaa thakethi llh dhenevodigenve'eve. 'adhi llh hurihaa'e'che' dhenevodigenve'eve.

('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) 'emeehun 'islaamu vun 'e'ee 'emeehun kaleygefaanash koshdhin heyokame'kamuga'i 'emeehun dhekeneehe'yeve? ('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanuvidhaaLuvaasheve. kaleymen kaleymenge 'islaavun 'e'ee thimankaleygefaanash koshdhin heyokame'kamuga'i kaleymen nudhekeysheve. 'adhiki'e'he'yeve? llh kaleymennash 'eemaankamash thedhumagu dhe'kevun 'e'ee 'ekalaange kaleymengema'chash dharumavanthave vodigennevumeve. ('e'ee 'ekalaange kaleymenash koshdhe'vi heyokamekeve.) kaleymennakee thedhuverin kamuga'ivannyaa (kaleymen 'egoth qaboolukuraasheve.)
hamakashavarun 'uduthakaa'i bimuga'ivaa Gyb (nufennathakethi) llh dhenevodigenve'eve. 'adhi kaleymenkuraakanthakash llh ba'lavaavodigenve'eve.

q: mi'akurugemaana'e' 'adhi muraadhe' moLashdhenevodigenvanee hama llh 'eve. maathvegenvaa mi quran gandhe'va'i thimanraskalaange huva'i waHiy kura'va'eve. (hamakashavarun muHamWdu gefaanakee 'amaanaaththeri vegenvaa rasoolu beykalekeve. nuvatha kaleymen maruvumashfahu maHsharu 'ash fonuveynekamee kashavarukamekeve. midhegothash mihuva'ige javaabu mufa'sirun bayaankura'va'eve.)

'adhiki'e' he'yeve. 'emeehun 'ebahee ma'kaage mushrikun 'e `ajaa'ibuvee 'emeehunge gaathash 'emeehungethere'in 'inzaarukura'vaa beykalaku vada'igathumunneve. 'ebeykalakee muHamWdu gefaaneve. 'ekaafarunbunee 'e'ee bodu `ajaa'ibe'kamasheve. ('ekaleygefaanu 'edha'kavaa vaahaka'e'ee `ajay'ibu vaahaka'ekeve.)
'aLefahe 'ahuremen maruvumashfahu 'adhi 'ahuremen ve'yashvumashfahuga'i 'alun 'ahuremen dhirigen 'annaane he'yeve? 'e'ee dhuruvegenvaa rujuw`a vumekeve.

dhenfahe kaafarunge 'ebahuge javaa llh 'edhe'vanee mifadha'inneve. hamakashavarun 'emeehunge kiba'in bingandu madhukuraathakethi 'ebahee 'emeehunge hashithakun veeraanaavegendhaavaraa feevedhaavaru thimanraskalaange dhenevodigenve'eve. 'adhi thiman raskalaange HaDra@u ga'i 'ehurikame' noatu kura'va'i ra'kaatheri kura'vaafa'ivaa fothe' ve'eve.

'adhi ki'e'he'yeve? 'emeehunge gaathash HaqWu 'a'ihidhun 'emeehun HaqWu dhogukuree 'eve. ('ebahee 'emeehunge gaathash HaqWu kamuga'ivaa quran 'a'ihidhun 'emeehun 'e'ves fikure'belume'nethi dhogukuree'eve.) fahe 'emeehunvanee 'e quran 'aa'i medhu 'ekathi 'aneke'chash ma'suni kurevigenvaa 'oLun boLume'ge thereyga'eve. ('e'bayaku bunee 'e'ee sihhure'kamasheve. 'ane'bayakubunee 'isvedhiyameehunge dhoguvaahakathake'kamasheve. 'adhi 'ane'bayakubunee 'e'ee kahaanathe'kamasheve. dhenmihengos thafaathu 'etha'vaahaka'ekeve.)

'emeehunge matheega'ivaa 'udash 'emeehunfahe nubalanee he'yeve? thimanraskalaange 'e'udu ha'dhavaafa'i vanee konfadha'akunkan 'adhi thimanraskalaange 'e'udu zeenaththeri kura'vaafa'ivanee kihine'kamaa'i medhu 'emeehun visnaa nuhadhanee baava'eve? 'adhi 'e'akash 'e'ves redhe' / feLume' nuve'eve. baakoLe' nuve'eve.

'adhi bingandu (dhanna'eve.) 'ebingandu thimanraskalaange dhanmavaa fethuru'veemeve. 'adhi thiman raskalaange 'eyga'i farubadhatha' le'veemeve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange 'eyga'i rivethi 'adhi furihama konmebaavathakunves joadu joadu ge fathpilaaveli feLu'veemeve.
'ekantha'tha' 'ehen 'ele'vee llh 'ash tha'ubaave rujoo`avaa konme 'aLaku visnaa fikurukosh 'adhi wa`Zu naSinyHa@ libigathumashtaka'eve.
'adhi thimanraskalaange 'udun = barakaaththeri fene' ve'seveemeve. 'efenun bageechaathakaa'i 'adhi govaamuge gothuga'i kedevey 'o'taruves thimanraskalaange faLu'vameve.
'adhi meyvaa 'aLaa dhigu kadhuru ru'thakaa'i 'ekathima'chash 'anekathi 'araa furibaaruvefa'ivaa meyvaage 'e'tha' 'e'ashvaa 'eru'tha' thimanraskalaange 'efenun feLu'veemeve.

'e'ee 'aLuthakunnashvaa rizuge'ge gothunneve. 'adhi 'efenun maruve hanafasvefa'ivaa rash rash thimanraskalaange dhiru'vameve. meesthakun nukuthunvanee 'efadha'inneve. ('ebahee maHsharu 'ash dhi'umashtaka'i kashvaLuthakunmeesthakun nukunnaanee vaareyvehuneemaa bimungastha' faLa'igen nukumegannagothasheve. 'efadha'inneve.
dhanna'eve. 'udu 'e'ves thanbakaa'inula'i 'ufu'lava'i 'ehaareethikosh varugadhakosh zeenaththerikosh ha'dhava'i 'adhi bingandu fathuru'va'i thanavaskura'va'i gasgahaageheege ni`umathunfuru'va'i mathinvaarey ve'sava'i 'adhiminoonves mibodu kaa'inaathugege 'enmeha'i thakethi ha'dhava'i mifurihama nizaamugemathin hingavaa kalakash meesthakun maruvumashfahu dhevanafaharash dhiru'vaa maHsharu kure'vun 'e'vesgothakun dhathinuvaaneykan konme salaamath bu'dhi'kash 'engeyne'eve.
'adhi 'emeehungekureega'i 'ebahee quraysh ngekureega'i nuwHu `alyhi lslm ge qa'umugemeehun 'adhi'ukhduwdu 'eve ki'unu vaLugaduge 'ekuverinnaa'i 'adhi SaliHu `alyhi lslm ge qa'umugemeehunnaa'i,
'adhi `ad baaga'ige meehunnaa'i 'adhi fir`awn 'aa'i 'adhi luwT gefaanunge 'akhu nves (rasoolun dhogukuri'eve.)

'adhi 'yk@ 'eveki'unu rashugemeehunnaa'i ('e'ee shu`aybu `alyhi lslm fonu'vunu qa'umekeve.) 'adhi tbW` ge meehunnaa'i mihurihaameehun rasoolun dhogukuree 'eve. dhen fahe 'emeehunnash koafaa'aa'i biruverikamuge basfuLu HaqWu vee'eve. dhanna'eve. tubWa`u 'akee yamanu kara'ige qabiyla@ 'ekeve.

'aLefahe furathama he'dhevumash thimanraskalaange varubaliveehe'yeve? nuvatha nukuLedhivodigen nevee he'yeve? 'adhi ki'e'he'yeve? 'ehennooneve. 'emeehun 'evanee dhevanafaharash he'dhevumaa'imedhu 'oLume'ge thereyga'eve.

'adhi hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange 'insaanaa he'dheveemeve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange dhenevodigen vameve. 'eynaage nafusugethere'ash vadhenukumevaa 'enmeha'i khiyaaluthakaa'i kantha'thake' 'adhi thimanraskalaange 'eynaage kandhuraaga'ivaa naarashvureves 'eynaayaa'i gaathvegenve'eve.
dhemalaa'ikathbeykalun 'eynaayaa'i ba'dhalukuraahindhu (handhumafuLu kura'vaasheve.) 'edhebeykalun 'eynaage kanaathfaraathaa'i va'athfaraathun 'isheedhevada'igen / 'inthizaaruga'i thi'bavaane'eve.
'eynaabunaa bahugethere'in 'e' lafZu 'e'ves raqiybun 'aa'i `atiyd 'eve ki'unu dhemalaa'ikathbeykalun nuli'u'va'idhoonukura'va'eve.
'adhi maruge 'udhagootha' (maruge sakaraath) 'eynaa'ash hama HaqWu gothuga'i 'annahu'teve. ('eynaa'ash 'engeveyne'eve.) 'e'ee ('emarakee) kaley 'eyaa'idhurash dhiya'e'cheve.
'adhi thaaLafifumelevi'je'yaa'i dhen 'e'ee wa`iydu ge dhuvaheve. (koafaa'aa'i `adhabu ge dhuvaheve.)
'adhi konme nafuse' 'anna'iru 'enafusakaa'i 'eku 'eynaa maHsharu 'ash gendhaane beykalakaa'i hekidhe'vaaney beykalakaa'i vaahu'teve.

('ey 'insaanaa'eve.) hamakashavarun kaley dhuniyeyga'i 'uLunu'iru mikamaa'imedhu 'ebahee maHsharu kure'vumaa'i medhu Gafilu vegen veemu'eve. dhenfahe thimanraskalaange kaleyniva'i koshfa'ivaa huras nangavaa kashfu kure'veemeve. fahemi'adhu kaleyge dheloa thooneve. (hurihaa 'e'che' saafukosh fennaane'eve.)

'adhi 'eynaage qariynu ('eynaayaa'i havaaluvefa'ivaa malaa'ikathaa) vidhaaLuvaane'eve. mi'ee mi'aLaa'aa'i 'ekuvaathake'cheve. ('e'ee 'e'insaanaa'aa'i 'eynaage `amalugefatheve.) HaDiru vegenmivanee'eve.
('e dhemalaa'ikathbeykalunnash 'angavaane'eve.) kaafaruvunbodu nukiyamantheri / 'aniyaaveri konme meehe' naraka'ash 'e'la'ilaasheve.
heyokantha'manaakurunbodu 'e'ka'uvanthakan qaboolu nukuraa HaqWu kankamash sha'ku kuraa konmemeehekeve. naraka'ash 'e'la'ilaasheve.
'eynaa llh 'aa'i 'eku 'ehen 'ilaahe' la'i hamaja'saa shareeku kuree'eve. 'ehenve thiya'ige dhemalaa'ikathun 'eynaa gadhavegenvaa `azaabash 'e'la'ilaasheve.

'eynaage qariynu 'ebahee ('eynaayaa'i guLifa'ivaa shayTanu 'aa) dhannavaane'eve. 'ey'aLamenge rabWu 'eve. mi'aLaa 'eynaa magu nufura'dhameve. 'adhi'ehennamaves 'eynaavee dhuruvegenvaa magufuredhume'ga'eve.
kaleymen thimanraskalaange HaDra@u ga'i 'ara'irun nuvaasheve. hamakashavarun thiman raskalaange kaleymenash 'isve ninmavaafa 'ivanee wa`iydu 'eve. 'ebahee koafaa'aa'i `adhabu 'eve.
thimanraskalaange HaDra@u ga'i basbadhalu nuveveyhu'teve. 'adhi thiman raskalaange'ee 'aLuthakunnash 'aniyaa kura'vaa kalaku kamuga'i nuve'eve.

naraka'ash thiman raskalaange waHiy kura'vaa dhuvas (handhumafuLu kura'vaasheve.) waHiy kura'vaa husheemeve. thibaa furi'je he'yeve? 'adhi 'eythi dhannavaane'eve. 'adhi 'ithurash veythoa'eve? ('ithurash huri'yaa 'ithurashves dhe'vaasheve.)
'adhi taqwa~ verinnash taka'i dhurunoon hisaabakash suvaruge gaathkurevey hu'teve.

('adhi 'engeveyne'eve.) mi'ee ge HaDra@u 'ash tawba@ ve rujuw` vaa konme 'aLakash wa`du vevifa'ivaa thaneve. 'adhi 'emeehaku ge 'amufuLuthakash ra'kaatherive faafathakaa'i dhuruvegenvaa konmemeehekeve.
'adhi'emeehaku Gaybu ga'i vodigenvaa raHmnu vantha kalaange'sh biruvethi ve 'adhi salaamathvegenvaa hithakaa'igen 'emeehaku ge HaDra@u 'ash 'a'i meehunnasheve. ('emeehunnash 'engeveyne'eve.)
('emeehunnash 'engeveyne'eve.) salaamathkamaa'i 'eku kaleymen 'esuvaruge'ash kaleymen vannaasheve. 'adhi'e'ee maruvume'nethi dhemi thibeyney dhuvaheve.
'ethaaga'i 'emeehun 'edheyhaa 'e'che' 'emeehunnash hunna hu'teve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange HaDra@u ga'i 'ithurashve'eve. 'ithuru ni`umathatha've'eve.

'adhi 'emeehunge kurin (ma'kaage meehunge kurin) 'u'maththakuge there'in kitha'kitha' 'u'math thimanraskalaange halaaku kure'veen he'yeve? ('ebahee varash gina'in halaaku kure'veemeve.) 'emeehun mimeehunashvure baaruge gothun maagadhafadha'eve. fahe 'emeehun rash rashashdhathuru fathurukosh hoadhaa beli'eve. 'emeehunnash fahe ('ekalaange `azaabun) salaamathvaane thane'fenunubaava'eve? (nufennaane'eve.)

hamakashavarun 'ekankamuga'i (heyonuba'i vakikuran 'egey) hithe'vaa konme meehakash nuvatha 'eynaa hith HaDiru koshgenvaa hhaalu rangaLash kanula'i 'aha'ifi konmememeehakash kanda'eLigen `ibra@u 'aa'i wa`Zu naSiyHa@ ve'eve.
'adhi hamakashavarun 'uduthakaa'ibimaa'i 'adhi 'edhemedhuvaahaathake'chaa'i hadhuvahe'ge thereyga'i thimanraskalaange he'dheveemeve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange'ash 'e'ves varubalikame' nujehe'eve.

fahe 'emeehun 'ebunaa basthakash kaleygefaanu keththerive vada'i gannavaasheve. 'adhi 'iru 'erumuge kurinnaa'i 'adhi 'iru 'o'sumuge kurin kaleygefaanunge rabWu 'ash Hamdu kurumaa'i 'eku tasbiyHa vidhaaLuvaasheve.
'adhi reygaduge vaguthu ga'yaa'i sajidha kure'vumuge fahuga'yaa'i ves 'ekalaange'ash tasbiyHa vidhaaLuvaasheve.
'adhi dhaadhi gaath hisaabakun gova'ila'vaa kaleygefaanu gova'ila'vaa dhuvahuge 'adu 'a'savaasheve.

HaqWu gothuga'i thaaLafileege 'adu 'emeehun 'ahaadhuvas 'e'ee (kashvaLuthakun) nukunna dhuvaheve. ('e'ee qiyama@ dhuvahun meesthakun maHsharu ge ma'idhaanash jamaakure'vumashtaka'i srafiylu gefaanun gova'i la'vaa thaaLafili funmavaa le'vumeve.)
hamakashavarun thiman raskalaange thakethi dhiru'vaa maru'vameve. 'adhi 'ehurihaathakethi 'enburi 'a'unvanee hama thimanraskalaange HaDra@u 'asheve.

'emeehun fiyava'i 'avas'avahash bingandu faLa faLa'igendhaadhuvas (handhumafuLu kura'vaasheve.) 'e'ee meesthakun kashvaLu thakun nukumegen govaabeykale'ge govumash meesthakundhaane'eve. 'e'ee 'e'kure'vu masheve. maHsharu kure'vumasheve. 'e'ee thimanraskalaange'ash dhaadhi faseyhakamekeve.

'emeehun 'ebunaathakethi thimanraskalaange dhenevodigenve'eve. ('ebahee maruvumashfahu 'alundhiru'vumaa'i maHsharu kure'vumaa'i hisaabu be'levumaa'i dhenves 'ebaavathuge kantha'dhogu kuraameehun 'ebunaa thakethi thiman raskalaange 'a'savaavodigenve'eve. 'adhi kaleygefaanu 'emeehungema'chash gadhaha'dhavaa harukashi beykalaku kamuga'i vevada'i nugannava'eve. (kaleygefaanash 'othee hama 'i'va'idhinumeve.) fahe thimanraskalaange wa`iyd 'ash (koafaa'ash) biruvethivaa meehakash quranu n wa`Zu naSiyHa@ dhe'vaasheve.
ve'yaa'i, hirafuhaa'i, 'ebaavathuge lu'i thakethi buru'sa'ilaa va'i gandhe'va'i llh t`l~ huva'i wHiy kura'va'eve.
'adhi fenun baruvegenvaa vilaatha' gandhe'va'i llh t`l~ huva'i wHiy kura'va'eve.
'adhi kandumatheega'i faseyhakamaa'eku dhuvefa'idhaa na'udhoagu ('uLandhu) gandhe'va'i llh t`l~ huva'i wHiy kura'va'eve.
'adhi 'ebeykalunge rabW ge 'mr fuLash rzq 'aa'i, vaareyaa'i, 'adhives thakethi kanda'eLifa'ivaa gothakash ba'savaa mly'k@ beykalun gandhe'va'i llh t`l~ huva'i wHiy kura'va'eve.

'ey meesthakunneyve. kaleymennash w`d vevigenvaa kankamakee hama thedhu w`d fuLu thakekeve 'ekeve. 'ebahee maruvumashfahu mHshr kure'vumaa'i, `ml thakash hisaabu be'levumaa'i, suvarugeyaa'i, 'ethaange n`m@ thakaa'i, naraka'aa'i, 'ethaange `dhb thakaa'i, mi hurihaa kankamakee hama kanda'eLigen seedhaakosh 'eyge vaguthuthakuga'i hunnaaney kankameve. 'e'ee hama kanda'eLigen thedhu vaahakathakeve.
'adhi hama kashavarun qym@ dhuvahun `dl veri jazaa dhe'vaaney kamee 'e'ves sha'ke'nethi kanda'eLigen 'onnaaney kamekeve.
'adhi dhuniyeyge binmatheega'i mi hunna kahala veleege maguge veri 'udu gandhe'va'i llh t`l~ wHiy kura'va'eve.

hama kashavarun kaleymen thiya vanee (mHmd gefaanaa medhu) kanda'eLigen thafaathu vaahakathake'ga'eve. kaleymenge thereyga'i mHmd gefaanakee sHr veri'ekey bunaa meehun ve'eve. 'adhi 'e'ee dhoguveriyekey bunaa meehun 'eba thi'beve. 'adhi 'e'ee khn 'ekey bunaa meehunves 'eba thi'beve. 'adhi qran 'akee sHr 'ekey nuvatha dhogu bTl vaahakathakekey nuvatha 'e'ee kahna@ 'ekey bunaa meehunves 'eba thi'beve. mihengos thafaathu vaahakathake'ga'eve.
