mihurihaa ni`umathakee 'emeehun dhuniyeyga'i thibi'iru koshfa'ivaa heyo `amaluthakuge jazaa'e'ge gothun 'e'vey dhe'vunthakeve.
'emeehun 'ethaaga'i 'e'ves baTilu vaahaka'e'viyas 'adhi faafaverivevey 'ade'viyas nu'ahaane'eve.
hama'ekani 'ekaku 'anekakash salaamu kuraa 'adumenuvee'eve.
kanaath faraathumeehunnakee konfadha maathba'e'he'yeve? (kana'athfaraathumeehunney 'othbasfuLuge muraadhakee 'emeehunge `amalugefath kanaathfaraathun libeymeehunneve.)
'emeehunvanee suvarugeyge furihama ni`umathuga'eve. kashineth kunnaaru gahuge meerukunnaaru libumuge ni`umathuga'eve.
'adhi thirinfasha'igen gofithakaa'ihama'ash meyvaa'aLaa baraavefa'ivaa TlH gasgahuge ni`ma@u ga'eve. (TlH gahakee gina mufa'sirun vidhaaLuvaagothuga'i dhonkeyluge baavathekeve.)
'adhi 'emeehunvanee dhemigenvaa hiyaluga'eve.
'adhi'emeehunvanee 'emeehunnashtaka'i 'abadhaa 'abadhu 'ohi'ohi hunnameerufenuge ni`ma@u ga'eve.
'adhi ginavegenvaa meerumeyvaathakuge ni`ma@u ga'eve.

'emeyvaa'ash kendidhi'ume'nuve'eve. 'adhi mana`a vume'nuve'eve. ('ebahee dhuniyeygemeyvaa'ashvagothash vakimoosumakash libifa'i 'ane'ba'imoosumash nulibeygothe'nuve'eve. 'adhi ki'e'he'yeve? dhaa'imeegothe'ga'i libeygothasheve.) 'adhi manaakuraanemeehaku nuve'eve.
'adhi'emeehunvanee 'ufuligenvaa dhaanmathikoLuthakuga'i rivethivegenvaa maath 'anhenunnaa'i 'ekuga'eve.

'adhi hamakashavarun 'ekanbalun thimanraskalaange ha'dhavaafa'ivaanee 'aahe'dhevumakunneve. (mithaamisifavaa 'anhenunnakee dhuniyeyga'i 'uLunu 'anhenunkure suvaruge vanumuge naseebulibunu meehunkamuga'i bunevuneve.)
'adhi thimanraskalaange suvaruge'ashtaka'i 'ekanbalun bikuruverinkamuga'i le'veemeve.

'adhi firindheke loabivaagothash 'adhi firinves 'ekanbalundheke loabivaagothash 'e' `umure'ge nuvatha 'e' 'khlaqu 'e'ge bayaku kamuga'i le'veemeve. (ba'e' mufasWiru n vidhaaLuve'eve. 'emeehunge `umurakee 'ahareve. = bn kathiyr =)
'isvedhiya gina ni`mi@ thakakee kanaathfaraathuge 'ekuverinnashtaka'i huri ni`mi@ thakekeve.
'e'ee 'isvedhiya 'u'maththakugethere'in ba'ekeve.
'adhi fahuge 'u'mathugethere'inba'ekeve.
'adhi va'athfaraathuge 'ekuverin (dhanna'eve.) va'athfaraathuge 'ekuverinnakee konfadha nuba'i ba'e'he'yeve?
'emeehunvanee naraka'ige hoonugadha vihadhumaa'i 'enmegadha hoonufenuge `adhabu ge rahalibi libi'eve.
'adhi naraka'ige hoonugadha 'adhi finikame'neth dhumuge hiyaluga'eve.
'eyga'i 'e'ves finikame'neth 'adhi 'e'ves 'araame'viyasnuvaa ne'eve.
hamakashavarun 'emeehun vee 'eygekurin ('ebahee dhuniyeyga'i 'uLunu'iru) = Halalu noonthaketheen majaakosh hadhaakamuga'eve.
'adhi 'emeehunvee 'enmebodufaafakurunmathee 'ebahee (shiruku kunmathee) dhemithibeybayaku kamuga 'eve.
'adhi 'emeehun bunaakamuga'i vee 'ahuremen maruve'je'yaa 'adhi 'ahuremen ve'yashve 'adhi kashitha'ves feeve ve'yashvumashfahu 'ahuremen dhirige fonuveyneyhe'yeve?
'adhi 'ahuremenge 'isvedhiya kaabafa'inves fonuveyneyhe'yeve?
('ey rasuwl llh 'eve!) kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve! hanmakashavarun 'isvedhiyahaabayaku 'adhi fahun'a'ihaabayakuvesme'eve.
kanda'eLi 'egigenvaa vakidhuvahe'ge vakivaguthakash kashavarunves 'e'kureveyhu'teve. 'e'ee qiyaamath dhuvaheve.
dhenhamakashavarun kaleymen 'eymithiba dhoguveri madhufuredhunu meehunneyve!
hamakashavarun kaleymen zaqWuwm gahakun kaane'eve. ('e'ee naraka'iga'eve.)
'adhi 'e'inkaleymen kaleymenge bandutha' furaane'eve.
'adhi 'emeehun 'eygema'chash 'enmegadhahoonu fen boane'eve.
fenbovaa balijehifa'ivaa jamaluboavarash 'emeehun 'eythiboane'eve.
mi'ee hisaabu ba'lavaadhuvahun 'emeehunnashvaa mehumaandhaaree'eve.
kaleymen he'dhevee thimanraskalaange'eve. kaleymen 'ekan thedhukuraanenama'eve. kaleymen 'ekan thedhunukuranee keethvehe'yeve?
kaleymen thiyabeyrukuraa mannyaa'i beheygothun kaleymen nikan khabarudheebalaasheve. (dhekibalaasheve.)
'e'in (makhluwqu 'aku) ha'dhavanee kaleymenhe'yeve? nuvatha 'eha'dhavaa kalakee thimanraskalaange he'yeve?

, thimanraskalaange kaleymengemedhuga'i maru (maruvun) minvarukure'veemeve. 'adhi kaleymenge sooratha' badhalukura'va'i 'adhi kaleymenash neygey soorathakakash thimanraskalaange kaleymen 'ufe'dhevumash nukuLedhivodigenvaa kalakukamuga'i thimanraskalaange nuve'eve.

, thimanraskalaange kaleymengemedhuga'i maru (maruvun) minvarukure'veemeve. 'adhi kaleymenge sooratha' badhalukura'va'i 'adhi kaleymenash neygey soorathakakash thimanraskalaange kaleymen 'ufe'dhevumash nukuLedhivodigenvaa kalakukamuga'i thimanraskalaange nuve'eve.
'adhi hamakashavarun kaleymenge furathama he'dhevun kaleymennash 'engeyne'eve. fahe kaleymen `ibra@ libi nugannanee kee'vegen he'yeve?
kaleymen ('osh 'indha'igen) thiyakuraa dhaduverikamaa'imedhu kaleymen nikan khabarudheebalaasheve. (kaleymennikan dhekibalaasheve.)
'e'osh faLuvaaha'dhavanee kaleymen he'yeve? nuvatha 'e'osh faLuvaa gasha'dhavanee thimanraskalaange he'yeve?

thimanraskalaange 'edhivodigannavaanama hamakashavarun halaakuve kudhikudhive beynun nukurevey kundithakakash thimanraskalaange 'eha'dhavaafa'ihusheemeve. dhen 'eyrun kaleymen `ajay'ibu vegen bunaane'eve.
hamakashavarun 'e'ves 'e'che' nulibi 'ahuremennash ge'lunvee'eve.
'adhi ki'e'he'yeve. 'ahuremenmivanee ('edhaduge barakaathun) maHruwmu vegenneve.
kaleymen thiyaboafenaa'imedhu kaleymen nikan nikan khabarudheebalaasheve. (dhekibalaasheve.)
vilaagadun 'efen ve'savanee kaleymen he'yeve. nuvatha 'eve'saakalakee thimanraskalaange he'yeve?
thimanraskalaange 'edhivodi gannavaanama gadhalonu fene'kamuga'i 'efen thimanraskalaange la'va'ifeeheve. kaleymena fahe shukuru nukuraanehe'yeve?
kaleymen roakoshgen thiya'andhaa 'alifaanaa'imedhu kaleymen nikan khabarudheebalaasheve. (dhekibalaasheve.)
'egas'ufe'dhevee kaleymen he'yeve? nuvatha 'egas ha'dhavanee thimanraskalaange he'yeve?

(naraka'ige 'alifaanuge) handhaanakashaa'i 'adhi dhathuruverinnashaa'i dhuruhisaabuga'i
'uLeymeehunnash ves beynunkoshlevey 'e'che'kamuga'i thimanraskalaange 'e 'alifaan le'veemeve.
fahe kaleygefaanunge boduvegenvaa rabWu nanfuLun. kaleygefaanu tasbiyH vidhaaLuvaasheve!
fahe tharitha' 'o'sey thanthan gandhe'va'i thimanraskalaange huva'i waHiy kura'vameve.
'adhi hamakashavarun'e'ee kaleymennash 'engeynama'e'ee kanda'eLigen boduvegenvaa huva'ekeve.
hamakashavarun 'e'ee maathvegenvaa quran 'e'kan kashavareve.
ra'kaatherivegenvaa fothe'ga'ivaa (lawHu lmaHfuwZ ga'ivaa)
Tahiru vegenvaa beykalaku menuvee (malaa'ikath beykalakumenuvee) 'efothuga'i nubeehe'eve.
'e'ee `alamu thakugeveri rabWu ge HaDra@u n baavaathla'vaa baavaathle'vumekeve.
kaleymen 'aadha'ige 'e'che'kamuga'i bala'i dhogukuranee mivaahaka he'yeve? (mi quran he'yeve?)
'adhi kaleymen kaleymenge rizuquge shukurukuru n hamakashavarun kaleymen dhogukurume' kamuga'i lanee he'yeve? llh baavaathle'vi vaareyfen thari'ash nisbathkuranee'eve.
(maruvaameehaa) lagodivaLaa'i hama'ash furaana 'ara'je'yaa,
'adhikaleymen 'ehindhun 'eynaa'ash balaha'ta'igen thibeyne'eve.
'adhi thimanraskalaange 'eynaa'aa'i gaathkan bodeve. 'adhi 'ehene'kamaku kaleymennakash nufene'eve.
, fahe kaleymen maruvumashfahu hisaabuba'lavaanekamash 'e'basnuvannyaa kaleymen 'efuraana 'anburaa ra'dhukuraahushi kameve. kaleymennakee thedhuverinkamuga'ivannyaa'eve.
, fahe kaleymen maruvumashfahu hisaabuba'lavaanekamash 'e'basnuvannyaa kaleymen 'efuraana 'anburaa ra'dhukuraahushi kameve. kaleymennakee thedhuverinkamuga'ivannyaa'eve.
fahe 'eynaa 'ebahee (marash HDir vee meehaa) ku'thanvegenvaa meehungethere'in vannyaa.
fahe 'eynaa'ash huree dhuniyeyge 'udhagulun 'araamu libigathumaa'i 'adhi suvarugeyge rizuqeve. (nuvathameeruvasdhuvaa maamelaame'yeve.) 'adhi ni`m@ thakugeveri suvaruge'eve.
'adhi 'eynaakanaathfaraathuge 'ekuveringethere'in vannyaa (marash HDir vee meehaa kanaathfaraathuge 'ekuveringe there'invannyaa 'eynaa'ash buneveyne'eve.)
kanaathfaraathuge 'ekuveringefaraathun. fahekale'ash salaamu hu'teve. ('eynaa'ash 'engeyne'eve.)
'adhi 'emeehaa dhoguveri magufuredhunumeehungethere'in vannyaa dhanna'eve.
fahe 'eynaaha'ashhunnahushee 'enme hoonufenuge mehumaandhaaree kameve.
'adhi naraka'ige 'alifaanuga'i 'endhumeve.
hamakashavarun mi'ee kanda'eLigen yaqeenunves HaqWu 'eve.
fahe ha'iba boduvegenvaa kaleygefaanunge rabWu nanfuLun kaleygefaanu tasbiyH vidhaaLuvaasheve!
'uduthakaa'i bimuga'i vaahaathakethi llh 'ash tasbiyHa kiya'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange'ee gadhafadhavanthavevodigenvaa 'adhi Hikma@ vanthavevodigenvaakalaange'eve.

'uduthakaa'i bimuga'ivaahaathakethi 'ekalaange'ash khaSWa vegenve'eve. 'ekalaange thakethi dhiru'vaa maru'va'eve. 'adhi konme kame'ge ma'chash 'ekalaange kuLadhunvanthave vodigenvaa kalaku kamuga'ive'eve.

'ekalaange'ee 'enmefurathama'eve. 'ekalaange'ashvurekurin 'eka'che'ves nuve'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange'ee 'enmefaheve. 'ekalaange'ashvure fahun 'eka'che'ves nuvaane'eve. 'adhi 'e'ee hurihaa 'e'che'gemathee vodigenvaa kalaange'eve. (nuvatha dhaleeluthakaa'i HuHWa@ thakun 'ekalaange vodigenvaakan fa'uLuvegenvaa kalaange'eve.) 'adhi 'e'ee 'enme 'adeega'ivaahaathakethives dhenevodigenvaa kalaange'eve. 'adhi 'e'ee hurihaa 'e'che' dhenevodigenvaa kalaange'eve.

hadhuvahe'gethereyga'i 'uduthakaa'i binhe'dhevee hama'ekalaange'eve. dhen'ekalaange `arsh'ash stawa~ vevodigennevi'eve. 'ekalaange dhenevodigenve'eve. bimugethere'ashvannahaathake'chaa'i 'adhi 'ethanun nukunnahaa thake'chaa'i 'adhi 'udun fa'ibaa thake'chaa'i 'adhi 'e'udash 'ara'igendhaahurihaathake'chaa'i mihurihaathakethi 'ekalaange dhenevodigenve'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange (dhenevodigathumaa'i kuLadhunvanthakan) vanee kaleymenvee konmethane'ga'i kaleymennaa'i 'ekuga'eve. 'adhi llh kaleymen kuraahaakamakash llh ba'lavaa vodigenve'eve.
'uduthakaabimuge muLi milku khaSWa vegen vanee 'ekalaange'asheve. 'adhi 'enmeha'i kantha'tha' 'enburi 'a'unvanee hama ge HaDr@u 'asheve.

'ekalaange dhuvaaluge there'ash reygandu va'dhava'eve. 'adhi reygandugethere'ash dhuvaalu va'dhava'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange'ee hiththakuge 'ethereyga'i vaahaathakethives dhenevodigenvaa kalaange'eve. (Damiyru thakuga'i vanhanaavefa'ivaa 'enmeha'i thakethives 'ekalaange dhenevodigenve'eve.)

kaleymen llh 'ashaa'i 'ekalaange rasoolaa'ash 'eemaanvaasheve. 'adhi kaleymen nash 'ekalaange la'vaafa'ivaa 'ethaketheega'i kaleymen taSarWufu kurumash khaliyfa@ veri kuruvaafa'ivaa 'e thaketheen kaleymen heydhakuraasheve. kaleymengethere'in 'eemaan ve 'adhi 'emeehun (llh 'engevifadha'in) heydhakuri meehun dhanna'eve. 'emeehunnash huree boduvegenvaa dharuma'eve.

'adhi kaleymen llh 'ash 'eemaan nuvaanvee kee'vegen he'yeve? konkamakaahedhihe'yeve? 'adhi kaleymenkaleymenge rabWu 'ash 'eemaanvumash rasoolaa kaleymenash gova'ila'vanee'eve. 'adhi hamakashavarun 'ekalaange vanee kaleymenge `ahdu kashavaru hi'pavaafa'eve. kaleymennakee mu'uminun kamuga'i vannyaa ('ekamash samaaluvun hu'teve.)

bayaanvegenvaa 'aayaththa' 'ekalaange 'aLaagema'chash baavaathla'vanee hama 'ekalaange'eve. 'e'ee (jaahilukamaa'i shirukuge) 'adhireegethere'in 'ekalaange kaleymen neru'vuma'taka yaa'i 'adhi ('eemaankamaa'i `ilmuge) 'alikamuge there'ash kaleymen ve'dhumasheve. 'adhi hamakashavarun llh ta`al~'ee kaleymennaa'imedhu nuhanu 'oagaavantha 'adhi raHma@ le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaangekan kashavareve.

('eymeesthakunneyve!) kaleymenge 'athuga'ivaa mudhalun gemaguga'i kaleymen heydha nukuraanvee kee'vegen he'yeve? ('e'ee kaleymen taSarWufu kurumash llh kaleymenash dhe'vaafa'ivaa 'ekalaange mudhaleve.) 'adhi 'uduthakaa'i binthakuge muLi vaarutha milkuve khaSWa vegenvanee hama 'ekaange'asheve. 'e'ee 'enmeha'i khalqu thakun maruvumashfahuves 'uduthakaa'i binthakaa'i 'adhi 'edhemedhuga'i vaahaathakethee vaarutha milkuvegenvaanee ves hama'ekani 'ekalaange'asheve. maruvegen dhaa'iru 'ekakuves 'e'ves mudhale' nugendhaane'eve. dhenfahe ma'kaa fataHa vumugekurin kaleymenkure ge maguga'i mudhaaheydhakosh hanguraamakurimeehunnaa'i ma'kaa fataHa vumuge fahun ge maguga'i mudhaaheydhakosh hanguraamakurimeehunnaa'i midheba'imeehun maathkamaa'i dharaja'igegothun hamahamavegen nuve'eve. ma'kaa fataHa vumugekurin kaleymenkure ge maguga'i mudhaaheydhakosh hanguraamakurimeehunge dharaja maaboduvegenve'eve. 'ekamaku 'edheba'imeehunkure konmebayakashves llWahu wa`du kura'vaafa'ivanee heyodharuma'eve. suvaruge'eve. 'adhi llWahu ta`al~ 'ee kaleymen kuraa hurihaakame'ge khabaru dhenevodigenvaa kalaange'eve. ('adhi 'ekamuge khabaru 'ekalaange kaleymenash dhe'vaane'eve.)

rivethivegenvaa rangaLu dharannyakun llWahu 'ash dharannyashdheynee kaleymenkure kaakuhe'yeve? 'e'ee'emeehakash 'ekalaange ginakosh dhe'vumash taka'eve. 'adhi 'emeehakash maath vegenvaa 'ujoora / suvaruge hunnahu'teve.

mu'uminu firihenunnaa'i mu'uminu 'anhenun 'emeehunge kurimathinnaa'i 'adhi'emeehunge kanaathfaraathun 'emeehunge noorudhaathee / 'alikuraathee kaleygefaanu dhekevada'igannavaadhuvas (handhumafuLu kura'vaasheve!). ('emeehunnash buneveyne'eve.) kaleymennash mi'adhu 'ufaaverikan hu'teve. 'e'ee 'ethanthaagedhashun 'aarutha'dhemey suvarugethakeve. 'emeehun 'ethaa dhemeethibeyhu'teve. boduvegenvaa naseebakee 'e'ee 'eve. 'e'ee qiyaamath dhuvaheve.

munafiqu firihenunnaa'i munafiqu 'anhenun 'eemaanvee meehunnaa'i dhimaa'ash bunaadhuvas (handhumafuLu kura'vaasheve!) 'emeehun bunaane'eve. kaleymenge 'alikamun 'ahuremenves ba'e' libigathumash kaleymen 'ahuremennash ntiZaru kosh la'vaasheve! 'ehindhun ('emeehunnash) buneveyne'eve. kaleymen kaleymenge fahathash 'enburidhaasheve. dhen 'ethanun kaleymen 'alikame' libigannaasheve. dhenfahe 'edheba'imeehunge dhemedhuga'i 'efaaruga'i dhore'vaa faare' (hurahe') levidhaane'eve. 'efaaruge 'etherefaraathuga'i raHmi@ vaa 'adhi 'eyge beyrufaraathuga'i 'eyaa'i jehigen `dhabu vaafaarekeve.

'emeehun mimeehunnash govaane'eve. ('ebahee munaafiqun mu'uminunnash govaane'eve.) 'adhibunaane'eve. (dhuniyeyga'i) 'ahuremen kaleymennaa'i 'eku nuvamuhe'yeve? 'ebahee 'ahuremenves kaleymennaa'i'eku mu'uminunnash vegen'uLuneemeve. 'emeehun ('ebahee mu'uminun) bunaane'eve. 'aa'ekeve. thiya'ee thedhekeve. kaleymen 'ahuremennaa'i 'eku 'uLuneemu'eve. 'adhi 'ehene'kamaku kaleymen kaleymenge nafusutha' fithunaveri kuree'eve. halaaku kuree'eve. 'adhi kaleymen (muHmd faanashaa'i mu'uminunnash) nuba'igoththa' dhimaavumash ntiZaru kuree'eve. 'adhi kaleymen dheenaa'imedhu sha'ku kuree'eve. 'adhi nuba'i 'u'meedhuthakaa'i 'edhuntha' kaleymen he'luntheri kuruvee'eve. 'e'ee ge 'amurufuLu 'annaadhen 'ebahee maru 'athuve'ja'umashdhaadheneve. 'adhi 'aa'imedhu shayTanu kaleymen he'luntheri kuruvee'eve.

dhenfahe mi'adhu kaleymengekiba'in 'e'vesfidhuya'e' nuhifeveyne'eve. qaboolu nuveveyne'eve. 'adhikaafarunge 'athunviyas (qaboolu nuveveyne'eve.) kaleymenge jaagayakeenaraka'eve. kaleymenge saharoaveri'akee 'e'ee'eve. nuvatha kaleymenash'a'ulaavegenvanee 'ethaneve. 'e'eevaa gosthibun nuba'ivegenvaa thanekeve.

'aLefahe 'eemaanvee meesthakunnash 'emeehunge hiththa' llh handhaankurumash ( ge zikurumash biruvethive ma'ithirivaan) gaathvegen nuvey he'yeve? 'adhi meegekurin fothdhevunumeehun fadha'in (yahuwdiy nnaa'i naSara~ 'infadha'in) mimeehun (muHamWd gefaanash 'eemaanveemeehun) nuvaahushikameve! fahe 'emeehungema'chash (yahuwdiy nnaa'i naSara~ 'ingema'chash) dhuvastha' dhiguvee'eve. dhen fahe 'emeehunge hiththa' harukashivee'eve. 'adhi 'emeehunkure ginameehunvee faasiqunkamuga'eve. ( ge kiyamanun nukuthbayaku kamuga'eve.)

kaleymen dhannaasheve. bingandu maruvefa'i 'othumashfahu hamakashavarun llh ta`al~ 'ebingandudhiru'va'eve. kaleymen bu'dhikosh fikuru kureythoa hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange kaleymennash 'aayaththa' bayaakosh dhe'va'ifeemeve.
dhanna'eve. bingandumaruvefa'i 'o'vaa 'ebingandu dhiru'va'i gastha'faLu'va'i thaazaakoshle'vi kalakash meesthakun maruvumashfahu 'emeehun dhevanafaharash dhiru'va'i fonu'vumash dhathinuvaanekan salaamathbu'dhihuri konmemeehakash 'engeyne'eve.

hamakashavarun Sadaqa@ kosh heydhakuraa firihenunnaa'i 'adhi Sadaqa@ kosh heydhakuraa 'anhenun 'adhi 'emeehun rangaLuvegenvaa dharannyakun llh 'ash dharanidhee hedhi meehun dhanna'eve. 'emeehunnash 'etha'guna'akash thawabu 'ithuru kureveyne'eve. 'adhi 'emeehunnash hunnahuree maathvegenvaa dharuma'eve.

'adhi llh 'ashaa'i 'ekalaange rasoolunnash 'eemaanvee meesthakun kanda'eLigen 'emeehun 'e'ee 'emeehunge rabWu ge HaDra@u ga'i SidWiyqu nnaa'i shaheedhunneve. 'emeehunnash 'emeehunge dharuma yaa'i 'adhi 'emeehunge nooraa'i / 'e'alikamaa'i hunnahu'teve. 'adhi kaafaruvee meesthakun 'adhi 'emeehun thimanraskalaange 'aayaththa' dhogukosh hedhimeehun dhanna'eve. 'emeehun 'e'ee naraka'ige 'ekuverinneve.

('eymeesthakunneyve!) kaleymen dhannaasheve! hamakashavarun dhuniyeyge Haya@ 'akee kuLivaraa'i akhira@ handhaanna'tha'ilaa zaathuge kantha'thakaa'i 'adhi zeenath therivungandekeve. 'adhi kaleymen 'e'bayaku 'ane'ba'e'ge ma'chash fakhru verivumakaa'i 'adhi 'ekaku 'anekakashvure mudhalaa'i dhareenun ginakurumaa'i 'eve. 'e'ee vaareyvilaagande'gemisaaleve. ('evilaagandun fenvehigen dhanduge gastha'hedhi fa'kaavegengos) dhanduverin 'eynaage dhanduge gasthakaa'imedhu `ajaa'ibu koshli vilaagandekeve. dhen 'egastha' 'ehenhurefaa hikigengos dhen dhonvefa'ivanikosh kaleydhekeyne'eve. dhen 'egastha' hikigengos kunithakakashvedhe'eve. 'adhi akhra@ ga'i gadhavegenvaa `azaabeve. 'adhi ge HaDra@u ga'ivaa faafafu'sevumaa'i 'adhi 'ekalaange ruhivodigathumaa'eve. 'adhi he'luntherikuruvaa kuda'araamukoLe'kamuga'i menuvee dhuniyeyge Haya@ nuve'eve.

kaleymenge rabWu HaDra@u nvaa faafa fu'sevumashaa'i 'adhi 'ethaage fuLaamin 'udaa'i bimuge fuLaa min fadha thanavas suvaru ge'ash kaleymen vaadhakoshfa'i dhaasheve. 'ethantha'yaaru kurevifa'ivanee llh 'aa'i 'ekalaange rasoolunnash 'eemaanvee meehunnasheve. 'e'ee ge faDlu vanthakameve. ('oagaavanthakameve.) 'ekalaange 'edhivodigennevi 'aLakash 'ekalaange 'ekandhe'va'eve. 'adhi llh 'ee boduvegenvaa faDlu vanthakamugeveri kalaange'eve. ('oagaavanthaka mugeveri kalaange'eve.)

bimuga'i viyas 'adhi kaleymenge nafusuthakuga'i viyas 'e'ves muSiyba@u 'e' 'e muSiyba@u 'e' je'sevumuge kurin fothe'ga'i liyevigenvaamenuvee (lawHu lmaHfuwZu ga'ivaamenuvee) nujehe'eve. ('ebahee konme kamakeeves 'ekalaange 'azalee dhenevodigathun niyaakuraagothugemathee lawHu lmaHfuwZu ga'i liyevi foLuvath dhemigenvaakan kameve.) hamakashavarun 'ekan 'e'ee ge HaDra@u 'ash dhaadhi faseyha kame'kamuga'i ve'eve.

'e'ee kaleymenge kiba'in vedhiya kanthakugema'chash kaleymen hithaama nukurumasheve. 'adhi 'ekalaange kaleymennash dhe'vithake'chash kaleymen 'ufaa ves nukuLa'umasheve. 'adhi bodaave fakhru verivaa 'e'ves meehakash llh loabive vodi nugannava'eve.

'adhi bakhiylu vaameehun 'adhi 'emeehun meesthakunnash bakhiylu vumash 'amuru kuraa meehun 'adhi (heydhanukosh) 'enburi furagasdheefimeehun dhanna'eve. mi'in 'e'vesmeehe'ge 'e'ves`amalakun ge HaDra@u 'ash 'e'ves ge'lume'netheve. mihenee hamakashavarun llh ta`ala~ 'ee 'ami'la zaathufuLaa'igen fudhivodigenvaa 'adhi Hamdu 'aa'i thaareefu libivodigenvaa kalaange'eve.

hamakashavarun thimanraskakalaange rasoolubeykalun bayaanvegenvaa dhaleeluthakaa'igen thimanraskakalaange fonu'veemeve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange 'ebeykalunnaa'i 'eku fothaa'i meezaan nuvatha `adlu verikan baavaathle'veemeve. 'e'ee meesthakun `adlu verikan qaa'imu kurumashtaka'eve. 'adhi thimanraskalaange dhagadu baavaathle'veemeve. 'eyga'i gadhafadha baaruve'eve. 'adhi meesthakunnashvaa fa'idhaave'eve. 'adhi 'e'ee Gaybu ga'i / nufeni 'ekalaange'ashaa'i 'ekalaange rasoolunnash naSru dhenee konba'e'kan llh dhenevodigenvaakan 'engevumashtaka'eve. hamakashavarun llh ta`ala~ 'ee gadhafadhavantha 'adhi `izWa@ vantha kalaange'eve.

'adhi hamakashavarun nuwHu `alayh lslm 'aa'i brahiym `alayh lslm thimaraskalaange fonu'veemeve. 'adhi 'edhebeykalunge dharifaskoLuga'i nabeekamaa'i 'adhi foth thimaraskalaange le'veemeve. fahe 'emeehunge thereyga'i thedhumagu libunu meehun ve'eve. 'adhi 'emeehunkure ginameehunnee faasiqunneve. ( ge kiyamanun nukuthmeehunneve.)

'ebeykalunge 'asaruthakuge ma'chash ('ebeykalunge fahash) dhen thiman raskalaange thiman raskalaange rasoolun vidhi vidhi gen taba`a kure'veemeve. (fonu'veemeve.) 'adhi mrym gefaanungedharikalun `iys~ `alayh lslm ves thiman raskalaange taba`a kure'veemeve. (fonu'veemeve.) 'adhi thimanraskalaange 'ekaleygefaanash njiylu dhe'veemeve.
'adhi 'ekaleygefaanash thabaaveemeehunge hiththakuga'i 'oagaaverikamaa'i rHma@ 'adhi rahbaniyWa@u (shahwa@ thakash biruvethivun) thimanraskalaange le'veemeve. 'emeehun 'ekan 'ebahee rahbaniyWa@u (shahwa@ thakash biruvethivun) 'ami'la'ash 'ufe'dhee 'eve. thimanraskalaange 'emeehungema'chash 'ekan farDu nukura'vameve. 'emeehun 'ekankuree ge ru'sevun libumash 'edhigenneve. fahe'emeehun 'ekamash faruvaatheri vun hha'quvaavarash faruvaatheri nuvi'eve. dhenfahe 'emeehungethere'in 'eemaanveemeesthakunnash 'emeehunge dharuma thimanraskalaange dhe'veemeve. 'adhi 'emeehunkure ginameehunvee faasiqunkamuga'eve.

'ey'eemaan ve'jemeesthakunneyve. kaleymen 'ash biruvethivaasheve. 'adhi kaleymen 'eemaanvaasheve. 'ekalaange rasoolaa'ash ('ebahee muHamWad SalW~ llh `alayhi wasalm 'ash) 'eemaanvaasheve. 'eyrun 'ekalaange kaleymenash 'ekalaange raHma@u n dheba'i dhe'vaane'eve. 'adhi 'eyge 'aleega'i kaleymen higaaney noore' 'ekalaange kaleymenash la'vaanetheve. 'adhi 'ekalaange kaleymenash fu'savaanetheve. 'adhi 'ee ginagina'in faafa fu'savaa raHma@u le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaange 'eve.

'adhi 'hlu kitabu n (yahuwdiy nnaa'i naSari~ 'in) 'emeehunnash ge faDlu vanthakamuge there'in 'e'ves kamakash / 'e'ves 'e'chakash kuLadhaanavegen nuvaakan 'emeehun dhenegathumashtaka'eve. (nuvatha dhenegathun hu'teve.) 'adhi hamakashavarun 'enmeha'i faDlu vantha verikanvanee ge 'athpuLuga'i kamaa'i 'ekalaange 'edhivodigannavaa'aLakash 'ekalaange 'edhe'vaanekan 'emeehun dhenegathun hu'teve. 'adhi 'ee boduvegenvaa faDlu vantha kamugeveri kalaange kan ves 'emeehun dhenegathun hu'teve.

('ey muHamWadu 'eve!) 'ekanbuleyge firikalunnaa'imedhu 'ashshakuvaa dhannavaa Hal kaleygefaanaa thakuraarukura'va'i basdhannavaa kamanaage bas hamakashavarun 'a'savodigenfi'eve. 'adhi thiya dhefaraathuge vaahaka 'a'sava'eve. hamakashavarun 'ee 'a'savaavodigannavaa 'adhi ba'lavaavodigenvaa kalaange'eve.

thiyaba'imeehunkure thimaamenge 'anbeen thimaamenge mayekey hamakuraa meehun (Ziharu kuraa meehun) dhanna'eve. ('ehen 'emeehun bunnyakas) 'e 'anhenun 'e'ee 'emeehunge ma'in kamuga'i nuve'eve. 'emeehunge ma'in kamuga'ivaakan kashavaree 'emeehun vihe'i 'anhenunneve. (Haqiyqiy ma'inneve.) 'adhi hamakashavarun 'emeehun 'ehen 'ebunaa bahakee (thimaage 'anbimeehaa thimaage mayekey 'e'fadha'ey) 'ebunaabahakee bahuge there'in shariy`a@ qabuwlu nukuraa hadi munkaru bahekeve. 'adhi 'e'ee hama bodu dhogekeve. 'adhi hamakashavarun 'ee kanda'eLigen ginagina'in `afuw kura'vaa 'adhi faafa fu'sevun boduvegenvaa kalaange'eve.
dhanna'eve. mi'aayaththa' baava'ile'vumuge sababe' kamuga'i tafsiyr `ilm verin liyu'vaafa'ive'eve. 'eyge khulaSa@ 'akee: 'awsu bnu lSWamitu, 'ekaleygefaanuge 'anbikanbalun khawla@u binti tha`laba@ mayekey hamakure'vi'eve. misoorathuga'i bayaanvegenmivaa Ziharu ge Hukum 'ebahee mayekey hamakurumuge Hukum baava'ile'vumuge kurin meehaku thimaage 'anbimeehaa mayekey hamakoshfeemey bunefi'yaa dhemeehun dhen 'abadhash varivee'eve. mihenve 'ekamanaa kanboduvegen rasuwlu llWahi ge 'arihashgos 'evaahaka dhennevumun 'ekaleygefaanu Hadiyth kure'vee 'ekamaa behey Hukum 'e' nethkamasheve. 'alunves 'ekamanaa 'ekamanaage Hal ge vaahaka bayan kosh vaahaka takrar kura'va'eve. 'eki faharu 'eki `ibara@ nneve. 'ekamanaage ma'sala'aa'i guLigen mi dhe'aayathaa'i 'adhi meegefahuga'ivaa dhe 'aayath baava'ile'vee'eve. Ziharu kurumuge 'enmehaa Hukum baava'ile'vee'eve.

'adhi thimaamenge 'anbin thimaamenge ma'innekey 'e'fadhakuraa meehun dhen 'emeehun 'ebuni bunun 'anburaa genas 'emeehunge 'anbeennaa'i jima` vumash qaSdu kuraanama 'edhemeehun jima` vumuge kurin 'aLaku minivankurun hu'teve. ('e'ee 'eynaa 'ebuni nuba'i dhogu bahuge 'adhabakasheve. 'ekamuge kafWara@ 'akasheve.) thiyaba'imeehunnash 'amurukura'vanee 'efadha'inneve. 'adhi 'ee kaleymen kuraahaa kame'ge khabar dhenevodigenvaa kalaange'eve.

dhenfahe 'aLaku minivan kuraan nulibunu meehaa ('aLaku nulibigen namaves, 'adhi 'aLaku gannahaa fa'isaa thimaage 'athuga'i nethigen namaves 'ekan nukurevunu meehaa'ash) dhen 'othee vidhividhigen dhemasdhuvahu roadha hifumeve. 'e'ee 'e dhemafireen jima` vumuge kureenneve. dhenfahe, dhemasdhuvahu roadha hifumash kuLadhaana nuvi meehakunama dhen 'othee fasdhoLas miskiynnnash kaan dhinumeve. ('e'ee konme miskiyn 'aku 'e'faharu bandu fureyvarash dhinumeve. mikamaa behey tafSiyl tha' fiqh foththakaa'i, Hadiyth foththakuga'i bayn vegen ve'eve.)
'isvedhiya Hukm thakakee kaleymen 'ashaa'i, 'ekalaange rasuwl 'aa 'ash ymn vumash taka'i kanda'aLu'vaafa'ivaa Hukm thakeve. 'adhi 'e'ee kanda'aLu'vaafa'ivaa HadW thakeve. 'inthakeve. 'ethanthan fahanaLa'i gosgen nuvaane'eve. ('ethanthan fahanaLa'i gos ge 'mr fuLuthakaa'i, Hukm fuLuthakash kiyamannuve ymn nuve'je meehaa'ee kfir 'ekeve.) 'adhi kfir nnash huree veyndhenivi `adhb 'eve.
dhanna'eve. 'isvedhiya 'aayaththakuga'i bayn vegen 'evanee Zihr kurumuge kushuge vaahakayaa'i, 'ekamuge 'adhabuge vaahaka'eve. Zihr kurumakee thimaage 'anbimeehaa'aa dhimaa'ash ('anti `alayWa kaZahri 'umWiy) 'ebahee "kaley 'ahurenge ma'chash 'ahurenge manmage burikashi fadha'eve." mifadha'in bunumeve. 'eyge maana'akee "kale'ekey 'ahurenge manma'ekey 'e'fadha'eve. manma gaathuga'i reykurumakee Harm kame' kamuga'i vee fadha'in kaleyge gaathuga'i 'ahuren reykurunves 'ahurennash Harm 'eve." mi'eve. 'islaamudheenuga'i mi Hukm 'a'umuge kureen meehaku thimaage 'anhenunnaa dhimaa'ash 'efadha'in bunefi'yaa dhen 'e dhemeehun varivee'eve. dhuvahakuves dhen nu'indheveyne'eve. 'ehen namaves mi 'aayaththa' baava'ile'vumun 'ekan kensalvee'eve. 'e dhemeehun vari'e' nuvaane'eve. 'e bunibunumash kafWra@ dhineemaa 'alunves 'anbimeehaa gaathuga'i reykurun hu'dhavee'eve. 'ekamuge kafWra@ 'akee 'aLaku minivan kurun. nuvatha vidhividhigen dhemas dhuvahu roadha hifun. nuvatha fasdhoLas miskeenunnash kaandhinun. mi'eve. mi'in konmeves 'e' kamekeve. 'emeehakash kuLadhaanavee 'enme mathee kamekeve.

'ash nukiyamantherive, 'aa'i, 'ekalaange rasuwl 'aa'i khilf ve, dhekoLuhadha'i, ge HadW thakun beyruveganna meehun dhanna'eve. 'isvedhiya 'efadha meehunves dherakurevi, nikamethikurevunu fadha'in 'emeehunves dherakurevi, nikamethi kurevi'je'eve. (konme thaaku, 'adhi konme zamaane'ga'ives 'efadha meehun dherakura'va'i, nikamethikura'vaane'eve.) 'adhi hamakashavarun bayaanvegenvaa aya@ tha' thiman raskalaange baava'ile'veemeve. 'ebahee thiman raskalaange'aa 'idhikoLuvaa meehunnash ('isvedhiya 'umW@ thakuga'ives) `iburathakash fudheyvaruge aya@ tha' baava'ile'veemeve. 'adhi kaafaruvee meehunnash hunnahushee hama veyndhenivi, 'ihaanethivegenvaa `adhb 'eve.

'emeehunnash 'efadha hna@ theri `adhb hunnahushee 'enmeha'i meesthakun 'alun dhirigen maHshar 'ash fonuvey dhuvahunneve. 'adhi dhuniyeyga'i 'eba'imeehun koshfa'ivaa 'enmeha'i `amal thakuge khabar, 'emeehunnash 'angavaane'eve. 'e huriha'i `amal 'e' 'e'ves 'uni'ithure' nukura'va'i himanu'va'i, baraabaru kura'vaafa'i ve'eve. 'adhi 'emeehun vanee 'e `amal thakuge matheen handhaan na'thaala'ifa'eve. 'adhi llWah'ee konme kame'ge ma'chash hekivevodigannavaa kalaange'eve.

('ey rasuwlu llWahi 'eve!) ta`la~ 'uduthakaa'i, bimuga'i vaaha'i thakethi dhenevodigenvaakan kaleygefaanash 'engivada'inugannavaa thoa'eve? thin meehaku thibegen najwa~ 'e' kuraanama ('ebahee thin meehaku thibegen si'ru vaahaka'e' dha'kaanama) 'emeehunge hatharuvana meehakash vodigenve'eve. ('e'ee 'ekalaange dhenevodigathumaa'i, qudra@ therivantha kamuge gothunneve. 'ebahee hatharuvana'ash 'ekalaange dhenevodigathumaa'i, qudra@ therivantha kamuge gothun 'ekalaange vodigen vaane'eve.) 'adhi fas meehun najwa~ 'e' kurannyaa, havana'ash 'ekalaange vodigen ve'eve. 'adhi kithanme madhu bayaku najwa~ kuriyas, 'adhi kithanme gina bayaku najwa~ kuriyas, 'adhi konme thaaku kuriyas, 'ethane'ga'i 'e ba'e'ge thereyga'i (dhenevodigathumaa'i, qudra@ therikamuge gothun) 'ekalaange vodigen vaane'eve. dhen 'emeehun 'ekuri huriha'i kame'ge, 'adhi dhe'ki vaahaka'e'ge khabar qiyma@ dhuvahun 'ekalaange dhe'vaane'eve. hamakashavarun ta`la~'ee huriha'i kame' dhenevodigenvaakalaange'eve.

najwa~ kurun 'ebayakash nahee kurevunumashfahu dhen 'alunves 'ekamash 'emeehun rujuw` ve, najwa~ kuramundhaa meehunnash kaleygefaanu nuba'lavamuthoa'eve? 'emeehun najwa~ kuramun 'e dhanee faafaveri vevey, 'adhi `adwa@ theri veveyney gothunneve. 'adhi rasuwlu llWahi 'aa'i 'uredhumuga'eve. 'adhi kaleygefaanuge 'arihash 'emeehun 'athuve'je'yaa 'emeehun kaleygefaanaa 'e salaankuranee kaleygefaanash salaankura'vaafa'i nuvaa fadha'akunneve. 'adhi 'efadha'in kankoshfa'i, 'emeehun 'ami'la-'ami'la'ash bune'eve. "'ahuremen mi kuri kanthakash, 'ahuremen mi buni bahash 'ahuremennash 'ane'kaa `adhb nudhe'vaaney baava'eve? `adhb dhe'vaafaaney kanvesneynge'eve." 'emeehunge 'e nuba'ikamash naraka fudhe'eve. qiyma@ dhuvahun 'emeehun 'ethaa 'andhaane'eve. 'e'ee gosthibun varashves nuba'ivegenvaa thanekeve.
mi dhe'aayathuga'i sifavegen midhanee rasuwlu llWahi ge zamaanuga'i yahuwdiy nge bayaku kantha' kuri gothe'ge vaahaka 'akaa'i, 'eba'imeehunge akhir natheejaage vaahaka'eve. ('lwHidiy vidhaaLuvi'eve. tafsiyr `ilm vereen vidhaaLuvi'eve. munfiq nge meehunnaa'i, yahuwdiy nnaa dheba'imeehun 'e've thibegen si'ru vaahaka dha'kaa kamuga'i vi'eve. 'emeehun muw'min nge meehunnash heekuruvanee muw'min nge nubayash si'ru vaahaka dha'kaa kamasheve. dhen 'eyge sababun muw'min nge meehunnash varash hithaamaverikan 'aadhe'eve. 'ezamaanakee hanguraama'ige vagutheve. 'adhi muw'min nnaa'i, yahuwdiy nnaa dhemedhu SulH ge mu`hada@ 'e' ves vefa'ivaa vagutheve. dhenfahe, mi yahuwdiy nge mi `amal ginavegen muw'min n rasuwlu llWahi 'ash 'ekamuge shakwa~ dhannava'i hadha'ifi'eve. 'ehenve rasuwlu llWahi, yahuwdiy nnash 'ekan manaakura'va'i, naheekura'va'ifi'eve. 'ehen namaves 'emeehun 'ekamun manaave, dhurunuvi'eve. 'isvedhiya dhe aya@ ga'i 'e 'ishaarath kura'vaa 'e'kamakee 'e'ee'eve. = fatHu lqadiyr =
'ane' vaahakayakee yahuwdiy nge meehun rasuwlu llWahi ge 'arihash 'a'is 'ekaleygefaanash nuba'i `ibr@ n salm kuraa vaahaka'eve. salm kurumash 'emeehun beynunkuraa `ibr@ 'akee (lsWamu `alayka 'eve. 'eyge muraadhakee 'ekaleygefaanu maruvumash 'emeehun du` kurumeve.) = fatHu lqadiyr = subHnahu wata`la~ muw'min nnash 'ekankan 'angava'i, 'e munfiq nnaa'i, yahuwdiy nge khabar tha' bayn kure'vee'eve. 'emeehun muw'min nnash nuba'iheekuruvumashnuba'i si'ru vaahaka dha'kaan thinmeehun thi'bas hatharuvanayash 'ekalaangevodigen vaaney kamaa'i, kithanme madhu bayaku thi'bas, 'adhi kithanme gina bayaku thi'bas, 'adhi konme thaaku thibegen vaahakadhe'kiyas 'ekan dhenevodigenvaaneykan 'angava'i bayn kure'vee'eve. 'adhi 'isve dhiyafadha nuba'i `amal tha' kuraa meehunge jaagayakee qiyma@ dhuvahun naraka kamaa'i, 'emeehunnash 'ethan fudheyvaru vaaneykanves 'engevee'eve. mi vaahakatha' dhigukosh tafSiyl kosh tafsiyr foththakuga'i liyevigen ve'eve. 'ehenve, 'e vaahakatha' handhaankoshlee'eve.

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve. thiyaba'imeehun najwa~ kurannyaa faafaveri veveyfadha 'adhi `adwa@ theri veveyfadha'in najwa~ nukuraasheve. 'ebaavathuge vaahaka nudha'kaasheve. 'adhi rasuwl 'ash 'uredheveyfadha najwa~ nukuraasheve. 'adhi 'ehene' kamaku thiyaba'imeehun najwa~ kurannyaaves heyokanthakaa'i, taqwa~ verivevey kankamuga'i najwa~ kuraasheve. 'adhi thiyaba'imeehun 'ash taqwa~ veri vaasheve. 'ekalaange'ee 'ekalaange HaDra@ 'ash thiyaba'imeehun maHshar kureveyney kalaange'eve.

hamakashavarun faafaveri vevey, 'adhi `adawa@ theri vevey najwa~ 'akee sa'ithaanuge faraathun vaa kamekeve. 'eynaage reyvumekeve. 'e'ee iyman vegen vaa meesthakunnash hithaamaverikan je'sumash taka'i kuraa kamekeve. 'ekamaku ge 'izunafuLaa la'igen menuvee 'ekamun 'emeehunnash, 'ebahee muw'min nnash 'e'ves ge'lume' dheveyney kamuga'i nuve'eve. 'adhi muw'min n hama'ekani 'ash wakiyl kosh, baroasaa kuraahushi kameve. 'ithubaaru kuraahushi kameve.

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve. majlis thakuga'i ('ehen meehun 'isheennaan) "kaleymen thanavaskoshlaashey" kaleymennash bunevi'je'yaa fahe kaleymen majlis thanavaskoshlaasheve. 'e'irun kaleymennash thanavas koshdhe'vaane'eve. 'adhi "kaleymen thedhuvaashey" kaleymennash bunevi'je'yaa dhen kaleymen thedhuvaasheve. fahe kaleymenkure iyman vee meehunnaa'i, 'adhi `ilm 'ungenunu meehun mathiveri 'etha' dharajathakakash 'ufu'lavaane'eve. 'adhi kaleymen kuraaha'i kame'ge khabar dhenevodigen ve'eve. (qiyma@ dhuvahun 'e kankamuge [jazaa] kaleymennash dhe'vaanetheve.)
* noat: mi 'aayathun 'ishaaraathvegen mivanee rasuwlu llWahi ge 'SHb nge medhuga'i dhimaavi mas'ala@ 'akasheve. 'e vaahaka'ige khulSa@ 'akee: badr hanguraama'iga'i ba'iverivevada'igennevi 'SHb nnash rasuwlu llWahi 'ithuru samaalukame' baha'tavaa kamuga'i vi'eve. 'e'dhuvahaku rasuwlu llWahi 'aa'i, ba'e' 'SHb n majlis ga'i thi'bavanikosh badr hanguraama'ash vada'igennevi beykalunkure ba'e' beykalun vada'igen rasuwlu llWahi 'aa salaankura'va'i, dhenves thi'bevi beykalunnash salm kure'vumashfahu 'ekaleygefaanaa dhimaavaa gothash koLash thi'bevi'eve. 'e'ee 'isheendhevada'igannavaaney thankoLe' nethigenneve. 'e beykalun 'ehen thi'beveethee 'ekan 'ekaleygefaanash bodufuLuvegen 'ebeykalunnash than dhe'vaan vegen kureen 'isheendhevada'igen thi'bevi beykalun kure ba'e' beykalun thedhuvevada'igennevumash vidhaaLuvi kamuga'i vi'eve. 'e'ee badhuruge beykalunnash maathkosh hi'thevumash taka'eve. mikamaa guLigen mi 'aayath baava'ile'vee kamuga'i vi'eve. = ftH lqdyr - bn kthyr =

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve. thiyaba'imeehun rasuwlu llWahi 'aa si'ru vaahaka'e' dha'kaan qaSd kurannyaa 'e vaahaka'e' dha'kaan feshumuge kureen Sadaq@ 'e' kuraasheve. 'egoth thiyaba'imeehunnash heyovefa'i Thr kan bodeve. dhenfahe thiyaba'imeehunnash Sadaq@ kuraaney minvare' nulibi'jenamaves kushe' netheve. 'ehenee hamakashavarun 'ee ginagina'in faafafu'savaa, raHma@ le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaange'eve.

thiyaba'imeehun 'efadha vaahaka'e' dhe'kumuge kureen Sadaq@ dheegen faqiyr vedhaaney kamash biruvethivanee he'yeve? fahe 'efadha Sadaq@ 'e' thiyaba'imeehunnash nudhevi'je'yaa / (nulibi'je) hindhun, thiyaba'imeehunnash tawba@ la'va'ifi'eve. dhenfahe thiyaba'imeehun namaadhu qy'im kosh, zakaath dheysheve. 'adhi 'ashaa'i, 'adhi 'ekalaange rasuwl 'aa 'ash kiyamantheri vaasheve. 'ee thiyaba'imeehun kuraaha'i kame' dhenevodigenvaa kalaange'eve. 'adhi 'ekanbalunge faafa fu'sevumash ge HaDra@ ga'i 'edhivada'igannavaasheve. hamakashavarun 'ee ginagina'in faafa fu'savaa, 'adhi raHma@ le'vun boduvegenvaa raskalaange'eve.

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve. 'eba'e'ge ma'chash koafaa la'vaafa'ivaa bayaku 'e'ee kaleymenge vereen kamuga'i bala'i, 'emeehunnash naSr dhee, kaleymenge verikan 'emeehunnash nudheysheve. ('e'ee muslim n fiyava'i 'enmeha'i kafir jama`a@ thakeve. nuvatha yahuwdiy nneve.) fahe 'emeehunkure, maruvegos, kashvaLuthakuga'ivaa meehunves akhira@ dhuvahaamedhu 'umWiyd kanda'ileefadha'in mimeehunves mivanee akhira@ dhuvahaamedhu 'umWiyd kanda'ila'ifa'eve. (fahe akhira@ dhuvahaamedhu 'emeehun 'umWiyd kanda'ilee akhira@ dhuvas naannaaney kamuge `tiqd ge ma'chasheve. nuvatha 'e dhuvas 'a'umun 'emeehunnash 'e'ves heyo naseebe' nethkan 'engi 'egothuge ma'chasheve. wallWahu 'a`lamu)
'uduthakaa'i, bimuga'i vaaha'i thakethi 'ash tasbiyH kiya'eve. hus Thir vantha kure'eve.

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve. kaleymen nukuraa kantha'thakuge vaahaka kurikamash bunanee kee'vegen he'yeve? ('ekame' nukoshthibe, thimaamen 'eveni heyokame' koshfeemey, miveni rangaLukame' koshfeemey bunehadhanee kee'vegen he'yeve?)
kaleymen nukuraa kanthakuge vaahaka koshfeemey bunehedhumee ge HaDra@ ga'i koafaa'aa'i, `adhb boduvegenvaa kamekeve. ('e hedhenee dhogekeve.)
ge maguga'i safusafash ('e'gaakoLu 'ane' gaakoLaa guLi, thathve gadhafadhavefa'ivaa binaa'e'fadha gadhafadhakosh safuhadha'igen) hanguraamakuraa meehunnash loabivevodigen ve'eve.

'adhi muwsa~ `alayh lslm 'ekaleygefaanuge qawm ge meehunnash vidhaaLuvihindhu hanumafuLu kura'vaasheve fahe 'ekaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvi'eve. "'ey 'ahurenge qawm ge meehunneyve. kaleymen thiman kaleygefaanash 'undhagoo kuranee kee'vegen he'yeve? hamakashavarun thimankaleygefaanee kaleymenge gaathash fonu'vi rasuwl 'aakan kaleymen rangaLash dhannaane'eve." ('emeehun 'ekaleygefaanash 'undhagookuree 'ekaleygefaanuge basfuLu nu'ehumunnaa'i, 'ekaleygefaanuge 'mr fuLash nukiyamantheri vegennaa'i, 'adhi 'ekaleygefaanash huthuru 'e'chethi kiya'igenneve. 'ekaleygefaanuge kurimathifaraath boduvefa'eyves 'emeehun kee'eve. 'Hzb soorath nimeythaa 'evaahaka dhikr kurevigen ve'eve.) dhenfahe 'emeehun 'egothuge matheega'i 'ekaleygefaanash nukiyamantherivun mathee dhemithibumun, nuvatha iyman kamaa'i, thedhumagaa dhurash 'emeehun lenbumun 'emeehunge hiththa' iyman kamaa'i, thedhumagaa dhurash lanbava'ifi'eve. 'adhi fsiq ve'je bayakash thedhumagu nudha'kava'eve.

'adhi maryam gefaanunge dharikalun `iysa~ `alayh lslm baniy sry'yl nnash vidhaaLuvi hindhu kanveegoth handhuma fuLu kura'vaasheve! 'ekaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvi'eve. "'ey baniy sry'yl 'eve! hamakashavarun 'ahurennakee kaleymenge gaathash fonu'vi rasuwl 'aa'eve. 'e'ee 'ahurenge kureega'i vaa tawra@ thedhukuraa Hl ga'eve. 'adhi 'ahurenge fahun vada'igannavaaney rasuwl beykalaku vada'igannavaaney kamuge 'ufaaveri khabar ves kaleymennash dheysheve. 'e beykale'ge nanfuLakee 'aHmad 'eve." dhenfahe bayaanve, fa'uLuvegenvaa mu`jiza@ 'aa'i, daliyl 'aa'igen 'ekaleygefaanu ('ebahee `iysa~ / nuvatha 'aHmad gefaanu) vada'igathumun 'emeehun bunee "mi'ee bayan vegenvaa siHr 'e'" kamuga'eve. (kaafarunge meehun mi'in 'e' beykalakashves iyman 'e' nuvi'eve.)

slm vumash 'emeehakash goveyhindhu, govemun dhaa'iru ge ma'chash bodu dhoge' hadha'igath meehakash vuren vakeen bodu 'aniyaaveriyakee kaaku he'yeve? 'e'ashvure bodu 'aniyaaveriyaku nuvaane'eve. 'adhi 'aniyaaveri ve'je bayakash thedhumagu nudha'kavaa hu'teve.

'emeehun 'edhenee 'emeehunge 'angathakun (ba'theege huLukoLash fumeygothash fumegen) ge nuwr nivaalaan kamasheve. slm diyn ge 'alikan na'tha'ilaan kamasheve. 'ekamaku kaafarun nuruhi thi'bas 'ekalaange nuwr furihama kura'vaane'eve. slm diyn fa'uLukura'vaane'eve.

'ekalaange'ee thedhumagaa'i, HaqW diyn 'aa'igen 'ekalaange rasuwl 'aa muHamWadun fonu'vi kalaange'eve. 'e'ee 'enmeha'i diyn thake'ge ma'chash 'e diyn fa'uLukura'va'i, gadhakure'vumashtaka'eve. mushrik nnaa'i diyn ge `adwa@ thereen nuruhi thibinamaves me'eve.

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve. veyndhenivi `adhb n thiyaba'imeehun salaamath vaaney viyafaari'akash thiman raskalaange thiyaba'imeehunnash magudha'ka'i, 'irushaadhudhe'vaa husheemeve. 'e viyafaareege ra'sulmal 'akee (thiyaba'imeehunge faraathun dha'kaanjehey mudhalakee):

thiyaba'imeehun 'ashaa'i, 'ekalaange rasuwl 'aa'ash iyman ve, 'e dhefaraath thedhukurumaa'i, thiyaba'imeehunge mudhalaa'i, thiyaba'imeehunge nafs thakun ge maguga'i jihd kurumeve. thiyaba'imeehunnash 'engeynama 'egoth, 'adhi 'e kantha' thiyaba'imeehunnash heyokan bodeve. 'ekamuge badhaluga'i kaleymennash huri fa'idhaa'akee, 'e viyafaareege nafaa'akee:

'ekalaange thiyaba'imeehunge faafatha' fu'sevumeve. 'adhi 'e thanthaange dhashun 'aarutha' dhemigenvaa suvarugethakash thiyaba'imeehun ve'dhevumeve. 'adhi qy'im ve thibey suvarugethakuga'i thibeyney maskan tha' (thibeyney than) thiyaba'imeehunnash dhe'vumeve. boduvegenvaa naseebakee 'e'ee'eve.

'adhi thiyaba'imeehun 'e fa'idhaa'akash taka'i loabikuraaney 'ehen fa'idhaa'e' ve'eve. 'e'ee ge HaDra@ n vaa naSr 'aa'i, kaamiyaabeve. 'adhi fatH 'eve. (makWa@ fatH vumeve.) 'adhi muw'min thakunnash 'ufaaverikamuge khabar dhe'vaasheve.
dhanna'eve. 'isvedhiya dhethin aya@ ga'i bayn kura'vaafa'i 'evaa nafaa 'eha'ibodu viyafaari'akee mi'adhu 'aLugandumennash ba'iveri vevidhaaney viyafaari'ekeve. 'e' faraathun husha'aLaanjehey mudhalakee 'ashaa'i, 'ekalaange rasuwl 'aa'ash iyman vumaa'i, dhen thimaamenge mudhalaa'i nafs thakun ge maguga'i jihd kurumeve. mi thaketheege badhaluga'i dhe'van 'e 'angavanee dhuvahaku nimume' nuvaa bodu ni`ma@ 'eve. 'e'ee faafa fu'sava'i dhe'vumaa'i 'ethanthaange dhashun 'aarutha' hingahinga'i 'onna suvarugethakash ve'dhevumaa'i, qy'im ve thibey suvaruge'in maathvegenvaa goathigedhoru dhe'vumeve. 'adhi meege 'ithurun 'ehen fa'idhaa'ekeve. 'e'ee dhuniyematheega'i dhe'vaaney fa'idhaa'eve. kureen dhennevigen 'evanee qiyma@ dhuvahun huri fa'idhaa'aa'i, boduvegenvaa naseebeve. dhuniyematheega'ivaa fa'idhaa'akee ge naSr 'aa'i, fatH dhe'vumeve. fahe mi viyafaareege nafaa bodukamaa'eve!

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve. thiyaba'imeehun ge naSr vereennash vaasheve. 'ebahee ge diyn 'ash naSr dhey bayaku kamuga'i kaleymen vaasheve. 'e'ee HawriyW nnash ves `iysa~ vidhaaLuvi fadha'inneve. (HawriyW nnakee `iysa~ `alayh lslm ge 'SHb nneve.) 'ekaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvi'eve. " 'ash naSr dheyn 'ahurenge naSr vereennakee koba'ihe'yeve?" ('ebahee ge diyn 'ash naSr dhinumash taka'i 'ahurennash naSr dhee vaagiverivaaney bayakee kon ba'e' he'yeve?) 'ehindhu HawriyW beykalun dhennevi'eve. "'ahuremen mee ge naSr vereenneve." ('ebahee ge diyn 'ash naSr dheyn thibi meehunneve.) (muHamWad gefaanash iyman vegen thibi meehunneyve. `iysa~ `alayh lslm ge HawriyW beykalun 'e vidhaaLuvigothash ge diyn 'ash naSr dhey bayaku kamuga'i kaleymen vaasheve.)
fahe 'SHb beykalunnash rasuwl 'efadha'in 'engevumun 'e beykalun kantha' kure'veeves hama 'efadha'inneve. 'e beykalun vee ge diyn 'ash naSr dhin maath beykalun kamuga'eve. raDiya `anhum) dhen baniy sry'iyl nge there'in jam`a@ 'e'ge bayaku meehun `iysa~ `alayh lslm 'ash iyman vi'eve. 'adhi 'eyge there'in jam`a@ 'e'ge bayaku kaafaruvi'eve. dhenfahe kaafaru 'evee jam`a@ ge ma'chash iyman vee meesthakun thimanraskalaange gadhakura'va'i, ta'yiyd kure'veemeve. 'adhi iyman vee meesthakun vee 'eba'imeehunge `aduwW nge ma'chash gadhavegenvaa bayaku kamuga'eve.

'uduthakaa'i, bimuga'i vaaha'i thakethi 'ash tasbiyH kiya'eve. hus Thir vantha kure'eve. (dhulun bunevey thakethi dhulunneve. dhulun nubunevey thakethi 'adhi 'ehen gothakunneve. Hl ge dhulunneve. 'insaanunnakash 'e thaketheege tasbiyH nuvisneyne'eve. 'e'ves 'e'che' 'ash tasbiyH kiyaa kamuga'i menuvee nuve'eve. 'ekamaku 'insaanunnakash 'e tasbiyH nuvisneyne'eve: wain mWin shayin ilWa yusabWiHu biHamdihi walakin lWa tafqahuwna tasbiyHahum lay@ - baniy isray'iyl 44.) 'ee 'enmeha'i thaketheege veri kalaange'eve. 'adhi 'enmeha'i `ayb 'akun dhuruve hus Thir vegenvaa kalaange'eve. 'e'ee `izWa@ vantha, Hakiym vantha kalaange'eve.

'ekalaange'ee liyekiyaan nudhanna 'umWiyW meehunge there'ash hama 'emeehunge there'in ('ebahee 'umWiyW 'in) meehaku rasuwl kamaa'igen fonu'vi kalaange'eve. ('ebahee samwi~ 'e'ves fothe'ge 'hl veri bayaku kamuga'i nuvaa `arabi~ nge there'ash `arabi~ nge there'in rasuwl 'aku fonu'vi kalaange'eve. 'e'ee muHamWadun 'eve. 'adhi 'ehen noonas "'umWiyW" mi lafZ ge maana'ee liyekiyaan nudhanna meehaa'eve. 'e dhuvasvaru `arabi~ nge madhu meehakash liyekiyaan 'engunas, gina meehunnakee `amW kosh liyekiyaan nudhanna meehunneve.) dhenfahe 'e rasoolaa vada'igathee 'eba'imeehunnash 'ekalaange aya@ tha' kiyava'idhe'vumashaa'i, kufr 'aa'i, shirk n 'eba'imeehun Thir kure'vumashaa'i shaa'i, 'adhi keerithi quran 'aa'i, sunWa@ 'eba'imeehunnash 'ungannava'idhe'vumasheve. 'adhi 'eyge kureega'i, 'ebahee rasuwl 'aa fonu'vumuge kureega'i, kanda'eLigen bayn vegenvaa magufuredhume'ga'i 'emeehun thibinamaves me'eve.

'adhi 'ekaleygefaanu rasuwl kamaa'igen fonu'vevee 'ehaathanash 'eba'imeehunge thereyga'i neth bayakashves ('ebahee 'ekaleygefaanuge 'SHb beykalunnashfahu qiyma@ 'aa jeheyndhen dhuniye'ash 'annaaney bayakash) ves rasuwl beykalaku kamuga'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange'ee `izWa@ vantha, Hakiym vantha kalaange'eve.

'e'ee - 'ebahee nabi~ kamaa'i, rasuwl kamakee - ge faDl vanthaveri kameve. 'ekalaange 'edhivodigennevi faraathakash 'e faDl vanthakan dhe'va'eve. 'adhi 'ee faDl vanthakamuge veri, nuhanu ha'iba vanthakamugeveri kalaange'eve.

tawra@ 'ash `amal kuran jehifa'i dhen 'e fothuga'ivaa gothash `amal nukuri meehunge misaalakee burikashimatheega'i bodethi baru foththake' 'ufulaa Himr ge misaaleve. (burikashimatheega'i vanee fothe' kame'ves najihe'ves kame' 'e Himr 'ashves neynge'eve.) ge 'aayaththa' dhogukuri mi meehunge misaaluge nuba'ikan varashves bodeve. 'adhi 'aniyaaveri ve'je bayakash thedhumagu nudha'kavaane'eve. (mi 'aayathuga'i 'ishaaraathvegen mivaa meehunnakee yahuwdiy nneve.)

('ey rasuwl 'eve!) kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve! 'ey yahuwdiy vegath meehunneyve! kaleymennee 'ehen meesthakun fiyava'i ge waliyW n kamuga'i - 'adhi 'ekalaange 'enme loabivevodigenvaa meehun kamuga'i dhekeynama - 'ehenkamash heekurannyaa fahe kaleymen maruvaan 'edheysheve. ('e'irun hama seedhaa dhen suvaruge dhaanvee'eve. kaleymen heekuraa gothuga'i, 'adhi kaleymen bunaa gothuga'i yahuwdiy 'aku nuvatha naSra~ 'aku menuvee suvaruge nuvannaane'eve.) kaleymenge bahuga'i kaleymen thedhubunaa kamuga'i vaanama 'avahash maruvaan 'edheysheve. ('emeehunge 'ebahaa'i, 'e heekurun 'e'ee dhoge'kan 'angava'i 'e waHiy kura'vanee mifadha'inneve.)
dhuvahakuves 'emeehun 'e marakash neydheyne'eve. 'e'ee 'emeehun koshfa'ivaa faafathakuge sababunneve. 'emeehunnee 'aniyaavereenneve. 'adhi 'aniyaavereennaamedhu dhenevodigen ve'eve.

('ey rasuwl 'eve.) kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve. 'eyakaamedhu kaleymen birun thiya fila'iganna maru hamakashavarun kaleymennaa ba'dhalukuraane'eve. kaleymen maruvaane'eve. si'raa'i, fa'uLu dhenevodigenvaa kalaange HaDra@ 'ash - ge HaDra@ 'ash - dhen kaleymen fonuveyne'eve. dhenfahe dhuniyeyga'i thibegen kaleymen kuriha'i kame'ge khabar 'ekalaange kaleymennash dhe'vaane'eve. ('adhi 'eyge jaza ves dhe'vaane'eve.)

'ey ymn ve'je meesthakunneyve. hukuru dhuvahu hukuru namaadhash gova'ilevi'je'yaa ge dhikr kurumash kaleymen 'avasvegannaasheve. 'adhi kaleymen ganevi'kun dhookoshlaasheve. (hukuru vaguthu kaleymen viyafaari nukuraasheve.) kaleymennash 'engey kamuga'i vannyaa 'egoth ('ekan) kaleymennash maa heyovegen ve'eve.
* noat: "hukuru dhuvahu hukuru namaadhash gova'ilevi'je'yaa" 'ey 'oth basfuLuge muraadhakee mm meehaa khuTba@ kiyumash minbarash 'ereemaa dhen 'e govaa bangi govumeve. 'e vaguthun feshigen hukuru namaadhu nimeyndhen, viyafaarikurun muLeen Harm vaane'eve. manaa vaane'eve. rasuwlu llh zamaanuga'i khuTba@ fa'tavanee mendhuru bangi'aa'i vidhigenneve..ga'e'nooneve.

dhenfahe hukuru namaadhu nimi'je'yaa dhen kaleymenge masa'kathaa'igen (ganevi'kumaa'i, 'ehenihenves kankamaa'igen) 'uLeysheve. bimuga'i fethurigannaasheve. dhaan beynun hu'dha dhi'umakash dhaasheve. dhi'un hu'dhavee'eve. 'adhi ge HaDra@ n faDl vanthakan 'edheysheve! rizugu 'edheysheve! 'adhi dharumayaa'i, thawb ves 'edheysheve! 'adhi ginagina'in 'ash dhikr kuraasheve! handhaankuraasheve. 'e'ee kaleymennash kaamiyaabu veythoa'eve. 'ekamuge 'umWiyd ga'eve.

'adhi rasuwlu llh 'emeehunnash viyafaari'e' feni'je'yaa, nuvatha kuLivare' feni'je'yaa 'edhimaa'akash 'eba'imeehun vakivakivegen dhanee'eve. kaleygefaanu (minbaruga'i khuTba@ vidhaaLuvaan) dhookoshla'ifa'i 'emeehun nukumegen 'e dhanee'eve. kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve! kuLivaraa'i, viyafaari'ashvure ge HaDra@ ga'i vaa thakethi (thawb 'aa'i, dharuma) maa heyokan bodeve. 'adhi 'ee thakethi dhe'vaa faraaththakuge there'in 'enme heyovegenvaa faraatheve.
* noat: mi 'aayath baava'ile'vi sababe' tafsiyr `ilm vereen liyu'vaafa'i ve'eve. 'e vaahaka'ige khulSa@ 'akee: madiyna@ ge 'hl vereennash banduha'ihoonukame' dhimaavefa'ivee dhuvasvare'ga'i 'emeehunge viyafaari gaafilaa shm kara'in 'a'is lefi vaguthakee hukuru dhuvahu rasuwl mimbaruga'i khuTba@ vidhaaLuvaan hunnevi vagutheve. viyafaari gaafilaa 'anna 'adu 'ivumun miskithuga'i hukurash gos thibi meehunves 'enme baara meehun fiyava'i 'enmen viyafaari gaafilaa'aa dhimaa'ash dhemiganevunee'eve. rasuwl hunnevee khuTba@ vidhaaLuvaasheve. 'ekamaa guLigen mi 'aayath baava'ile'vi 'eve. wallWahu 'a`lamu. = fatHu lqadiyr =

('ey rasuwl 'eve!) munfiq nge meehun kaleygefaanuge majlis 'ash 'athuve'je'yaa 'emeehun bunaane'eve. "hamakashavarun kaleygefaanakee kanda'eLigen ge rasuwl 'aa kamash 'ahuremen hekivameve." 'adhi 'e'angavanee hamakashavarun kaleygefaanee ge rasuwl 'aa kan dhenevodigen ve'eve. 'adhi hamakashavarun munfiq n 'e hadhanee kanda'eLigen dhogukan, 'e'ee dhoguvereen kamuga'i hekivevodigenve'eve.
dhanna'eve. mi 'aayathuga'i mivaa munfiq nge muraadhakee `abdu bn 'ubayWu bn saluwl 'aa'i, 'eynaage 'ekuvereenneve. rasuwl ge majlis'ash 'emeehun 'a'is, "kaleygefaanee rasuwl 'aa kamash 'ahuremen hekivameve." mihen bunaa bunumakee 'emeehun dhulukoLun bunaa bunume' kamuga'i hekivevodigannavanee'eve. 'e'ee muw'min nge kandithakun salaamathvaan vegen hadhaa bodu roa buhuthaan dhogeve. 'emeehunnakee 'etherefushun 'eemaanvegenvaa ba'e' nooneve.

'emeehun 'emeehunge huvayaa'i, heki 'e lanee (muw'min nge kandithakun salaamathvaa) 'a'dana'e' kamuga'eve. fahe 'egothun 'emeehun ge magu bandhukuranee'eve. hamakashavarun 'emeehun kuramun 'e dhaa kanthakakee haadhahaaves nuba'i kankameve.

'e'ee, 'ebahee 'emeehun 'e dhoguhadha'i, 'adhi nuba'i `amal tha' kuramun 'e dhanee 'emeehun hamakashavarun 'eemaanve, dhen kaafaruvee kamuge sababunneve. dhenfahe 'emeehunge hiththakuga'i si'kaja'sava'i, bandhukure'vee'eve. 'ehenveemaa 'emeehunnakash nuvisneyne'eve.

('adhi 'ey rasuwl 'eve!) kaleygefaanash 'emeehun feni'je'yaa 'emeehunge hashithakuge reethikamuge sababun kaleygefaanu `ajy'ib kuruvaane'eve. 'adhi 'emeehun vaahakadha'kannyaa kaleygefaanu 'a'savaane'eve. (kaleygefaanash heefuLuvaanee 'e'ee hama HaqW thedhu vaahaka kamasheve. namaves 'e'ee hama dhogeve.) 'emeehun konfadha he'yeve? 'emeehunnekey faare'ga'i la'koshlaafa'ivaa lakudigandekey hama 'e'fadha'eve. konme 'ade' 'ivunas 'emeehunnash heevaanee 'e'ee hama 'emeehunge ma'chash 'anna 'ade' kamasheve. ('e'ee 'emeehunge findikamunneve.) 'e'ee kanda'eLigen `aduwW n neve. 'emeehun halaaku kura'vaashi'eve! la`na@ la'vaashi'eve! 'adhi 'emeehun HaqW magaadhuruve, dhogutha' hadhanee konfadha'akun he'yeve? dhoguhedheynee konfadha'akun he'yeve?

, 'adhi "kaleymenge faafa fu'sevun 'edhi du`a koshdhinumash 'edhi dhannavaan rasuwl ge'arihash kaleymen 'annaashey" mihen 'e munfiq nnaa dhimaa'ash bunevi'je'yaa 'emeehunge boatha' 'ane' faraathash 'anbura'ilaane'eve. 'adhi "'emeehun kibr verivegenvaa Hl, furagasdheythan kaleygefaanu dhekevada'igannavaane'eve." fahe 'emeehunge faafafu'sevumash kaleygefaanu du` kure'viyas, 'adhi nuvatha 'emeehunnash faafafu'sevumash du` nukure'viyas hamahama'eve. 'emeehunnash faafanufu'savaa hu'teve. fsiq ve, nukiyamantherive'je bayakash hamakashavarun thedhumagu nudha'kava'eve.

, 'adhi "kaleymenge faafa fu'sevun 'edhi du`a koshdhinumash 'edhi dhannavaan rasuwl ge'arihash kaleymen 'annaashey" mihen 'e munfiq nnaa dhimaa'ash bunevi'je'yaa 'emeehunge boatha' 'ane' faraathash 'anbura'ilaane'eve. 'adhi "'emeehun kibr verivegenvaa Hl, furagasdheythan kaleygefaanu dhekevada'igannavaane'eve." fahe 'emeehunge faafafu'sevumash kaleygefaanu du` kure'viyas, 'adhi nuvatha 'emeehunnash faafafu'sevumash du` nukure'viyas hamahama'eve. 'emeehunnash faafanufu'savaa hu'teve. fsiq ve, nukiyamantherive'je bayakash hamakashavarun thedhumagu nudha'kava'eve.

'emeehunnakee, 'ebahee 'e munfiq nnakee "rasuwl ge 'arihuga'ivaa meehunnash kaleymen heydha nukuraashey" mihen bunaa meehunneve. 'e'ee 'emeehun 'ekaleygefaanu dhookosh, muLeen dhurash dhaandheneve. 'ekamaku, 'uduthakaa'i, bimuge khazna@ tha' vanee hama'ekani 'ash milkuve, khSW vegenneve. namaves munfiq nnakash 'ekame' nuvisne'eve.
* noat: mi 'aayathuga'i rasuwl ge 'arihuga'ivaa meehunney 'oth basfuLun muraadhuvanee muhjiriyW beykalunkure faqiyr beykalunneve. = fatHu lqadiyr =

'emeehunnakee -'ebahee munafiqnnakee- mihenves bunaa meehunneve. 'ahuremen hanguraama'in 'eburi mdyn@ 'ash dhevi'je'yaa 'ethaanga'i thibi `izWa@ theri maath meehunvegen 'ethaanga'i thibi dhera nikamethin 'ethanun nikanhure nerelaahusheemeve. (mifadha bastha' bunee munafiq nge ray'iys `abdullWahi bnu 'ubayWu bnu saluwlu 'eve. `izWa@ therin kamuga'i 'enaa muraadhu kuree 'eynaayaa 'enaage 'ekuverinneve. 'adhi dhera nikamethinkamuga'i 'eynaa muraadhukuranee rasuwlu 'aa 'ekaleygefaanuge 'arihuga'i vaa muw'min nneve. fahe llWahu subHanahu wata`ala~ 'eynaage mibahash ra'dhukura'va'i 'e'angavanee mifadha'inneve.) `izWa@ therikamaa maathkan vanee hama'ekani llWahu 'ashaa'i 'ekalaange rasuwl 'ashaa'i 'adhi muw'min nnasheve. 'ehen bayakashnooneve. 'ekamaku munafiq nnakash 'egothe' neyge'eve.

'ey iyman ve'je meesthakunneyve! kaleymenge mudhalaa 'adhi kaleymenge dharinge sababun - 'ethake'chaa'i hedhi - llWahu ge dhikr n kaleymen Gafil kosh handhaanna'tha'i liya nudheysheve! fahe 'ehen hadha'ifi meehun dhanna'eve. 'e'ee kanda'eLigen ge'li halaakuve'je ba'ekeve.

'adhi thimanraskalaange kaleymennash dhe'va'ifa'ivaa thakethin kaleymen heydhakuraasheve! 'e'ee kaleymenkure meehaku ka'iri'ash maru 'a'is mifadha'in 'emeehaa dhennevumuge kurinneve. 'ey 'aLuge rabW 'eve. kuda vaguthukoLakash mi'aLaa laskoshla'vaane nama'eve. 'eyrun mi 'aLaa Sadaqa@ dhee 'adhi SaliH meehunge there'in vaahusheemeve. mihen dhennevumuge kurinneve.
fahe 'e'ves nafs 'e' 'e nafs 'e'ge vaguthujehumun dhen llWahu lasnukura'vaa hu'teve. 'adhi llWahu kaleymen kuraahaa kame'ge khabar moLash dhenevodigenve'eve.

'uduthakaa'i bimuga'ivaahaa thakethi llWahu 'ash tasbiyH kiya'eve. 'ekalaa nge hus Tahir vanthakure'eve. 'enmehaa thaketheege milk veriyakee 'ekalaange'eve. 'ekalaange 'edhivodigennevi gothakash 'ethaketheege taSarWufu hingava'eve. 'adhi 'enmehaa Hamdu 'aa'i ta`riyf 'e'huree hama 'ekalaange'asheve. 'adhi 'ekalaange konme kamakash kuLadhunvanthavevodigenve'eve.

('ey 'enmeha'i meesthakunneyve!) kaleymen he'dhevee 'ekalaange'eve. kaleymenge there'in kaafarun ve'eve. 'adhi muw'min nves kaleymenge there'in ve'eve. 'adhi kaleymen kuraahaa kamakash llWahu ba'lavaavodigenve'eve.

'uduthakaa'i bin 'ekalaange HaqW gothuga'i he'dhevi'eve. 'adhi 'ekalaange kaleymen soorakure'vi'eve. 'adhi kaleymenge soora rivethi kura'va'i rangaLu kure'vi'eve. 'adhi 'enburi dhiyunvanee 'ekalaange HaDra@ 'asheve.

'uduthakaa'i bimuga'i vaahaa thakethi 'ekalaa nge dhenevodigenve'eve. 'adhi kaleymen si'rukuraa kanthakaa'i 'adhi kaleymen faaLukuraa kantha'ves 'ekalaange dhenevodigenve'eve. 'adhi hiththakuga'i foruvifa'ivaa thakethives llWahu dhenevodigenve'eve.

('ey mithiba kaafaruve'je meesthakunneyve.) meege kurin 'isve dhiya kaafarunge khabar tha' kaleymenge gaathash naadhey he'yeve? (nuwH qawm fadha `adu qawm fadha thamuwd qawm fadha kaafaruvee qawm thakuge khabar naadhey he'yeve? 'ivifa'i nuvey he'yeve?) 'emeehunves 'emeehun kuri nuba'i kanthakuge sababun 'a'i `adhab ge raha libi gatheve. 'adhi akhira@ ga'i 'emeehunnash huree veyndhenivi `adhab 'eve.

'ehen 'evee, 'ebahee 'e `adhab 'emeehunnash HaqW vee 'emeehunge gaathash 'emeehunge rasuwl beykalun bayaanvegenvaa daliyl thakaa'i mu`jiz@ 'aa'igen vada'igennevumun 'ekaafarunge meehun 'e rasuwl beykalunnaa dhimaa'ash (malaamathkoshfa'i bunee) 'ahuremennash thedhumagu dha'kaanee adam ge dhari'e' he'yeve? dhenfahe 'eba'i meehun 'ekalaange rasuwl beykalun dhogukosh kaafaruvee'eve. 'adhi furagas dhinee'eve. 'adhi llWahu 'emeehunge iyman kamaa'i 'aLukamaa'i nula'i fudhivodigenfi'eve. 'adhi llWahu 'ee ('ami'la dhat fuLaa'igen) fudhivodigenvaa Hamdu libivodigenvaa kalaange'eve.

kaafaruvee meesthakun heekoshfa'i bune'eve. 'emeehun maruvumashfahu 'alun dhirigen maHshar 'ash nufonuveyne'eve. 'emeehun 'ehen heekure'eve. 'ey rasuwl 'eve! kaleygefaanu vidhaaLuvaasheve! 'e'gothakashves 'ehen nuvaane'eve. thimankaleygefaanuge rabW gandhee huva'ikoshfa'i bunameve. hamakashavarun yaqiyn nves kaleymen maruvumashfahu maHshar 'ash fonu'veyne'eve. dhen thiyaba'imeehun dhuniyeyga'i koshfa'ivaa kanthakuge khabar kaleymennash dheveyne'eve. ('adhi 'eyge furihama jaza ves dhe'vaane'eve.) 'e'ee 'ekalaange 'ash dhaadhi faseyhakamekeve.

fahe 'ehenve kaleymen llWahu 'ashaa'i 'ekalaange rasuwl 'aa 'ashaa 'adhi thimanraskalaange baava'ile'vi nuwr kamuga'ivaa keerithi quran 'ash iyman vaasheve. 'adhi llWahu kaleymen kuraahaa kame'ge khabar moLash dhenevodigenve'eve. ('eyge jaza dhe'vaane'eve.)

'enmehaa meesthakun 'e'kura'vaa dhuvahu kaleymenves 'e'kura'vaa jama` kura'vaanekan handhaan kuraasheve. 'e'ee taGabun 'eve kiyunu qiyama@ dhuvaheve. ('e'ee nukiyamantherivi meesthakunnash ge'lumaa'i halaaku - 'adhi kiyamantherivee meesthakunnash fa'idhaa 'aa'i kamiyab huri dhuvaheve.) 'adhi llWahu 'ash 'eemaanve SaliH `amal kuri meehaa dhanna'eve. hamakashavarun 'emeehaage kushfaafatha' thimanraskalaage fu'sava'i - 'adhi 'ethanthaage dhashun 'aarutha' dhemidhemi 'onna suvaruge thakakash thimanraskalaange 'emeehaa va'dhavaa husheemeve. 'efadha meehun 'ethaa 'abadhu dhemithibeyne'eve. boduvegenvaa naseebakee 'e'ee'eve.
'adhi kaafaruve thimanraskalaange 'aayaththa' dhogukuri meehun dhanna'eve. 'emeehunnakee naraka'ige 'ekuverinneve. 'emeehun 'ethaa dhemithibeyne'eve. 'e'ee 'enburi dhiyun nuba'ivegenvaa thanekeve.

'e'ves meehakash 'e'ves baavathe'ge 'udhagule' muSiyba@ 'e' llWahu ge idhn fuLaa'i la'igen menuvee nujehe'eve. ('e'ee llWahu ge qaDa qadaru ga'i nimifa'ivaa kankameve.) 'adhi 'ekankamakee 'efadha'in hingaa kantha'kan dhane llWahu 'ash iyman ve thedhukoshfi meehaadhanna'eve. 'ekalaange 'emeehaage hithash keththerive qaDa qadaru 'ash ruhumuge magudha'kavaa 'ekamash tawfiyq dhe'va'eve. 'adhi llWahu 'ee hurihaa kame' dhenevodigenvaa kalaange'eve.

'adhi kaleymen llWahu 'ash kiyamantherivaasheve! 'adhi kaleymen rasuwl 'aa 'ash kiyamanvaasheve! 'adhi kaleymen kiyamantherinuve 'eburi furagas dhinas (rasuwl 'aage ma'chash 'e'ves kushe' netheve. faruvaale'netheve.) 'ehenee hamakashavarun rasuwl 'aage ma'chash 'othee bayan vegenvaafadha'in 'i'va'idhinumeve.

llWahu 'e'ee 'ekalaange fiyava'i HaqW 'ehen 'e'ves ilh 'aku nuvaa 'e'ka'uvantha kalaange'eve. 'adhi muw'min nge ma'chash wajib vegenvanee hama'ekani llWahu 'ash wakiyl kosh 'ithubaaru kurumeve. baroasaa kurumeve.

'ey 'eemaanve'je meesthakunneyve! hamakashavarun kaleymenge 'anbeennaa'i kaleymenge dhareenge thereyga'i kaleymennashvaa `aduwW n ve'eve. fahe 'eba'imeehunnaa medhu ra'kaatherivaasheve! hushiyaaru vaasheve! 'adhi kaleymen 'emeehunnash ma`af kosh 'emeehunge kushaa'imedhu 'aLa'i nula'i dhookoshla'ifi'yaa ('efadha heyobadhalu llWahu ves kaleymennash dhe'vaane'eve.) fahe hamakashavarun llWahu 'ee ginagina'in faafa fu'savaa, rHm@ le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaange'eve.

hamakashavarun kaleymenge mudhalaa'i dhareennakee fitna@ 'ekeve. imtiHan 'ekeve. kaleymenge goth be'levumekeve. 'adhi llWahu ge HaDra@ ga'ivaa thawab 'aa'i dharuma maa heyovegenve'eve. boduvegenvaa dharuma 'othee 'ekalaange HaDra@ ga'eve. ('e'ee mudhalaa'i dhareenge sababun llWahu 'ash nu'uredhi kiyamantherivee meehunnasheve.)

kaleymen llWahu 'ash taqwa~ verivaasheve. 'ekalaange HaDra@ 'ash biruvethivaasheve! 'e'ee kaleymennash kuLadhaanaveevarakasheve. 'adhi kaleymennash kurevey 'amr tha' 'ahaasheve! 'adhi 'amr thakash kiyamantherivaasheve! 'adhi 'ekalaange dhe'vaafa'ivaa mudhalun heyokantha'thakash heydhakuraasheve! 'e'ee ha'thaaves kaleymenge nafs thakashvaa heveve. 'ebahee heyokanthakash heydhakurumee kaleymennashvaa heveve. 'adhi thimaage nafs ge dhahivethikamun salaamathvevi'je meehun dhanna'eve! fahe kamiyab ve naseebuverivaaney meehunnakee 'e'ee'eve.

heyo rangaLugothuga'i llWahu 'ash dharani dhennyaa 'ekalaange kaleymennash 'eyge badhalu ginakoshdhe'vaa hu'teve. 'adhi 'ekalaange kaleymenge faafa fu'savaa hu'teve. 'adhi llWahu 'ee kiyamantherivaa 'aLunnash thawab 'aa'i dharuma 'ithurukoshdhe'vaa kalaange'eve. 'adhi 'uredhey 'aLunnash `uquwba@ 'avas nukura'vaa raskalaange'eve.

'adhi 'ekalaange'ee Gaybu ga'i vaa kanthakaa'i fa'uLuga'ivaa kantha' dhenevodigenvaa gadhafadhavantha 'adhi Hikma@ vantha kalaange'eve.
dhanna'eve. heyogothuga'i dharani dhinumakee ikhlaS therikamaa'eku heyohithun thimaage mudhaa llWahu ge maguga'i heydhakurumeve. wallWahu 'a`lamu.

'ey nabi'yaa'eve. (mi 'aayathun nabi'yaa'ash mukhaTab kura'vaafa'i 'othas basfuLun murad kurevenee muLi 'umWa@ 'aa'i'ekuga 'eve. 'aayathuge siyaqu n 'ekan rangaLash haamave'eve.) dhen 'e'angavanee, thiyaba'imeehun 'anhenun varikurannyaa 'ekanbalunge `idWa@ ge kureekoLuga'i varikuraasheve. 'e'ee HayD n Tahir vumashfahu 'ekanbalunnaa jima`u nuve varikurumeve.) 'adhi kaleymen `idWa@ rangaLash hisaabukosh baraabaru kuraasheve. 'adhi kaleymen llWahu 'ash biruvethivaasheve. 'e'ee kaleymenge rabW 'eve. (dhenfahe kaleymen 'ekanbalun varikoshfi'yaa) 'ekanbalun (firimeehaage) ge'in nunereysheve. 'adhi 'ekanbalunves ge'in nunikunna hu'teve. 'ekamaku 'e'ee 'ekanbalun bayan vegenvaa faHish kame' genas nugathi'yaa'eve. (fahe 'e'ee ziney kurun kahala - nuvatha dhoonuba'ikamun geyga'i 'uLey meehunnash 'udhagoovun kahala kankameve. fahe 'efadha kame' koshfi'yaa dhen 'ekanbalun ge'in nerunas kushe' netheve.) 'adhi 'e'ee, ('ebahee mi'engevunthakakee) llWahu ge HadW thakeve. 'ekalaange 'inthakeve. 'adhi llWahu ge HadW tha' fahana'aLa'idhaa meehaa hamakashavarun 'emeehaa 'emeehaage nafs 'ash 'aniyaaverive'je'eve. (fahe 'ekanbalun `idWa@ hamavandhen firimeehaage geyga'i 'inumun) dhen llWahu 'ufa'dhavaa kame' niyaakura'vaa gothe' kaleymenakash neygeyne'eve. 'edhuvasvaru llWahu kame' niyaakura'va'ifaane'eve.
dhanna'eve. llWahu kame' medhuveri kura'vaa niyaakure'vumuge murad 'e'kamuga'i mithaaga'i mivanee `idWa@ ge dhuvasvaru firimeehaage geyga'i varikuri 'anhenaa 'inumun firihen meehaa 'ash gina vaguthu 'eynaa feni 'alunves 'edhemeehun dhemedhu llWahu guLun 'ufa'dhava'i dhe'va'ifaane'eve. firimeehaage hithash loabiverikan vadhe 'alun dhemeehun guLeynegoth medhuveri vedhaane'eve. 'egoth heyovegenve'eve. la`alWa llWaha yuHdithu ba`da dhalika 'amran mibasfuLun muraadhukurevenee 'ekanthakeve. wallWahu 'a`lamu.

fahe 'ekanbalunge `idWa@ hamavaan gaathve'je'yaa rangaLu gothuga'i 'ekanbalun hifaha'taasheve. ('ebahee 'ekanbalunnash 'undhagoo kurumakaa'i nula'i 'ekanbalunnaa'eku 'alunves loabivethikamaa maSlaHa@ 'aa'eku 'uLumash 'ekanbalun rujuw` kuraasheve. 'anthbakash hadhaasheve.) nuvatha rangaLu gothuga'i 'ekanbalun dhookoshlaasheve. 'adhi 'e dhegothunkure konme gothe'ga'ives kaleymen `adl veri dhe hekin la'i hekiveri kuruvaasheve. 'adhi hekiverin ikhlaS therikamaa'eku llWahu 'ashtaka'i hekibas qay'im kuraasheve. 'adhi llWahu 'ashaa'i akhira@ dhuvahash iyman vaa meehakash 'ekalaange naSiyHa@ 'aa'i wa`Z dhe'vanee 'efadha'inneve. 'adhi llWahu 'ash taqwa~ verive'je meehaa'ash 'enaa 'ash jehifa'ivaa 'undhagulaa dhathin nukunnaane konmeves mage' llWahu la'vaa hu'teve.

'adhi 'eynaa 'ash heeves nuvaa gothgothun 'eynaa'ash rizq dhe'va'eve. 'adhi llWahu 'ash wakiyl kosh baroasaakoshfi meehaa dhanna'eve. 'ekalaange 'eynaa'ash fudheyne'eve. nuvatha 'ekalaange 'eynaa'ash fu'dhava'idhe'vaane'eve. 'ehenee hamakashavarun llWahu 'ekalaange 'amr fuLutha' hingava'eve. tanfiydh kura'va'eve. ('e'akash 'e'ves meehakash hu'tume' neyruveyne'eve.) 'adhi hamakashavarun llWahu konme 'e'chakashves 'adhi konme kamakashves minvare' le'vi'eve. 'adhi vaguthe'ves le'vi'eve. ('undhagulakashves 'ekan nimeyne vaguthe' le'vi'eve. 'adhi 'e 'undhagoo vaane vare'ves le'vi'eve. faseyhayashves nimeyne vaguthe' le'vi'eve. 'adhi faseyha vaane vare'ves minvaru kure'vi'eve.)

('ey muw'min nneyve!) thiyaba'imeehunge 'anhenunkure muskuLivumuge sababun HayD vumaa'i medhu muLin naa'unmeedhu vefa'ivaa 'anhenunge `idWa@ 'aa'imedhu thiyaba'imeehun sha'kuve'je'yaa dhanna'eve. fahe 'ekanbalunge `idWa@ 'akee thin masdhuvaheve. 'adhi `umur Lavumuge sababun HayD vaa `umur 'ash nufoaraa thibey 'anhenkudheenge `idWa@ 'akeeves thinmasdhuvaheve. maabandu 'anhenunge `idWa@ 'akee 'enaage vihe'umeve. vihe'umun `idWa@ hamavee'eve. 'adhi llWahu ge 'amurufuLuthakash kiyamanve 'ekalaange nahee thakun dhuruve 'ekalaange 'ash taqwa~ verive'je meehaa dhanna'eve. llWahu 'eynaage kanthakuga'i fahi kamaa'i faseyhakan la'va'eve.

misoorathuga'i 'isvedhiya vaahaka thakakee kaleymenge ma'chash baava'ila'vaafa'ivaa 'ekalaange 'amr fuLuthakeve. 'e 'amr fuLuthakash kiyamantherive taqwa~ verive'je meehaage kushfaafatha' llWahu 'eynaa 'ash fu'sava'idhe'vaane'eve. 'adhi akhira@ ga'i 'eynaa'ash boduvegenvaa dharuma 'aa'i thawab dhe'vaa hu'teve.

ruj`iy varin kaleymen varikuri 'anhen meehaa'ash 'eynaa 'innaanethan kaleymen dheysheve! 'e'ee kaleymenves dhiri'uLey fenvarakunneve. kaleymenge thanavaskanhuri minvarakunneve. ('eynaa'ash nafaqa@ ves 'ebahee ka'ibo'i hedhey minvaruves dheysheve. 'adhi 'eynaa'ash dhathikurumashtaka'i kaleymen 'eynaa'ash 'undhagoo nukuraasheve. ('e'ee `idWa@ hamavaan ka'iriveemaa rujuw` koshfa'i 'alunves varikurumeve. 'ehen nuhadhaasheve. 'eyrun 'alunves 'eynaa `idWa@ fasha'igen hamakuranjeheyne'eve.) 'adhi varikurevunu 'anhen meehaa'akee maabandu meehe'nama 'eynaa vihaandhen 'eynaa'ash kharadu ves kuraasheve. dhenfahe 'eynaa viha'igen dharifuLash kirudheynama 'ekamuge 'ujuwr 'eynaa'ash dheysheve. 'adhi kaleymen dhemeehun dhemedhu rangaLu gothuga'i mashwara@ kosh hamaja'saasheve. 'adhi dhemeehunge dhemedhu khilaf ve 'e'basnuvevi konme faraathakashves 'undhagoove'je'yaa 'e dharifuLash 'ehenmeehaku la'igen kirudheysheve.

'adhi 'e kiruma'innash thanavaskanhuri meehunge thanavaskamun heydhakuraasheve. 'adhi 'emeehakash rizq dhathive'je meehaa, 'athmathi dhathimeehaa 'eynaa'ash llWahu dhe'vaafa'ivaa minvarakun heydhakuraasheve. kharadu kuraasheve. 'adhi 'e'ves nafs 'akash llWahu 'e nafs 'akash dhe'vi 'e'che'ge takliyf noonee nuja'sava'eve. 'adhi nikanhure 'undhagulakashfahu faseyha'e' llWahu la'vaane'eve.

'adhi kitha'kitha' rashrash 'era'rashuge rabW ge 'amr fuLuthashaa'i 'ekalaage rasuwl nnash nukiyamantherivi he'yeve? ('ebahee varash ginarashrashuge meehun 'e rashrashuge rabW 'ashaa'i 'ekalaange rasuwl nnash nukiyamantherivi'eve.) dhenfahe thimanraskalaange 'emeehunnaamedhu varash gadhavegenvaa hisaabakun hisaabu be'leveemeve. gadhavegenvaa `adhab 'akun 'emeehunnash `adhab dhe'veemeve.
fahe 'erashrashuge 'ahuluverin 'emeehunge kaafaru kamaa'i nukiyamantherikamuge raha libigatheve. 'adhi 'emeehunge akhir nimumakashvee ge'lumaa'i halaakeve.

'emeehunnash (qiyama@ dhuvahun) gadhavegenvaa `adhab 'e' tha'yaaru kure'vi'eve. 'ey iyman vegenvaa bu'dhiverinneyve. kaleymen 'ash taqwa~ verivaasheve. biruvethivaasheve. hamakashavarun kaleymennash dhikr 'e' baava'ila'va'ifi'eve.

'e dhikr 'akee rasuwl 'aa'eve. 'e rasuwl 'aa kaleymenge ma'chash ge bayan vegenvaa 'aayaththa' kiyavaa vidhaaLuve dhe'va'eve. 'e'ee iyman vegen SaliH `amal kuri meesthakun (kaafarukamaa'i shirk ge) 'andhirikamun neru'va'i (iyman kamaa hidaya@ ge) 'alikamuge there'ash ve'dhumasheve. 'adhi 'ash iyman ve SaliH `amal kuri meesthakun (dhanna'eve.) 'ethanthaange dhashun 'aarutha' dhemidhemi 'onna bageechaathakash (suvarugethakash) thimanraskalaange 'emeehun va'dhavaa husheemeve. 'emeehun 'ethanthaaga'i 'abadhee gothe'ga'i dhemithibeyne'eve. hamakashavarun 'emeehunnash rangaLu rizq dhe'vi'eve. 'emeehunge rizq rangaLukure'vi'eve.

'ee hath 'udu he'dhevi kalaange'eve. 'adhi bimunves 'evarash he'dhevi'eve. ('ebahee hath bin he'dhevi'eve.) 'adhi 'edhemedhuga'i 'ekalaange waHiy ge 'amr fuLutha' hinga'eve. ('ebahee 'uduthakaa'i binthakaa'i 'adhi 'edhemedhuga'ivaa khalq thakunnash 'ekalaange 'amr fuLu hingava'eve.) 'ekan 'efadha'in la'vaafa'ivanee hamakashavarunves konme kame'ge ma'chash kuLadhunvanthavevodigenvaakamaa'i 'adhi konme 'e'che'ves 'ekalaange dhenevodigenvaakan kaleymennash 'engevumashtaka'eve.

'ey nabiy 'aa'eve! 'anbi'anbikanbalun ru'sevumuge gothun llWahu kaleygefaanash Halal kura'vaafa'ivaa thakethi Haram kura'vanee kee'vethoa'eve? 'adhi llWahu 'ee ginagina'in faafa fu'savaa raHma@ le'vun boduvegenvaa kalaange'eve.

'adhi kaleymenge huva'in Halal veganevey goth llWahu kaleymennash sharu` koshdhe'va'ifi'eve. kanda'aLu'va'i dhe'va'ifi'eve. ('e'ee may'ida@ suwra@ ge vana 'aayathuga'ivaa fadha'inneve.) 'adhi llWahu 'ee kaleymenge veriyaa'eve. saharoaveriyaa'eve. 'ekalaange'ee 'aLuthakunge 'enmehaa kantha' dhenevodigenvaa Hikma@ vantha kalaange'eve.

'adhi nabiyWu llWahi 'ekaleygefaanuge ba'e' 'anbi'anbikanbalunge 'arihu vaahaka'e' si'rukure'vihindhu dhen 'ekamanaa 'evaahaka 'ehen beykanbalakash khabar kure'vumun 'ekamuge khabar ('ebahee 'e khabar kure'vumuge khabar) dhe'vumun, llWahu ta`ala~ 'ekan 'ekaleygefaanash 'angava'i fa'uLukura'va'ifi'eve. dhen 'ekaleygefaanu ('e 'anbikanbalunnash) 'eyge ba'e' vaahaka 'angava'i, 'adhi 'ane'ba'i vaahaka naangava'i vanhanaa kura'va'ifi'eve. dhen 'ekaleygefaanu 'evaahaka 'ekamanaa'ash 'engevumun 'ekamanaa vidhaaLuvi'eve. kaleygefaanash thiya khabar 'engevee kaakuthoa'eve. 'ekaleygefaanu Hadiyth kure'vi'eve. 'ahurennash 'e khabar dhe'vee 'enmehaa kantha' dhenevodigenvaa khabar dhe'vaa kalaange'eve.
dhanna'eve. mi 'aayaththa' baava'ile'vumuge munaasabathu dhethingothakash tafsiyru `ilm verin bayan kura'vaafa'ive'eve. 'eygethere'in 'enme mashhuwr goth dhaadhi kudakosh nakalu koshlameve. nabiy 'aa 'aa'i 'ekaleygefaanuge ba'e' 'anbi'anbikanbalunge medhuga'i hinga'idhiya kamakashvaathee 'efaraaththakash 'ekasheegennuvaa kushbahe' bunevi'jenama llWahu ge HaDra@ n haas fashun `afuw 'aa'i maGfira@ 'ash 'edhey Hal ga'eve. 'evaahaka'ige khulaSa@ 'akee: (maath llWahu 'ekamanaa'ash ru'sunle'vi HafSa@ gefaanunge dhaanmathikoLuga'i rasuwl 'ekaleygefaanuge jaariyaa mariya@u lqibTiyWa@ 'aa'i'eku 'e'dhaankure'vi kamuga'ivi'eve.
