'e'ee 'emeehun (dhuniyeyga'i thibegenkuri nuba'i`amalu thakuge) furihamajazaa'e'ge gothunneve.
hamakashavarun 'emeehunvee dhuniyeyga'i 'uLunu'iru qym@ dhuvahun hisaabu be'levumaa'imedhu birunugannabayaku kamuga'eve. 'ekamashneydhey bayakukamuga'eve.
'adhi'emeehunvee thimanraskalaange 'aayaththa' kanda'eLigen dhogukuribayaku kamuga'eve.
'adhi konmekame' 'adhi konme'e'che' thimanraskalaange 'e'e'che' li'u'va'ihimanu'vameve. ('e'ee 'ekalaange 'azaluge dhenevodigathumuga'ivaagothasheve.)

'adhi narakavanthaverinnash qym@ dhuvanuh naraka'ige `dhb libemundhaahidhu 'emeehunnash 'engeyne'eve. kaleymen `dhb gerahalibigannaasheve. `dhb gema'chash `dhb menuvee kaleymenash thimanraskalaange 'ithuru nukura'vaahusheemeve.
hamakashavarun taqwa~ verinnash 'edhevey naseebaa'i kaamiyaabu ve'eve.
'e'ee bageechaa thakaa'i 'adhi meybis kadhureve. (suvaruge thakaa'i 'ethanthaage `adhadhu nukurevey ni`matheve.)
'adhi reethi varash 'uramathi 'ufulifa'ivaa 'e' `umure'ge reethi 'anhen kudhinneve.
'adhi furifa'ivaa raluge thashithakeve. (nuvatha vidhividhigen 'anna raathashithakeve.)
'emeehun 'esuvarugeyga'i thibey'iru 'eves baTil vaahaka'e' naahaane'eve. 'adhi'e'ves dhoge'viyas nu'ahaane'eve.
('ey rasuwl llh 'eve!) 'e'ee kaleygefaanunge rabWu ge HaDra@u n 'emeehunnash dhe'vaa dharuma'e'ge gothun dhe'vaa dhe'vumekeve. fudheyvaru hadhiyaa'e'ge gothun dhe'vaa `inaamekeve.

'ekalaange'ee 'uduthakaa'i bimaa'i 'adhi 'edhemedhuga'i vaahaathaketheege rabWu 'eve. 'e'ee 'enmeha'i khalqu thakunnash 'ekalaange rahhmath `aa'muvegenvaa raHman vantha kalaange'eve. ('ekalaange 'izunafuLu nethis) 'ekalaange'ash basfuLe' dhannava'i vaahaka'e' dhe'kevumuge hu'dha'e' hama 'ekakashves 'edhuvahun milkuvegen nuve'eve.

'edhuvahakee -'ebahee qyam@ dhuvahakee- ruwH 'aa'i malaa'ikath beykalun safakash thedhuvevada'igannavaane dhuvaheve. 'edhuvahun 'emeehaku vaahakadhe'kumash, bahe'dhennevumash, ('ebahee shafa`a@ therivevada'igathumash) raHmn vantha kalaange 'izuna dhe'vi meehaku menuvee 'ekakuves bahe' bune vaahakadha'kaa nuhadhaane'eve. 'adhi 'e 'izuna dhe'veymeehakee 'emeehaa dhuniyeyga'i 'uLunu'iru seedhaa basbunimeehakukamuga'ivaane'eve. 'ebahee tawHyd 'ash hekivimeehaku kamuga'i vaane'eve. ('enoon meehakash shafa`a@ therivevada'igathumuge 'izuna 'edhuvahunnoannaane'eve.)
dhanna'eve. mi'aayathuga'i bayaanvegenmivaa ruwH 'akaa'imedhu mufasWir nge bas thafaathuvegenve'eve. 'e'ee ha'ibabodu malaa'ikath beykalakukamuga'i buneve'eve. 'adhi 'e'ee jibryl kamuga'i buneve'eve. 'adhi 'e'ee adm ge dharinge furaanathash kamuga'i buneve'eve. veemaa mivaahaka handhaankoshdhinee'eve.

'edhuvahakee hha'qu vegenvaa dhuvaheve. dhenfahe 'emeehaage rabWu ge HaDra@ 'ash dhi'umash 'adhi 'ekalaange HaDra@ n rangaLu jaaga'e' hoadhan'edheymeehaa (SlH `ml koshgen) 'e maqaamu hoadhaa hushikameve.

hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange thiyaba'imeehunnash indhr kosh mibirugannavanee dhaadhigaathuga'ivaa `dhb 'e'ge vaahaka'inneve. ('e `dhb ga'i nujehumashtaka'eve. konme meehakuves maruvumun 'ekan feshunee'eve. 'ehennyaa `dhb 'eve. 'ehennyaa 'araameve.) fahe 'e qyam@ dhuvahakee konme 'insaanakashves 'emeehaa dhe'ath 'iskurikame' ('ebahee 'emeehaa koshfa'ivaa `ml'e' hevas nubayas) 'emeehaage kurimashchash 'annaaneydhuvaheve. 'e `ml thakash 'eynaa balaane'eve. 'adhi kaafarumeehaa 'eynaa'ash huri `dhb 'aa'i nura'kaa bodukamun 'eynaa bunaane'eve. 'ahuren ve'yash veenama kihaarangaLu he'yeve. 'ahuren ve'yash vaanenama'eve.
dhanna'eve. qyam@ dhuvahun ta`l~ 'enmehaa janavaaru thake'ge medhuga'ives `dl 'ash niyaakura'va'i 'esorumen ve'yash ha'dhavaanekamuga'i ve'eve. 'ethandhekefa'i kaafaru meehaaves ve'yash vaan 'edheynekamuga'i ve'eve. wallhu '`lam.
kaafarunnaa'i nuba'i nulafaameehunge furaanatha' 'emeehun maruvaa vaguthu gadhafadha kamaa'i'eku 'emeehunge hashithakun dhama'igannavaa malaa'ikathbeykalun gandhe'vava'i huva'i waHiy kura'va'eve.
'adhi heevagikamaa'i 'oagaaverikamaa'i 'eku mu'uminunge furaanatha''ehashithakun vaki kura'vaa malaa'ikath beykalun gandhe'vava'i huva'i waHiy kura'va'eve.
'adhi ge 'amurufuLaa'igen 'udun 'avas'avahash fa'ibaavada'igannavaa malaa'ikathbeykalun gandhe'vava'i huva'i wHy kura'va'eve.
fahe mw'mn nge furaanathakaa'igen suvarugeyash 'avasvevada'igannnavaa malaa'ikathbeykalun gandhe'va'i huva'i waHiy kura'va'eve.

dhuniyeyge kantha' thadhubeeru kure'vumaa'igen ge HaDra@ n fa'ibaa vada'igannnavaa malaa'ikath beykalun gandhe'va'i waHiy kura'va'eve. dhanna'eve. mimuhi'mu fasfaraath gandhe'va'i huva'i waHiy kura'vanee hamakashavarun kaleymen maruvumashfahu 'alundhiru'va'i maHshar kura'va'i dhuniyeyga'i koshfa'ivaa `amaluthakuge khabaru 'angava'i 'e'ashfurihama jazaadhe'vaane kamasheve. 'e'ee nuvenudhaaneykamekeve. mi'ee 'ehuva'ithakuge javaabeve. veemaa 'ekankan 'egothash hingavaane'eve.
'e'ee furathama thaaLafili fumele'veydhuvaheve. ('edhuvahun gadhavegenvaa binhelume''a'is 'enmehaathakethi maruve fanaavegen higa'idhaane'eve.)
dhen'eyaa vidhigen dhevana thaaLafili funmava'i la'vaane'eve. 'edhemedhuga'i saaLees 'aharuvaanekamashHadiyth ga'i SaHWa kosh'a'isfa'ive'eve.
'edhuvahun ba'e'meehunge hiththa'biruverikan boduve haasvegenvaane'eve. 'e'eenuba'i nulafaameehunge hiththakeve.
'adhi 'emeehunge loatha'hunnaanee jehenhuri museebaathuge bodukamun dherave fenkaLive hithaamaverivefa'eve.

'efadhameehun dhuniyeyga'i 'uLunu'iru rasoolubeykalunvada'igen dheenashgova'ila'vaa 'adhi qyam@ 'ash fonu'vaa vaahaka vidhaaLuveemaa 'emeehun bunanee 'ahuremen dhendhirigen dhevanafaharashves 'annaaney he'e'yeve? 'e'ee malaamaathash bunaabunumekeve. 'adhi bune'eve. 'e'ee 'e'gothakashves vaaneykame'nooneve.
'ahuremen maruvegos kashitha'feeve 'aLi'ashveemaa 'alun dhirigen dhevanafaharashmaHsharkureveynehe'ye?

'ehenkamashvannyaa 'e'ee varashves ge'lun boduvegenvaa 'e'kure'vumekeve. ('emeehun 'ehen 'ebunanee malaamaathkurumuge gothunnaa'i 'inkaaru kurumuge gothunneve.) 'eyge javaabuga'i 'e waHiy kura'vanee 'annanivi fadha'inneve.
'ekan kanvaanekan kashavaree 'enmefaharaku thaaLafili funmavaale'vume'kamuga'eve. 'ebahee meesthakundhirigenthedhuvunvaanee 'enme faharaku thaaLafili funmavaale'vumunneve. 'e'ee dhevanathaaLafi'yeve.

'eha'irun 'enmeha'i meesthakun thibeynee bimugethere'in nukume bimuge matheega'eve. loatha'huLuva'igen balabala'eve. nunidhaane'eve. 'ebimashkiyanee sahir@ 'eve. 'ebimash'enanki'uneeves meesthakun 'egothash nunidha'i thibeytheekamuga'eve. 'adhi 'e'ee rihikula'ige bime'kamuga'i bunevuneve. wallhu '`lam * dhanna'eve. misoorath feshunuthaaga'ivaa walnWazi`ati - walnWashiTati - walsWabiHati - falsWabiqati - falmudabWirati mifaskalima'aa'imedhu mufasWiru nge basthafaathuvegenve'eve. thafaathugothgothash bunevifa'i ve'eve. 'aLugadu liyefa'i mivanee ginabeykalun vidhaaLuvigotheve. namaves...
* ba'e'beykalun vidhaaLuvefa'ivanee 'e'ee 'insaanaage nafusuge fashhaalathukamuga'eve. * 'ane'ba'ibeykalunvidhaaLuvanee 'e'ee marukamuga'eve. * 'ane'ba'ibeykalunvidhaaLuvanee'e'ee tharitharikamuga'eve. 'adhiminoon gothgothashves bunevifa'ive'eve. 'adhi 'e'inkonme bahakashves tawjiyh 'e've'eve. 'evaahakatha' 'ehenvaguthakun dhannavaanee'eve. * konme'akas dhevanafaharash dhirigen maHshr 'ash fonu'vemuge ma'sala dhogukuri meehun 'adhi dhogukuramundhaameehun varash gina'eve. 'isvedhiya 'm@ thakuga'ives rasuwl beykalun dhogukurumash dhimaavi 'enme bodu ma'sala'akee 'e'ee 'eve. qiym@ dhogukurumeve. 'ehennamaves 'e'ee dhuvaaluge 'irashvure 'aligadha dhaleelu hurikamekeve. `aql~ dhaleelaa'i naql~ dhaleeleve. dhuniyeyge mi'o'bodu kaarukhaanaaga'ives natheejaa'e' 'onnanvaane'eve. kudhikudhi kaarukhaanaathakuga'ives gadiyash faruvaabaha'taameehunnaa baraabarash masa'kath kuraameehunnash bodu 'ujoora dhe'vun 'ove'eve. 'e'ee 'enmen dhannakamekeve. 'ehenvee'iru mi kaarukhaanaaga'ives rangaLash masa'kathkuri meehunnaa'i faruvaabehe'ti meehunnash mathee dharaja hunnaanekamee sha'ke' huri kame'nooneve. faruvaakudakosh gadiyashaa'i masa'kathash makaru hedhi meehunnash musaara'in kendenjeheyne'eve. 'ekan 'onnaanee 'aharee ripoat 'i'vaa dhuvahunneve. 'e'ee qiym@ dhuvaheve. vanavana'ash 'inaamaa'i kushverinnash 'adhabu 'onnanjeheynekan salaamath bu'dhi'akash vi'yaa qaboolu kureveyne'eve. mi'i `aql~ dhaleeleve. naql~ dhalee 'adhi'ehaagina'eve.

'ey (rasuwl llh'eve!) hamakashavarun `imranu gedharikalun muwsa~ `alayhi lsWalam ge khabaru kaleygefaanunge 'arihash 'athuve'je'eve. nuvatha 'evaahaka kaleygefaanunge 'arihash 'athuve'jethoa'eve? (midhegothashves maanakura'vaafa'ive'eve.)
'e'ee 'ekaleygefaanunge rabWu Tuwa~ 'evekiyey muqadWas barakaaththeri vaadheega'i 'ekaleygefaanash nidhaa 'i'vevihidhuga'eve.
'ey muwsa~ `alayhi lsWalam 'eve. kaleygefaanu fr`wn ge gaathash rasoolukamaa'igen vada'igannavaasheve. hamakashavarun 'eynaa vanee bodaave nukiyamantheri vegenneve.

'adhikaleygefaanun 'eynaage gaathashvada'igen vidhaaLuvaasheve. ('ey fir`awnu 'eve.) manikufaanu fahe shirukukure'vun dhookoshla'va'i 'adhi nuba'i kantha'tha'dhookosh la'va'i Tahir vevada'inugannavaanuthoa'eve? (llh ta`ala~ muwsa~ `alayh lsWalam 'ash 'angavaafa'ivanee ma'ithiribahun 'enaa'aa'imedhu vidhaaLuvumasheve.)
(muwsa~ `alayh lsWalam fir`awnu 'ash vidhaaLuvi'eve.) 'ahuren manikufaanunge rabWu gefaraathash manikufaanash magudha'kavaahusheemeve. 'eyrun 'ekalaange'ash biruvethivada'igathun 'ekasheegenve'eve.
fahe muwsa~ `alayh lsWalam 'eynaa'ash boduvegenvaa mu`jiza@ dhe'kevi'eve. 'e'ee 'ekaleygefaanunge 'asaakoLu kamuga'i 'adhi 'athpuLukamuga'i bunevuneve.
fahe 'eynaa muwsa~ `alayh lsWalam gerasoolukan dhogukosh llh 'ash 'uredhi'je'eve.
dhen 'eynaa 'eemaankamash furagasdheefi'eve. 'adhi muwsa~ `alayh lsWalam 'aa'i 'idhikoLash masa'kathkuranfasha'ifi'eve.
, dhenfahe 'eynaameesthakun 'e'kosh jamaakuri'eve. 'adhi meesthakunnash 'eynaagova'ilee " 'ahurennakee kaleymenge 'enme mathee rabWu 'eve. " mifadha'inneve.
, dhenfahe 'eynaameesthakun 'e'kosh jamaakuri'eve. 'adhi meesthakunnash 'eynaagova'ilee " 'ahurennakee kaleymenge 'enme mathee rabWu 'eve. " mifadha'inneve.

fahe llh ta`ala~ 'eynaa hithpava'ifi'eve. halaaku kura'va'ifi'eve. (kanduga'i Garaqu kura'va'igenneve.) 'e'ee 'eynaabunidhebahe'ge sababunneve. (ma`alimtu lakum min lahin Gayri~ mibahaa'i 'ana rabWukumu l'a`la~ mibaheve.)
hamakashavarun 'ekankamuga'i 'ebahee fir`awnu ge Ha ditha@ ga'i llh 'ashbiruvethivaa bayakash `ibra@ 'aa'i wa`Zu naSiyHa@ ve'eve.

(qyam@ dhuvasdhogukosh 'ekamash 'inkaarukuraa 'enmenneyve.) 'udhagoovefa'i burakamakashvaanee dhevanafaharash kaleymen ha'dhava'i maHsharu kure'vun he'yeve? nuvatha 'udu he'dhevunhe'yeve? ('e'vesmisaale'nethi 'insaanaaha'dhava'i 'eynaage kantha' baraabaru kure'vi kalakash 'eynaamaruvumashfahu dhevanafaharash ha'dhava'i maHsharu kure'vun maafaseyhavaanekan konme salaamath bu'dhi'aka rangaLash'engeyne'eve. mihenee mi'o'bodethi 'udutha'mihaafurihakosh badhahikosh he'dhevun 'insaanaa he'dhevumashvure maa'udhagoovefa'i baruvaane'eve. 'adhi mi'in 'e'veskamakee llh ta`ala~ 'ashdhathikame'nooneve.)
'ekalaange 'udu 'uskura'va'i bimuge furaaLe'fadha'in le'vi'eve. 'adhi'e'uduge hurihaakame'baraabaru kure'vi'eve.
'adhi'e'uduge reygadu 'adhirikura'va'i 'adhi dhuvaalu 'alikosh faaLukoshneru'vi'eve.
'uduhe'dhevumashfahu dhen 'ekalaange binfethuru'vevi'eve.
'adhi bingandugethere'in fennukunnaaneygoth ha'dhava'i 'adhi fathpilaaveli 'ethaafeLu'vi'eve.
'adhi bingandu nugudeyneygothun 'ebimuga'i 'ekalaange farubadhatha' je'sevi'eve.
('ey'insaanunneyve.) mihurihaakamakeeves kaleymennaa'i kaleymenge na`am soofithakuge manfaa'e'ge gothunvaa kankameve.
dhenfahe thaaLafili funmava'i la'va'ifi'yaa ('e'ee dhevanathaaLafi'yeve.)
'edhuvahun 'insaanaa kashvaLun nukume 'eynaadhuniyeyga'i kurihaakame' hadhaankuraane'eve. 'adhi meesthakunge `amalutha'hunnaanee liyevi 'emeehunge kurimatheehaamavegenneve.

'adhi dhekeymeehaku dhushumash naraka faaLukureveyne'eve. (fahe mu'uminumeehaa 'enarakafenumun llh 'eynaa'ash dhe'vaafa'ivaa ginaguna ni`ma@ hadhaankosh 'enaraka'in salaamathveekamuge 'ufaakuraane'eve. 'adhi kaafarumeehaa 'enaage hithaama'igema'chash hithaama'ithuruvaane'eve.)
fahe kaafarukamaa'i 'uredhumuga'i ha'dhufahana'aLa'ifimeehaadhanna'eve.
'adhi'enaage akhira@u gekanthakashvure dhuniyeygekantha' 'iskurimeehaa,
hamakashavarun 'enaagos 'onnaanethanakee naraka'eve.

'adhi thimaa ha'dhavaabodukure'vi rabWu ge HaDra@u ga'i qiyama@ dhuvahun hunnanjeheyne magaamakaa'imedhu biruvethive 'adhi thimaage nafusu 'enmeha'i 'uredhunthakun dhurukosh manaakoshfimeehaa dhanna'eve.
fahe 'eynaa qiyama@ dhuvahun hamajehi hunnaanethanakee suvaruge'eve. 'adhi'ethaage ni`ma@ thakeve.
('ey rasuwlu llh 'eve.) qiyama@ vaane vaguthakaa'imedhu 'emeehun kaleygefaanaa'i suvaalu kure'eve.
'ehennamaves 'evaahaka kaleygefaanaadhe'kumuge dhen'otheekon kame'he'yeve?
'ekamuge 'enmeha'i 'egume'vanee hamakashavarun kaleygefaanunge rabWu ge HaDra@u ga'eve. 'ehen 'e'ves faraathakash 'ekanneygeyne'eve.
kaleygefaanunvaakan kashavaree 'edhuvahashbiruvethivaameekash 'edhuvahuge biruverikamuge khabarudhe'vaa beykalaku kamuga'eve.

'e qiyama@ dhuvahuge biruverikan fennahidhu 'emeehun konfadha he'yeve. 'emeehunnash heevaanee 'emeehun dhuniyeyga'i 'uLunee dhuvaale'ge haveerugevaguthukoLe'ga'ihenneve. nuvatha dhuvaale'ge hedhunuge vaguthukoLe'ga'ihenneve.
(rswl llh ) moonufuLu huthuru kurashva'i ruhi vada'i nugen 'enburi vada'igenfi'eve.

'e'ee 'ekaleygefaanunge 'arihash 'andhiri meehaku 'a'ihindhunneve. ('e'ee 'eynaa'ashvure bodethi bayakash 'islaamdheenash gova'i la'va'i 'emeehun 'islaamvuge sha'uqu ga'i 'innevi vaguthe'ga'eve.) 'ekamaamedhu ta`al~ `itabu ge basfuLu 'i'vavanee'eve.
('ey rswl llh 'eve!) 'emeehaa 'eemaan nuvaanekame' kaleygefaanash 'angava'i dhe'vee kon'e'che' thoa'eve? 'adhi ki'e'he'yeve? 'eynaa 'eemaanve Tahiru vegathun 'u'meedhu kureve'eve.
nuvatha 'eynaa wa`Zu naSiyHa@ kaleygefaanunge 'ari'ari'ahun libigenfaane'eve. dhen 'e wa`Zu naSiyHa@ n 'eynaa'ash manfaa koshfaane'eve. ('islaamve maath meehakash vedhaane'eve.)
'ekamaku kaleygefaanunge wa`Zu naSiyHa@ nu'aha'i 'e'infudhigenfi meehaa dhanna'eve. (bunevenee 'e'ee 'abuw jahulu 'aa'i 'ebaavathuge dhethin meehaku kamasheve.)
kaleygefaanun 'eynaayaa kurimathifuLula'va'i vaahakafuLu dha'kavanee 'eve.
'adhi 'eynaa 'eemaanve faafa'in Tahiru ve nugathumun kaleygefaanash 'othee kon ge'lume' thoa'eve? (hamakashavarun kaleygefaanu 'eynaa'ash rasoolukan 'i'va'i 'amaanaath 'adhaa kura'va'ifeemu'eve.)
'adhi kaleygefaanunge 'arihash 'avasvegenvaahhaal 'avas 'avahash'a'imeehaa dhanna'eve.
'eynaa 'a'ee biruvethivegenvaa hhaaluga'eve. ('e'ee `abd llh bn 'm mktwm 'eve.)
dhen fahe kaleygefaanu 'eynaage kiba'in Gafilu ve vada'igen dhuruvevada'igannavanee'eve.
'e'gothakashves 'e'ee 'ekasheegenvaa gothe'nooneve. hamakashavarun mi'aayaththakakee nuvatha misoorathakee nuvatha muLiquran 'akee wa`Zu naSiyHa@ 'eve.
fahe'edheymeehaku 'e'in wa`Zu naSiyHa@ libigannaasheve.
'e'ee maathvegenvaa fathfushthake'ga'i liyevigenvaa 'aayaththakekeve. 'ebahee 'e'aayaththa'baavaathle'vi 'iruvanee lawHu lmaHfuwZu ga'eve.
'e'ee ge HaDra@u ga'iminvaru 'ufuligenvaa maathfothekeve. 'enmeha'i 'unikamakaa'i `aybu 'akun salaamathvegenvaafothekeve. shayTan nnaa'i kaafarunge beehume'nuvaa Tahiru 'aayaththakekeve.
'e'aayaththa' gennavaafa'ivanee ge HaDra@u n rasoolubeykalunge'arihash vada'igannavaa malaa'ikathbeykalunge 'athpuLuthakunneve.
'ebeykalunnakee 'ebeykalunge rabWu 'ash kiyamantherivevada'igenvaa taqwa~verimaathbeykalunneve.
kaafaru 'insaanaa'ash la`na@ levi'je'eve. llh 'eynaa'ash la`na@ la'va'ifi'eve. 'eynaagehuri kaafarukamuge bodukamaa'eve. ('eynaahe'dhevunugothaa'imedhu 'eynaavisnunhu'teve.)
llh 'enaahe'dhevee konfadha dhera'e'chakun he'yeve?

'ekalaange 'eynaa he'dhevee manifodhuvarakunneve. dhenfahe llh 'eynaa furihamakura'va'i baraabarukure'vi'eve. ('enaage gunavanthakaa'i 'iskoLaa'i ga'igekulayaa'i 'adhives 'enmeha'ikame' 'ekalaange furihamakoshdhe'vi'eve.)
dhen 'eynaa 'enaage manmage bandun nukunnaanegothvesfaseyhakosh dhe'vee hama'ekalaange'eve. 'adhi dhuniyeyga'i 'eynaa'uLeyne minvarakaa'i heyonuba'i vakivaanegothdhe'keveeves hama'ekalaange'eve.
dhen'eynaa'ash kanda'eLifa'ivaa `umuruhamavumun 'eynaamarugannava'i kashvaLuga'i 'onnaanegothveshe'dhevee hama'ekalaange'eve.

dhen 'ekalaange 'edhivodigennevi hidhakun 'alun'eynaadhiru'va'i maHsharu 'ash fonu'vaaneeves hama'ekalaange'eve. (fahemifadha'in 'insaanaa ha'dhava'i 'eynaagekantha' furihama niZamu 'e'gemathin gendhavaa mathiverimaath llh 'ash 'e'insaanaa bodaavegathun hha'guvaaneekonfadha'akun he'yeve?)
'e'gothakashves 'ehennuvaane'eve. 'emeehun 'eheekuraagothakash nuvaane'eve. llh 'emeehunnash 'amurukure'vikantha' 'adhimihaathanakash 'emeehun nukure'eve.
fahe 'insaanaa 'enaage kaaboathake'chash visnaafikuru kurun hu'teve.
hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange bimash vaareyve'sevee konfadha'akunhe'yeve? 'adhi'efen bimuga'i khazaanaakure'veemeve.
'adhi gasgahaagehifeLumashtaka'i bimuge veligadufeLu'veemeve.
dhen 'ebimun thimanraskalaange 'ekibaavathbaavathuge gasgahaagehi faLu'va'i 'ekibaavathuge 'oshtaru neru'veemeve.

mibayaanvedhiya meesmeehunnaa'i qa'umu thakakee (`adu baaga'ige meehunnaa'i thamuwdu baaga'ige meehunnaa'i fir`awn 'aa'i 'eynaage qa'umu) mimeehunnakee 'emeehun'uLunu thanthan fasaadhakosh nukiyamantherikamaa'i bodaakamuga'i ha'dhu fahanaLa'igen dhiyabayekeve.
'emeesmeehun 'erashrashuga'i nulafaakanthakaa'i fasaadhakuruntha' gina kuree'eve.
dhenfahe kaleygefaanunge rabWu 'emeehunnash gadhavegenvaa `adhabu dhe'kevi'eve.

dhenfahe kaleygefaanunge rabWu vanee konme meehaku kuraakamakash rangaLash ba'lavaa vodigathun matheega'eve. ('ey mithiba qura'ishunneyve. (mihaaruthibi meesthakunneyve!) basneyheevi'yaa kaleymena'ves hama 'efadhagothe'vedhaane'eve.)

'insaanaage hhaaludhanna'eve. 'eynaage rb 'eynaa mtiHanu kure'vuma'taka'i 'eynaa'ashmaathkosh hi'thava'i 'adhi ni`ma@ dhe'va'ifi'yaa 'eynaabunaane'eve. 'e'ee hama mtiHanu 'eve. dhen'evaguthu 'eynaa llh 'ash shukuru kuran hadhaannethi'jenama 'eynaafe'ilvaane'eve.

'adhi dhanna'eve. 'e'insaanaa mtiHanu kure'vumashtaka'i 'eynaage rb 'eynaage rizuqu madhukura'va'i dhathikura'va'i dherakura'va'ifi'yaa 'enaabunaane'eve. 'adhi 'athmathidhathive fageeruvumakee ge koafaayaa'i `azaabuge dhaleele' nooneve. 'e'ee hama'ekani mu'sandhi meehaa shukuru kureythoa be'levumaa'i fageerumeehaa ke'theriveythoa be'levumekeve. 'adhives 'ekalaange dhenevodigenvaa kantha'thake've'eve.

'insaanaa 'e dhe haaluga'ives ('ebahee faseyhakamaa'i 'athmathi dhathikamuga'ives) 'efadha'in nubunaa hushi kameve. konme hhaalathakeeves 'eynaa kurashvaa 'imthihhaan 'ekeve. 'adhi ki'e'he'yeve. mudhaa gina'in dhevunu meehunves 'eyge hha'qu furihama'ash 'adhaa nukuraa kitha'me ba'ekeve. mudhaadhevunumeehun yathimunnash kaa'ethikoLu nudhineemu'eve.
'adhi kaa'ethikoLu dhinumash meesthakunnash hi'varu nudhemu'eve. thimaamen 'ami'la'a'ves 'ekamash 'edhunverikame' netheemu'eve.

thiyaba'i meehun vaaruthamudhaatha' 'athuvigothakun kanee'eve. kudakudhinnaa 'anhenunge mudhaaves 'emeehunnash nudhee kanee'eve. yatheemunnaa'i nikamethinge mudhaaves kanee'eve. mi'ee 'islaamdheen 'a'umuge kurin kantha' kuramun 'a'i gotheve. kudakudhinnash yatheemunnash 'anhenunnash vaaruthavume' noave'eve. 'ehurihaa mudhaaka'ihadhinee bodethi firihenunneve.
'adhi thiyaba'imeehun mudhalash loabikuranee maa bodasheve.
'e'gothakashves 'efadha'in loabikurun 'ekasheegen nuve'eve. (qiyaamathvumash) bingandu theLigane zalzalaa 'a'is gadhavegenvaa hharakaathakun bingandu hharakaathkosh,

'adhi kaleyfaanu ha'dhavaa bodukure'vi rb ('aLuthakunge medhuga'i fa'isalaa kure'vumash) vodigannava'i 'adhi malaa'ikathbeykalun safusafash (safakashfahu safe') vada'igen mikankan qiyaamath dhuvahunvaane'eve. ('edhuvahash visnaasheve.)

naraka 'edhuvahun geneveyne'eve. dhen 'edhuvahun 'insaanaa- 'ebahee kaafaru 'insaanaa handhaan kuraane'eve. 'eynaa dhuniyeyga'i kuri nulafaakantha'tha' handhaanvaane'eve. 'ekamaku dhen mi'adhu 'ekankan handhaanvumun 'othee kon fa'idhaa'e'he'yeve? kurimatheega'i 'othee gadha `azaabeve.
'adhi 'ehindhu 'eynaa bunaane'eve. 'ahurenge mihhayaathash heyo `amalu 'iskurevununama konfadha rangaLu he'yeve. ('ekamaku dhen hama hus nama 'eve.)
fahe'edhuvahun 'ekalaange `azaabu dhe'vaavarash hama'ekakashves `azaabu nudhe'veyne'eve. `azaabu 'ehaa gadhavaane'eve.
('adhi cheynunnaa'i hilihilaa'in kaafaruntha') 'ekalaange bannavaa varakash hama'ekakashves nubandheveyne'eve. ('evarash bannavaane'eve.)

, maathvegenvaamu'uminunnash qiyama@ dhuvahun nidhaa'i'veyne'eve. 'eemaankamaa'i tawHiyd genoorun 'alive 'ujaalaavegenvaa nafusuge veriyaa'eve. dhe'vi ginaguna savaabaa'i dharuma 'ash ruhigenvaa hhaalu 'adhi 'ekalaange thibaa'ash ruhivodigenvaa hhaalu thibaage rb ge HaDra@ 'ash 'enburi 'annaasheve.

, maathvegenvaamu'uminunnash qiyama@ dhuvahun nidhaa'i'veyne'eve. 'eemaankamaa'i tawHiyd genoorun 'alive 'ujaalaavegenvaa nafusuge veriyaa'eve. dhe'vi ginaguna savaabaa'i dharuma 'ash ruhigenvaa hhaalu 'adhi 'ekalaange thibaa'ash ruhivodigenvaa hhaalu thibaage rb ge HaDra@ 'ash 'enburi 'annaasheve.
('adhives 'ekalaange 'angavaane'eve.) thimanraskalaange SaliHu taqwa~ veri 'aLungethere'ash vannaasheve.
'adhi thimanraskalaange suvaruge'ash vannaasheve.
mi ma'kaa gandhe'va'i thimanraskalaange huva'i waHiy kurashvameve.

('ey rasuwlu llh!) kaleyge faanash 'erash hhalaalu vegenve'eve. ('ebahee llh hu'dha koshdhe'vi kudavaguthu koLe'ga'i hanguraamakosh qathulukurun kaleygefaanash hhalaalu vegenve'eve. 'e'ee ma'kaa fathahha kure'vidhuvahu hu'dhavi kudavaguthu koLe'kamuga'i vaaridhuvegen 'a'isfa'ive'eve. dhen 'eygefahuga'i 'alunves kurin 'othfadha'in Hurma@ theri rashe'kamuga'i 'erash ve'je'eve. wallh '`lm)
'adhi 'aadhamge dharinkure konme ba'payakaa'i 'adhi 'eynaayash libunu dharin gandhe'va'i huva'i wHy kurashvameve. mi dhehuva'ige javaabakee,
hamakashavarun 'insaanaa thimanraskalaange he'dhevee 'undhagulaa'i bura 'ufulaa meehe'ge gothuga'eve.

'adhi 'e'ves meehaku 'eynaage ma'chash kuLadhaana nuvaanekamash 'e'insaanaa heekuraneehe'yeve? ('ebahee 'eynaa kithanme faafa'e' kosh 'uLeynegothakash 'uLunas 'eynaayash `azaabe'dhee badhalu hifeynemeehaku nethkamash 'eynaa heekuraneehe'yeve?)
'adhi 'eynaa bune'eve. ('islaamdheenaa'i rswl 'aa'i `adhaavaath theri vumuga'i) 'ahuren 'etha'ba'ivaru gina `adhadhe'ge mudhaa heydhakosh halaaku koshfeemeve.
'aLefahe 'eynaayaa'i 'eynaa kuraa kantha' 'ekakuves nudhekeynekamash 'eynaa heekuraneehe'yeve? ('ehennuvaane'eve. 'eynaage hurihaakame' dhenevodigenve'eve.)
fahe 'eynaayash thimanraskalaange dheloa nudhe'vanhe'yeve? ('ebahee dhe'veemeve.)
'adhi dhulakaa'i dhe thunfathves nudhe'vanhe'yeve? ('ebahee dhe'veemeve.)

'adhi thimanraskalaange 'eyna'ash dhemagu dhe'keveemeve. 'e'ee heyomagaa'i nuba'i mageve. 'eynaa beynunmage' 'ikhthiyaru kuraasheve.
dhanna'eve. mithaa mi sifavegendhaa meehakee 'abuw l'ashdyn kiyaa kaafare' kamuga'i ve'eve. 'e'ee 'islaamdheenashaa'i rswl 'ash varash `adhaavaththeri meehe'kamuga'i vi'eve. 'e `adhaavaththeri kan gadhakurumash gina mudhaatha'ves 'eynaa heydhakuri kamuga'i ve'eve. tfsyr ('ysr ltfsyr)

fahe 'eynaa `aqab@ fahana'aLa'i nudhe'eve. nuvatha 'enaa `qb@ fahana'aLa'idhaane nama kihaa rangaLu he'yeve. ('ebahee 'eynaage 'e gina mudhalun heydhakoshgen `qb@ fahana'aLa'i dhiyanama kihaa rangaLuhe'yeve? 'e 'bw l'ashdyn 'ehurihaa mudhaa `qb@ fahana'aLa'i dhi'umash beynunkurinama kihaa rangaLu he'yeve?)
'adhi `qb@ 'e'ee kon 'e'che'kan kaleygefaanash 'anga'idhinee kon'e'che' he'yeve?
'e'ee 'aLun minivankurumeve.
nuvatha banduha'i hoonukamuga'i vaameehaa'ash kaa'ethikoLu foarukoshdhinumeve. kaan dhinumeve.
'ebahee gaaththimaage yatheem'ash (kaa'ethikoLu dhinumeve.)

nuvatha veleegeveri miskeenakash kaa'ethikoLu dhinumeve. ('ebahee faqeerukamun velinoon 'ehen'e'che'neth nuvatha binmathee 'oshoave 'othumuge sababun veli heykifa'ivaa ge'e'dhore' kaa'ethikoLe' feyraame' neth miskeenakash kaa'ethikoLu dhinumeve.) (`aqb@ 'akee mikankameve.)

'adhi 'efadha heyokantha'kuraameehaa 'eemaanvegenvaa meehungethere'in vumaa'eku ke'theri vumuge ma'chash 'ekaku 'anekakash vasithya kosh hedhi meehaku kamuga'i ve'eve. 'adhi 'ekaku 'anekakuge ma'chash rahhmath behe'tumashves vasithyath kuraameehaku kamuga'i 'eynaave'eve.
'efadha 'efadha meehun dhanna'eve. 'emeehunnakee kanaathfaraathuge 'ekuverinneve. nuvatha 'emeehunnee qiyaamath dhuvahun 'emeehunge `amaluge fath kanaatha'libeyne rangaLu meehunneve.

'adhi thimanraskalaange 'aayaththakash kaafaruvee meesthakun dhanna'eve. 'emeehunnakee va'athfaraathuge 'ekuverinneve. nuvatha 'emeehunnee qiyaamath dhuvahun 'emeehunge `amaluge fath va'athfaraathun libeyne meehunve.
'emeehunnash hunnahushee bandhuve thaLulevigenvaa `azaabeve. ('efadha konme meehaku jahannama'ige vakithaakashlevi vakin bandhu kureveynekamuga'i rivaavegen ve'eve.)
'iraa'i 'adhi 'eyge 'alikan gandhe'va'i huva'i waHy kurashva'eve.
handhu boduve vashve 'irufadha'in 'alikamuga'i thabaa ve'je'yaa'i 'e handhu gandhe'va'i huva'i waHy kurashva'eve.
'adhi dhuvaalu 'alive'je'yaa 'edhuvaalu gandhe'va'i huva'i waHy kurashva'eve.
'adhi reygandu 'andhiri ve'je'yaa 'e reygandu gandhe'va'i huva'i waHy kurashva'eve.
'adhi 'udaa'i 'ethaanga'i binaakura'vaafa'ivaahaa thake'chaa'i gandhe'va'i huva'i waHy kurashva'eve.
bimaa'i 'adhi bimuga'i fathuru'vaafa'ivaahaa thanakaa'i gandhe'va'i huva'i waHy kurashva'eve.
'adhi nafsaa'i nafsuga'i la'va'i tharukeebu kura'vaa baraabaru kura'vaafa'ivaahaa gunavanakaa'i gandhe'va'i huva'i waHy kurashva'eve.

fahe 'ekalaange 'e nafsash 'enafsuge nuba'ikamaa'i rangaLukan 'angava'idhe'vi'eve. 'ebahee 'e nafsash nuba'imagaa'i heyomagu 'angava'i dhe'vi'eve. dhanna'eve. 'isvedhiya hurihaathake'che' gandhe'va'i kure'vi huva'ige javaabakaa'i medhu mufa'sirun basthafaatheve. ba'e'beykalun vidhaaLuvanee javaabu Hadhf vefa'ivaa kamasheve. (vanhanaavefa'ivaakamasheve.) 'eyge javaabakee hamakashavarun kaleymen maruvumashfahu mahhsharash fonuveyne'eve. mi'eve. 'ane'ba'i beykalun vidhaaLuvanee 'e huva'ige javaabakee qad 'aflaHa man zakWaha waqad khaba man dasWaha mi 'aayath kamasheve. (mi javaabu 'aayathuge siyaqu 'aa'i gaathkan bodeve. wllh '`lm.)
hamakashavarun nafusu Tahirukosh shirukaa'i faafa'in dhurukoshfimeehaa kaamiyaabuve salaamath ve'je'eve.
'adhi 'enafusu magufura'dha'i halaakukosh vaave'dhimeehaa hamakashavarun ge'li halaakuve'je'eve.

thamuwdu baaga'igemeehun 'emeehun nukiyamantherikamuga'i ha'dhufahana'aLa'i gathumugesababun 'emeehunge rasoolu (SaliHu `alayhi lslm) ge rasoolukan 'emeehun dhogukoshfi'eve. nuvatha 'emeehun 'eemaan nuvinama 'emeehunnash 'athuvedhaaneykamash vidhaaLuvi `azaabu 'emeehundhogu koshfi'eve.
'e'ee 'emeehunge 'enmenuba'i 'adhi'enme 'abaa'javeriyaa (qadaru bnu salifu) ge jamalukoLu merumash thedhuve qaa'imuveehidhunneve. nuvatha 'emeehun 'enaafonuvi hidhunneve.

'adhi 'emeehunnash 'emeehunge rasoolu (SaliHu `alayhi lslm) vidhaakhuvi'eve. kaleymen ge jamalufuLash goanaa'e'nukosh 'eythi'uLen 'ethidhookoshlaasheve. 'adhi 'ethiboanevarakash fenboan 'eythidhookoshlaasheve.

dhenfahe 'emeehun 'ekaleygefaanunge basfuLu dhogukoshfi'eve. 'adhi'ejamalukoLuge mo'gadutha' kada'i 'ethi mara'ifi'eve. 'ekankuree 'enmenmeba'ivegenvaameehaa qadWaru bnu salif kiyaa 'abaa'javeriyaa'eve. dhenfahe 'emeehungema'chash ge `azaabu 'athuve'je'eve. 'e'ee 'emeehunge nukiyamantherikamaa'i faafa'ige sababunneve. 'adhi 'e`azaabu 'emeehunge ma'chash `aa'mukura'va'ifi'eve. 'e'eegadhavegenvaa 'adufashgadekeve. 'e'adash 'enmen birunfi'kedi maruve thandaavee'eve.
'adhi llh 'ekankure'vee fahathunbayaku 'a'is 'ekamugebadhalu hifa'ifaanekamuge 'e'vesgothakun biruvethive vevodigathumakaa'i nula'eve. (badhaluhifeyneekaakashhe'yeve?)
reygandu 'andhirive'je'yaa reygandu gandhe'va'i huva'i vahhee kura'va'eve.
dhuvaalu 'alive 'ujaalaa ve'je'yaa dhuvaalugandhe'va'i huva'i vahhee kura'va'eve.
'adhi firihen 'anhen dhejinsu he'dhevi thaathufuLu 'ebahee gandhe'va'i huva'i vahhee kura'va'eve. nuva 'anhen firihen dhejinsu gandhe'va'i huva'i vahhee kura'va'eve. 'ehuva'ige javaabakee:
hamakashavarun thiyaba'imeehunge `amalutha' thafaathuvegenve'eve. suvaruge vanthaveri `amalaa'i narakavanthaverikamuge `amalaa'eve.
fahe thimaage mudhaa heyogothuga'i heydhakosh sadhaqaath kosh 'adhi 'eyaa'eku 'eynaa taqwa~ verive.
'adhi 'eynaa'eheydhakuri mudhaluge savaabu llh dhe'vaanekamash thedhukosh yaqeen kosh nuvatha llah lWa llh thedhukosh nuvatha suvaruge dhe'vaanekamuga'i thedhukosh hedhimeehaa dhanna'eve.
hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange 'eynaa 'ash 'islaamudheennash 'uLun faseyhakoshdhe'vaahusheemeve. nuvatha suvaruge'ash dheveynegoth faseykoshdhe'vaahusheemeve.
'adhi thimaa mudhalash dhahivethive heyogothuga'i mudhaaheydhanukosh bakhiylu ve 'adhi akhira@ ge dharumayaa'i savaabu fiyava'i dhuniyeyge 'araamaa'i majalash fudhigenfimeehaa,

'adhi'eynaagemudhaa heyogothuga'i heydhakureemaa 'eygedharumayaa'i savaabudhe'vaanekamash thedhunukosh 'ekandhogukosh nuvatha llah lWa llh thedhunukosh nuvatha suvaruge dhe'vaanekamuga'i thedhukosh nuhedhimeehaa dhanna'eve.
hamakashavarun thimanraskalaange 'eynaa'ash heyokantha'kurumuge magudhathikosh 'udhagookoshlaa husheemeve.

'adhi 'efadha nulafaameehun halaakugethere'ash ve'ti'je'yaa 'ebahee 'eynaa naraka'ash levi'je'yaa 'enaagemudhaa 'eynaa'ash 'e'veskame' fu'dha'e'nudheyne'eve. 'eynaage mudhaluge 'e'ves fa'idhaa'e' 'eynaa'akash nukuraane'eve.
hamakashavarun thedhumagu bayaankoshdhe'vumakee thimanraskalaange'ash 'othkamekeve. ('ebahee heyomagaa'i nuba'imagu bayaankoshdhinumakee thimanraskalaange kamekeve.)
'adhi hamakashavarun dhuniye'aa'i akhira@ khaSWa vegenvanee thimanraskalaange'asheve. 'edhethaaga'ives thimanraskalaange 'edhivodigannavaa gothakash kantha'ge'dhavameve.
fahe qiyama@ dhuvahun 'adhan'adhaanuri gadha 'alifaane' hurikamuge biruveri khabaru thimanraskalaange kaleymennash dhemeve.
'abaa'javeri'akumenuvee 'e'alifaanash nuvannahu'teve.
'emeehunnee hha'qu dhogukosh 'eemaankamaa'i kiyamantherikamash furagasdhinmeehunneve.
'adhi taqwa~ verimaath meehun 'e'alifaanaa'i dhurukureveyne'eve. 'efadhameehun 'e'alifaanaa'i gaathnuvaane'eve.
'e taqwa~ verimaath meehakee thimaagemudhaa heyogothuga'i llh maguga'i heydhakosh 'adhi shirukaa'i 'ehenihenves faafa'in Tahiru vegenvaa meehekeve.
'adhi 'e'vesmeehakash 'emeehaakoshdhey heydhayaa'i Sadaqa@ ge muqabilu ga'i 'e'ves badhalakash nu'edheymeehekeve.
hama'ekani Sadaqa@ ge muqabilu ga'i 'emeehaa 'edheyhaaveskamakee 'emeehaa ha'dhavaa bodukura'vaa mathiverimaath rabWu ge wajhu fuLeve. 'ekalaange ruhivodigathumeve.

dhenfahe 'emeehaage mathiverivegenvaa rabWu ge wajhu fuLu 'edhigen Sadaqa@ kurimeehaa 'eynaa ruheyvaruge savaabaa'i karaamaath nikanhure 'eynaadhekeyne'eve.
* noatu: mi'aayath thakunsifavegenmidhaa taqwa~ verimaath meehakee 'buw bakr lSWidWiyqu raDiya llh `anhu kamuga'i ginamufa'sirun vidhaaLuve'eve. fahe 'ekaleygefaanunge mudhalun 'ethake' 'aLunminivan kura'va'i ge wajhu fuLa'taka'i dhookure'vi'eve. dhunyavee 'e'ves beynunfuLe' 'ovegenne'nooneve. kaleygefaanee yatheemaku kamuga'i 'ekalaange dhekevodigennevi'eve. dhenkaleyge faanash gedhoraa'i 'uLeveyne goth 'ekalaange ha'dhava'i dhe'vi'eve.
'adhi kaleyge faanee furihamathedhumage' nethi Gafil ve vada'igenvaa beykalaku kamuga'i 'ekalaange dhekevodigatheve. dhen 'ekalaange kaleygefaanash thedhumagu dhe'kevi'eve.

'adhi kaleyge faanee faqeeru 'adhi dharin gina beykalaku kamuga'i 'ekalaage dhekevodigennevi'eve. dhen 'ekalaange kaleygefaanu mu'sadhi kure'vi'eve. (kaleygefaanunge nafusufuLu mu'sadhi kura'va'i kaleygefaanu ruhivada'igannavaanegoth ha'dhava'idhe'vi'eve.)
fahe yatheemu kudhinge ma'chash gadhaha'dhava'i harukashive vada'i nugannavaasheve!
'adhi salaamujahaa nikamethinnash 'e'chethigova'i 'emeehun fa'sa'i nuha'dhavaasheve!

'adhi kaleygefaanunge rb kaleygefaanash dhe'vi ni`ma@ thakuge vaahakafuLu dha'kava'i 'ekan meesthakunnash faaLukura'vaasheve! dhanna'eve. ni`ma@ 'akee hurihaa ni`ma@ 'ekeve. namaves 'eygethere'in 'enme muqadWa su ni`ma@ 'akee quran 'eve. quran kiyavaa vidhaaLuvaasheve. nuvatha'e ni`ma@ 'akee nabeekameve. wllh '`lm.
thimanraskalaange kaleygefaanunge meymathifuLu thanavas kosh nudhe'vanthoa'eve? 'ebahee thanavaskoshdhe'veemeve.
'adhi thimanraskalaange kaleygefaanungekiba'in kaleygefaanuge kushfaafatha' dhurukure'veemeve. ('ebahee jaahili'ya zamaanuga'i faafa'e'vefa'ivaanamaves 'efaafa'e'ves nangavaa dhurukure'veemeve.)
'efaafathakakee kaleygefaanunge burakashifuLash buravefa'ivaa faafathakeve.
